AI.title_translation: Twitch聊天中的毒性：基于LLM的跨游戏社区分析
AI.tldr: 本研究使用LLM分析了Twitch上2000万条聊天消息的毒性，发现2.4%的消息有毒，MOBA游戏毒性最高，体育游戏最低，且毒性模式存在游戏特异性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注游戏内毒性，但对流媒体平台上不同游戏社区之间毒性行为的差异知之甚少。
AI.method: 分析了来自Twitch上4,452个直播流（涵盖七种游戏类型）的约2,000万条聊天消息。使用预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）进行零样本分类，根据Twitch的毒性分类法（包括骚扰、歧视、性内容和脏话等四个类别和八个子类别）对消息进行分类。该方法在TextDetox数据集上F1分数为94.5%。
AI.result: 2.4%的所有消息被归类为有毒。毒性在不同游戏类型之间存在显著差异：MOBA游戏直播的相对毒性率最高（3.2%），体育游戏显示出最低的毒性率（2%）。即使在同一游戏类型内，不同游戏的毒性分布也存在显著差异，表明存在超越类型层面的、塑造毒性行为的游戏特定社区规范和机制。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为Twitch上类型和游戏特定的毒性模式提供了实证见解，可以为游戏社区制定更有针对性的审核策略提供信息。
AI.translation: 在线游戏社区中的毒性仍然是一个持续的挑战，它体现在各种游戏类型、平台和玩家互动中。虽然许多研究集中在游戏内毒性上，但对于流媒体平台上不同游戏社区之间毒性行为如何变化知之甚少。为了解决这一不足，我们分析了来自Twitch上4,452个直播流的约2000万条聊天消息，这些直播流涵盖了七种游戏类型。我们使用预训练的大型语言模型通过零样本分类，根据Twitch的毒性分类法对消息进行分类。该分类法包括四个类别和八个子类别，包括骚扰、歧视、性内容和脏话。我们的方法在TextDetox数据集上取得了94.5%的F1分数，并展示了与人际一致性相当的人机一致性。我们的分析显示，所有消息中有2.4%被归类为有毒，并且不同游戏类型之间存在显著差异：MOBA游戏直播显示出最高的相对毒性率（3.2%），而体育游戏显示出最低的毒性率（2%）。此外，结果表明，即使在同一游戏类型内，不同游戏的毒性分布也存在显著差异，这表明存在超越类型层面的、塑造毒性行为的游戏特定社区规范和机制。这些发现为Twitch上类型和游戏特定的毒性模式提供了实证见解，可以为游戏社区制定更有针对性的审核策略提供信息。
AI.summary: 本文利用大型语言模型（LLM）对Twitch上2000万条聊天消息进行了毒性分析，旨在探究流媒体平台上不同游戏社区间的毒性行为差异。研究发现，2.4%的消息具有毒性，其中MOBA游戏毒性最高（3.2%），体育游戏最低（2%）。更重要的是，即使在同一游戏类型内，毒性分布也存在显著的游戏特异性。这些实证结果为制定针对性的游戏社区审核策略提供了重要依据。
AI.keywords: Twitch聊天毒性, 大型语言模型, 零样本分类, 游戏社区, 毒性模式
AI.comments: 本文通过大规模数据分析和LLM的零样本分类能力，弥补了流媒体平台毒性研究的不足。LLM在毒性检测上的高F1分数和人机一致性表明其在该领域的潜力。发现游戏内毒性存在显著差异，即使在同一类型内，也强调了未来审核策略需要考虑游戏特定的社区规范和机制，而非仅仅依赖泛类型策略，具有重要的实践指导意义。

title: Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL
authors: Guang Lin Haoyang Zheng Runzhe Zhang Guang Lin
summary: Recent advances in one-step text-to-image generation have enabled real-time synthesis with remarkable efficiency and quality. Previous reinforcement learning methods for one-step generators combine image-space reward optimization with diffusion noisy-space distribution matching. This paradigm brings challenges due to a mismatch between terminal reward optimization and the underlying generative dynamics. As a result, optimization tends to exploit stochastic degrees of freedom, often improving reward at the expense of image fidelity. To address this issue, we propose Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR), a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization. DIDR propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory. We show that this objective admits the same minimizer as clean-image RLHF, while naturally inducing the Diffused Reward Score (DRS), which acts as a reward-driven correction to the reference score function. To make this practical, we further introduce the Diffused Reward Proxy (DRP), an efficient estimator of DRS based on differentiable short-step denoising. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIDR consistently Pareto-dominates existing one-step SDXL baselines. Moreover, when transferred to a 6B DiT backbone (Z-Image), DIDR surpasses its 50-step teacher in preference alignment while requiring only a single generation step.

AI.title_translation: Diff-Instruct与扩散奖励：迈向原则性一步生成器强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR)的新型强化学习框架，用于一步文本到图像生成器，通过解决现有方法中奖励优化与生成动态之间的不匹配问题，显著提高了图像保真度和偏好对齐，同时保持了单步生成效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的一步文本到图像生成器强化学习方法在图像空间奖励优化与扩散噪声空间分布匹配之间存在不匹配，导致优化倾向于利用随机自由度，以牺牲图像保真度为代价提高奖励。
AI.method: 提出Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR)框架，这是一个基于积分KL最小化的无数据轨迹级对齐框架。DIDR将RLHF最优的奖励倾斜的干净图像分布传播到扩散轨迹上的所有噪声水平。它引入了扩散奖励分数（DRS）作为参考分数函数的奖励驱动校正，并通过可微分短步去噪引入了扩散奖励代理（DRP）作为DRS的有效估计器。
AI.result: DIDR在广泛实验中始终帕累托优于现有的一步SDXL基线。当应用于6B DiT骨干（Z-Image）时，DIDR在偏好对齐方面超越了其50步的教师模型，同时仅需一步生成。
AI.conclusion: DIDR通过解决现有RL方法中的不匹配问题，为一步生成器RL提供了一个原则性的框架，显著提高了生成质量和效率，实现了帕累托优势并超越了多步教师模型。
AI.translation: 一步文本到图像生成领域的最新进展实现了卓越效率和质量的实时合成。现有的一步生成器强化学习方法结合了图像空间奖励优化和扩散噪声空间分布匹配。这种范式由于终端奖励优化与底层生成动态之间的不匹配带来了挑战。因此，优化倾向于利用随机自由度，通常以牺牲图像保真度为代价来提高奖励。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR)，一个源自积分KL最小化的无数据轨迹级对齐框架。DIDR将RLHF最优的奖励倾斜的干净图像分布沿着扩散轨迹传播到所有噪声水平。我们表明，这个目标与干净图像RLHF具有相同的最小化器，同时自然地诱导出扩散奖励分数（DRS），它作为对参考分数函数的奖励驱动校正。为了使其实用，我们进一步引入了扩散奖励代理（DRP），一个基于可微分短步去噪的DRS高效估计器。广泛的实验表明，DIDR始终帕累托优于现有的一步SDXL基线。此外，当转移到6B DiT骨干（Z-Image）时，DIDR在偏好对齐方面超越了其50步的教师模型，同时仅需一步生成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR)的新型强化学习框架，旨在解决现有文本到图像一步生成器RL方法中奖励优化与生成动态不匹配导致图像保真度下降的问题。DIDR基于积分KL最小化，通过在扩散轨迹上对齐奖励倾斜的干净图像分布，并引入扩散奖励分数（DRS）及其高效估计器扩散奖励代理（DRP）来实现。实验证明，DIDR不仅在性能上帕累托优于现有的一步SDXL基线，而且在应用于大型DiT模型时，仅需一步生成就能在偏好对齐方面超越多步教师模型，显著提升了生成质量和效率。
AI.keywords: 一步生成器,强化学习,扩散模型,文本到图像,奖励对齐
AI.comments: 这项工作通过提出一个原则性的轨迹级对齐框架DIDR，有效地解决了现有强化学习方法在一站式文本到图像生成中面临的奖励优化与生成动态不匹配的关键问题。其创新之处在于将RLHF最优的奖励分布传播到整个扩散轨迹，并引入了DRS和DRP来实际实现这一点。DIDR在保持单步生成效率的同时，显著提高了图像质量和偏好对齐，甚至超越了多步模型，这对于实时高质量图像生成领域具有重要意义。

title: Remote sensing data imputation using deep learning for multispectral imagery
summary: Remote sensing techniques have been increasingly utilised in aquatic applications in recent years. A common challenge in using optical satellite data is the presence of missing observations due to cloud cover. These data gaps can lead to missed detection of critical events, such as algal blooms, in lakes of high interest to water authorities. As a result, enhancing the completeness of optical satellite datasets is crucial for improving the monitoring and prediction of algal blooms. In this study, we compared a traditional data imputation method (i.e., linear interpolation) with deep learning models for reconstructing missing spectral bands across four lakes with historical records of algal blooms. The deep learning models adopted include CNN-based architectures (i.e., CNN, Inception Resnet, and Autoencoder) and CNN-LSTM-based architectures (i.e., CNN-LSTM, Resnet-LSTM, and Autoencoder-LSTM). Our results demonstrated that deep learning models substantially outperformed the baseline linear interpolation method in imputing spectral band values within artificially masked regions. Among these models, CNN delivered the best performance across most lakes. Furthermore, we evaluated the performance of algal bloom indices (i.e., Green/Red and NDCI) derived from the imputed imagery by comparing them with the observed data. Our results demonstrate that deep learning models are effective for imputing missing data in PlanetScope SuperDove imagery, enabling more reliable applications in water monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 使用深度学习进行多光谱遥感数据插补
AI.tldr: 本研究比较了传统数据插补方法与深度学习模型在多光谱遥感图像中重建缺失光谱波段的能力，发现深度学习模型显著优于传统方法，尤其在藻华监测应用中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 光学卫星数据中因云层覆盖常出现缺失观测，导致无法及时发现藻华等关键事件。提高光学卫星数据集的完整性对于改进藻华监测和预测至关重要。
AI.method: 本研究将传统数据插补方法（线性插值）与多种深度学习模型（包括CNN、Inception Resnet、Autoencoder等CNN-based架构，以及CNN-LSTM、Resnet-LSTM、Autoencoder-LSTM等CNN-LSTM-based架构）进行了比较，以重建四个有藻华历史记录的湖泊中缺失的光谱波段。通过人工掩膜区域评估插补性能，并比较插补图像导出的藻华指数（Green/Red和NDCI）与观测数据。
AI.result: 深度学习模型在人工掩膜区域的谱带值插补方面显著优于基线线性插值方法。在这些模型中，CNN在大多数湖泊中表现最佳。深度学习模型能有效插补PlanetScope SuperDove图像中的缺失数据。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习模型能够有效插补多光谱遥感图像中的缺失数据，从而实现更可靠的水体监测应用。
AI.translation: 近年来，遥感技术在水生应用中的利用日益增多。使用光学卫星数据的一个常见挑战是由于云层覆盖导致观测数据缺失。这些数据空白可能导致对水务部门高度关注的湖泊中关键事件（如藻华）的漏检。因此，提高光学卫星数据集的完整性对于改进藻华监测和预测至关重要。在本研究中，我们比较了传统数据插补方法（即线性插值）与深度学习模型，用于重建四个具有藻华历史记录的湖泊中缺失的光谱波段。所采用的深度学习模型包括基于CNN的架构（即CNN、Inception Resnet和Autoencoder）和基于CNN-LSTM的架构（即CNN-LSTM、Resnet-LSTM和Autoencoder-LSTM）。我们的结果表明，深度学习模型在人工掩膜区域的谱带值插补方面显著优于基线线性插值方法。在这些模型中，CNN在大多数湖泊中表现最佳。此外，我们通过将插补图像导出的藻华指数（即Green/Red和NDCI）与观测数据进行比较，评估了其性能。我们的结果表明，深度学习模型对于插补PlanetScope SuperDove图像中的缺失数据是有效的，从而能够实现更可靠的水体监测应用。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决光学卫星图像中因云层覆盖导致的缺失数据问题，该问题阻碍了藻华等水生应用的有效监测。研究比较了传统线性插值方法与多种深度学习模型（包括基于CNN和CNN-LSTM的架构）在重建多光谱图像中缺失光谱波段方面的性能。实验结果表明，深度学习模型在插补任务上显著优于线性插值，其中CNN模型在多数情况下表现最佳。研究最终证实，深度学习模型能有效插补遥感缺失数据，从而提升水体监测应用的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 遥感, 深度学习, 数据插补, 多光谱图像, 藻华
AI.comments: 该论文展示了深度学习在解决遥感领域常见挑战（数据缺失）方面的实用性。通过与传统方法的比较以及针对藻华监测这一具体应用的衍生指数评估，突出了其现实意义和潜在影响。使用多种深度学习架构进行全面比较，增加了研究的严谨性。

title: Reason--Imagine--Act: Closed-Loop LLM Decision Making with World Models for Autonomous Driving
comments: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are promising for autonomous driving, but semantics-only decision policies can yield physically unsafe behavior in dynamic traffic. Existing methods either perform online language reasoning without explicit dynamics verification or use world models mainly in offline pipelines, leaving a gap between semantic intent and physical feasibility at decision time. We propose Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA), a closed-loop framework that couples an LLM reasoner with an action-conditioned world model for online safety verification. At each step, the LLM proposes an action template and candidate sub-actions, the world model performs short-horizon rollouts, and a safety scorer selects the safest executable action with feedback to the next reasoning step. Under a unified CARLA point-goal protocol (1000 episodes), RIA achieves 80.05% route completion, 51.10% arrival rate, and 0.20% collision rate. Under the same closed-loop interface, RIA consistently outperforms training-free baselines, including CARLA TM and MADA, on core closed-loop metrics. For reproducibility, code is available at https://github.com/pku-smart-city/source_code/tree/main/RIA.
comment: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). 8 pages, 2 figures

AI.title_translation: 思考-想象-行动：基于世界模型的闭环大型语言模型自动驾驶决策
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA) 框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）推理器与动作条件世界模型相结合，用于自动驾驶中的在线安全验证，显著提高了路线完成率和安全性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在自动驾驶中潜力巨大，但仅基于语义的决策策略可能导致物理不安全的行为。现有方法要么缺乏明确的动态验证，要么主要在离线管道中使用世界模型，导致语义意图与决策时的物理可行性之间存在差距。
AI.method: 提出Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA) 闭环框架，将LLM推理器与动作条件世界模型耦合，进行在线安全验证。在每一步中，LLM提出动作模板和候选子动作，世界模型执行短时预测推演，安全评分器选择最安全的可执行动作，并将反馈传回下一推理步骤。
AI.result: 在统一的CARLA点目标协议下（1000个 эпизоды），RIA实现了80.05%的路线完成率，51.10%的到达率和0.20%的碰撞率。在相同的闭环接口下，RIA在核心闭环指标上始终优于包括CARLA TM和MADA在内的免训练基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RIA框架通过结合LLM的语义推理能力和世界模型的物理验证能力，有效解决了自动驾驶中语义意图与物理可行性之间的差距，显著提高了决策的安全性和性能。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动驾驶领域前景广阔，但仅基于语义的决策策略可能在动态交通中导致物理不安全的行为。现有方法要么进行在线语言推理但缺乏明确的动态验证，要么主要在离线管道中使用世界模型，这在决策时在语义意图和物理可行性之间留下了空白。我们提出了Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA)，一个闭环框架，它将LLM推理器与动作条件世界模型耦合，用于在线安全验证。在每一步中，LLM提出一个动作模板和候选子动作，世界模型执行短时预测推演，安全评分器选择最安全的可执行动作，并将反馈传回下一推理步骤。在统一的CARLA点目标协议下（1000个 эпизоды），RIA实现了80.05%的路线完成率，51.10%的到达率和0.20%的碰撞率。在相同的闭环接口下，RIA在核心闭环指标上始终优于包括CARLA TM和MADA在内的免训练基线方法。为了可重现性，代码可在https://github.com/pku-smart-city/source_code/tree/main/RIA获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA) 框架，旨在解决大型语言模型在自动驾驶中决策时语义意图与物理可行性之间的差距。RIA是一个闭环系统，它将LLM的推理能力与动作条件世界模型相结合，进行在线安全验证。LLM提出动作，世界模型模拟其短期后果，安全评分器选择最佳动作并提供反馈。实验结果表明，RIA在CARLA环境下显著提高了路线完成率、到达率并降低了碰撞率，优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 自动驾驶, 世界模型, 闭环决策, 安全验证
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个将LLM的语义推理能力与世界模型的物理验证能力相结合的闭环框架，有效解决了自动驾驶中LLM决策的安全性问题。通过在线安全验证，RIA弥补了现有方法在语义意图和物理可行性之间的差距，为LLM在具身智能领域的应用提供了新的思路。其优势在于提高了决策的可靠性和安全性。

title: LC-ERD: Mining Latent Logic for Self-Evolving Reasoning via Consistency-Regulated Reward Decomposition
summary: The evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality process data. While self-alignment via endogenous rewards offers a solution, mining valid supervision faces three challenges: (1) Label Noise via Mimetic Bias, where rewards prioritize statistical likelihood over logical truth, creating a "correctness illusion" that masks compounding errors; (2) Coarse-Grained Supervision, where sparse global outcomes (e.g., in GRPO) fail to provide granular guidance, treating reasoning chains as monolithic; and (3) Distributional Collapse, where signals fail to generalize without amplifying pre-training biases. To address these, we introduce LC-ERD (Logic-Consistent Endogenous Reward Decomposition), a framework framing self-alignment as latent structure mining. We derive a Variational Logic Potential by aggregating consensus from the model's Latent Logic Expertise (LLE) to denoise the reasoning manifold, and introduce a Multi-Agent Value Decomposition protocol based on the IGM principle to quantify individual step utility. Experiments show LC-ERD delivers a robust self-evolution path, uncovering trade-offs between logic consistency and accuracy while identifying high-value reasoning patterns missed by standard rewards. Our code is available at https://github.com/Reinhardmannn/LC-ERD.

AI.title_translation: LC-ERD：通过一致性调节的奖励分解挖掘潜在逻辑以实现自进化推理
AI.tldr: LC-ERD通过挖掘潜在逻辑和分解奖励，解决了大型语言模型推理中高质量过程数据稀缺的问题，从而实现自进化推理。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理的演进受到高质量过程数据稀缺的限制。现有的自对齐方法面临三个挑战：模仿偏差导致的标签噪声、粗粒度监督和分布崩溃。
AI.method: 本文提出了LC-ERD（Logic-Consistent Endogenous Reward Decomposition）框架，将自对齐视为潜在结构挖掘。它通过聚合模型潜在逻辑专业知识（LLE）的共识来推导变分逻辑潜力以去噪推理流形，并引入基于IGM原则的多智能体价值分解协议来量化单个步骤的效用。
AI.result: 实验表明，LC-ERD提供了一条稳健的自进化路径，揭示了逻辑一致性和准确性之间的权衡，同时识别出标准奖励错失的高价值推理模式。
AI.conclusion: LC-ERD通过解决现有自对齐方法的挑战，有效地促进了LLM的自进化推理，并发现了更深层次的推理模式，超越了单纯的统计准确性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理的演进受到高质量过程数据稀缺的瓶颈限制。虽然通过内源性奖励进行自对齐提供了一种解决方案，但挖掘有效的监督面临三个挑战：(1) 模仿偏差造成的标签噪声，即奖励优先考虑统计可能性而非逻辑真相，从而产生“正确性幻觉”，掩盖复合错误；(2) 粗粒度监督，即稀疏的全局结果（例如在GRPO中）未能提供细粒度指导，将推理链视为整体；(3) 分布崩溃，即信号未能泛化而没有放大预训练偏差。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了LC-ERD（Logic-Consistent Endogenous Reward Decomposition），一个将自对齐视为潜在结构挖掘的框架。我们通过聚合模型潜在逻辑专业知识（LLE）的共识来推导变分逻辑潜力，以去噪推理流形，并引入基于IGM原则的多智能体价值分解协议来量化单个步骤的效用。实验表明，LC-ERD提供了一条稳健的自进化路径，揭示了逻辑一致性和准确性之间的权衡，同时识别出标准奖励错失的高价值推理模式。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Reinhardmannn/LC-ERD 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LC-ERD框架，旨在解决大型语言模型推理中高质量过程数据稀缺和现有自对齐方法存在的标签噪声、粗粒度监督及分布崩溃问题。LC-ERD通过挖掘模型的潜在逻辑专业知识来构建变分逻辑潜力以去噪推理，并采用多智能体价值分解来细化奖励，从而实现稳健的自进化推理，并发现传统方法难以捕捉的高价值推理模式。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 自进化推理, 奖励分解, 潜在逻辑, 一致性调节
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入LC-ERD框架，创新性地将自对齐视为潜在结构挖掘，并结合变分逻辑潜力和多智能体价值分解，有效解决了LLM推理中高质量过程数据稀缺和现有自对齐方法的局限性。其关注逻辑一致性而非单纯统计准确性，有望推动LLM在复杂推理任务上的进步。

title: A Tabular Schedule Abstraction for Communication-Aware Evaluation of Pipeline-Parallel LLM Training
comments: Accepted at the 25th IEEE International Symposium on Parallel and Distributed Computing (ISPDC 2026)
summary:
Pipeline parallelism is a key technique for distributed training of large language models because it reduces per-device parameter and activation memory. However, comparing pipeline schedules is difficult: analytical models expose structural quantities such as bubble ratios, while end-to-end hardware experiments are costly and system-specific. In this work, we introduce a tabular schedule abstraction and a unified multi-abstraction methodology that connects formula-based reasoning, idealized schedule tables, and communication-aware execution simulation.
  Using this framework, we compare GPipe, 1F1B, Chimera, and Hanayo in its restricted regime across multiple modeled system configurations. Our results show that schedule rankings are not abstraction-invariant: communication can negate structural advantages suggested by bubble analysis alone. Under the assumptions considered here, GPipe and 1F1B are runtime-equivalent, but 1F1B achieves a lower activation-memory peak. Chimera is advantageous mainly at low microbatch counts and in communication-favorable regimes, while Hanayo is effective in its intended restricted operating point but remains sensitive to network bottlenecks. We further study an asymmetric Chimera-style placement, which does not reduce the global peak memory requirement but reveals limited runtime gains in shallow pipelines. Overall, pipeline schedule quality is meaningful only in the context of the modeled execution environment.
comment: Accepted at the 25th IEEE International Symposium on Parallel and Distributed Computing (ISPDC 2026)

AI.title_translation: 针对流水线并行LLM训练中通信感知评估的表格调度抽象
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种表格调度抽象和统一的多抽象方法，用于在考虑通信的情况下评估流水线并行LLM训练的不同调度策略。研究发现调度排名并非抽象不变，通信会影响调度性能，并比较了GPipe、1F1B、Chimera和Hanayo等调度策略在不同系统配置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 比较流水线调度策略非常困难：分析模型只揭示如气泡率等结构性指标，而端到端硬件实验成本高昂且具有系统特异性。
AI.method: 本文引入了一种表格调度抽象和统一的多抽象方法，将基于公式的推理、理想化调度表和通信感知执行模拟结合起来。利用这个框架，在多种建模系统配置下比较了GPipe、1F1B、Chimera和Hanayo等调度策略。
AI.result: 调度排名并非抽象不变，通信可以抵消单独气泡分析所建议的结构优势。在所考虑的假设下，GPipe和1F1B在运行时等效，但1F1B实现了更低的激活内存峰值。Chimera主要在微批次数量较少和通信有利的场景下具有优势，而Hanayo在其预期的受限操作点有效，但对网络瓶颈敏感。进一步研究了非对称Chimera式放置，它没有降低全局峰值内存需求，但在浅层流水线中显示出有限的运行时增益。
AI.conclusion: 流水线调度的质量只有在建模的执行环境下才有意义。
AI.translation:
流水线并行是大型语言模型分布式训练的关键技术，因为它减少了每设备的参数和激活内存。然而，比较流水线调度很困难：分析模型揭示了气泡率等结构性量，而端到端硬件实验成本高昂且具有系统特异性。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种表格调度抽象和一种统一的多抽象方法，它连接了基于公式的推理、理想化调度表和通信感知执行模拟。
利用这个框架，我们在多种建模系统配置下比较了GPipe、1F1B、Chimera和Hanayo在其受限方案中的表现。我们的结果表明，调度排名并非抽象不变：通信可以抵消单独气泡分析所建议的结构优势。在本文所考虑的假设下，GPipe和1F1B在运行时等效，但1F1B实现了更低的激活内存峰值。Chimera主要在微批次数量较少和通信有利的场景下具有优势，而Hanayo在其预期的受限操作点有效，但对网络瓶颈敏感。我们进一步研究了非对称Chimera式放置，它没有降低全局峰值内存需求，但在浅层流水线中显示出有限的运行时增益。总的来说，流水线调度的质量只有在建模的执行环境下才有意义。
AI.summary: 本文针对流水线并行大型语言模型训练，提出了一种表格调度抽象和统一的多抽象方法，以实现通信感知的调度策略评估。该框架结合了公式推理、理想化调度表和执行模拟，用于比较GPipe、1F1B、Chimera和Hanayo等主流调度策略。研究发现，调度策略的性能排名会受到通信开销的影响，并非抽象不变。具体而言，1F1B在内存效率上优于GPipe，Chimera在特定条件下表现良好，而Hanayo对网络瓶颈敏感。文章强调，流水线调度质量的评估必须结合具体的执行环境。
AI.keywords: 流水线并行, LLM训练, 调度抽象, 通信感知, 性能评估
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了表格调度抽象和统一的多抽象方法，为LLM流水线并行训练的调度评估提供了一个全面的框架，弥补了现有分析模型和硬件实验的不足。其对通信因素的强调以及在不同系统配置下对主流调度策略的详细比较，对于指导实际的大规模LLM训练具有重要意义。局限性可能在于其结果的有效性依赖于建模的准确性。

title: CAFD: Concept-Aware DNN Fault Detection using VLMs
summary: Fault detection for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) has received increasing attention in recent years. While more advanced hybrid approaches have been proposed to combine multiple sources of information and outperform earlier techniques, they often incur substantial computational overhead, limiting scalability and practicality in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD), a learning-based approach that achieves superior fault detection performance by effectively integrating multiple information sources while maintaining practical efficiency. Specifically, CAFD is trained using a carefully selected set of informative features, including model-based signals derived from the DNN's outputs, distance-based features, and a novel concept-based feature, called Concept Failure Ratio (CFR). CFR leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to extract textual concepts from images and quantify the likelihood that their presence is associated with DNN failures. By incorporating this feature, CAFD benefits from complementary semantic information, enabling more effective fault detection. Our results demonstrate that CFR serves as an effective indicator for DNN fault detection. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation of CAFD, comparing it against five state-of-the-art baselines across three subject DNN models and datasets, including ImageNet. Across a wide range of constrained selection budgets, CAFD consistently outperforms all baselines in Fault Detection Rate (FDR), achieving average FDR improvements of 18.3% across all investigated subjects and budget sizes.

AI.title_translation: CAFD：使用VLM进行概念感知DNN故障检测
AI.tldr: CAFD是一种新的学习方法，通过结合模型信号、距离特征和新颖的概念失败率（CFR）来有效检测DNN故障，CFR利用VLM提取概念。CAFD在故障检测率上优于现有基线，且计算效率高。
AI.motivation: 现有的DNN故障检测混合方法计算开销大，限制了其可扩展性和实用性。
AI.method: 本文引入了概念感知故障检测（CAFD），这是一种学习方法。CAFD结合了多种信息源，包括从DNN输出中提取的基于模型的信号、基于距离的特征，以及一种新颖的基于概念的特征——概念失败率（CFR）。CFR利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）从图像中提取文本概念，并量化这些概念的存在与DNN故障相关的可能性。
AI.result: 结果表明，概念失败率（CFR）可以作为DNN故障检测的有效指标。CAFD在故障检测率（FDR）上始终优于五种最先进的基线，在所有研究对象和预算规模上，平均FDR提高了18.3%。
AI.conclusion: CAFD通过有效整合多种信息源，特别是引入概念失败率（CFR）这一新颖的概念特征，实现了卓越的DNN故障检测性能，同时保持了实际效率。CFR被证明是DNN故障检测的有效指标。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络（DNNs）的故障检测近年来受到越来越多的关注。虽然已经提出了更先进的混合方法来结合多种信息源并超越早期的技术，但它们通常会产生大量的计算开销，限制了在实际环境中的可扩展性和实用性。在本文中，我们引入了概念感知故障检测（CAFD），这是一种基于学习的方法，通过有效整合多种信息源，同时保持实际效率，实现了卓越的故障检测性能。具体来说，CAFD使用一组精心选择的信息特征进行训练，包括从DNN输出中提取的基于模型的信号、基于距离的特征，以及一种新颖的基于概念的特征，称为概念失败率（CFR）。CFR利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）从图像中提取文本概念，并量化它们的存在与DNN故障相关的可能性。通过引入此特征，CAFD受益于互补的语义信息，从而实现更有效的故障检测。我们的结果表明，CFR可以作为DNN故障检测的有效指标。我们对CAFD进行了广泛的实证评估，将其与五种最先进的基线在三个主题DNN模型和数据集（包括ImageNet）上进行了比较。在各种受限选择预算下，CAFD在故障检测率（FDR）方面始终优于所有基线，在所有研究对象和预算规模上，平均FDR提高了18.3%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CAFD（概念感知故障检测）的学习方法，旨在解决现有DNN故障检测方法计算开销大且实用性受限的问题。CAFD通过有效整合模型信号、距离特征以及一种新颖的基于VLM的概念失败率（CFR）来提高故障检测性能。实验证明，CFR是DNN故障检测的有效指标，并且CAFD在故障检测率上显著优于现有基线，同时保持了计算效率。
AI.keywords: DNN故障检测, 概念感知, 视觉-语言模型, 概念失败率, CAFD
AI.comments: CAFD的创新之处在于引入了概念失败率（CFR），巧妙地利用了视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的语义理解能力来为DNN故障检测提供互补的高级语义信息。这不仅提升了故障检测性能，还解决了传统混合方法计算开销大的问题，使其在实际应用中更具可行性和实用性。

title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit remarkable action generation for embodied intelligence, but their heavy compute make deployment on edge platforms impractical. Aggressive, sub-4-bit weight quantization is the natural solution, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suffer severe performance degradation in this regime. To address this, we introduce ActQuant, an action-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework that operates in two stages: (1) an inter-tensor bit allocator that assigns each weight matrix a single bit-width based on how much it contributes to predicting the agent's actions; (2) an intra-tensor scale optimizer tunes per-block quantization scales using action-aware curvature, so that dynamic range is concentrated on the weights most influential for control. To deliver the on-device benefits of our aggressive quantization, we further introduce OmniModel.cpp, an agentic conversion pipeline that ports architectures into a native C/C++ runtime with efficient low-bit kernels. We evaluate ActQuant both in simulation and on a real-world 6-DoF UR3 arm, with all models deployed through OmniModel.cpp. On the LIBERO benchmark, ActQuant is the only method that operates at or below 3 bits-per-weight, retaining 95.0% on OpenVLA-OFT and 94.8% on $π_{0.5}$. Pushed further, ActQuant reaches 2.5 bpw at 90.1% on OpenVLA-OFT, compressing the backbone from 14.3 GB to 2.7 GB (5.3$\times$). On the physical UR3 arm, $π_{0.5}$ quantized with ActQuant retains the baseline's success rate while reducing the memory footprint by 2.5$\times$.

AI.title_translation: ActQuant：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的动作引导式4比特以下量化方法
AI.tldr: ActQuant通过利用动作预测信息指导量化过程，实现了VLA模型在超低比特（<4-bit）下的高效压缩与部署，显著降低了边缘设备的内存需求且几乎不损失性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型计算量巨大，难以部署在边缘设备上，而现有的后训练量化（PTQ）方法在低于4比特时性能下降严重。
AI.method: 提出ActQuant框架，包含两阶段：1. 基于动作预测贡献度的层间比特分配；2. 基于动作感知曲率的块内量化尺度优化。并配套OmniModel.cpp实现高效C/C++部署。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准测试中，ActQuant在3比特以下仍保持约95%的性能；在2.5比特下将模型压缩了5.3倍；在真实UR3机械臂上成功保持了基准成功率并减少了2.5倍内存占用。
AI.conclusion: ActQuant通过动作引导的混合精度量化策略，成功实现了VLA模型在小于4比特下的高效压缩，同时保持了极高的任务成功率，为具身智能模型在边缘设备的部署提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身智能领域展现出了卓越的动作生成能力，但其巨大的计算需求使得在边缘平台上的部署变得不切实际。激进的4比特以下权重量化是自然的解决方案，然而现有的后训练量化（PTQ）方法在此制度下性能下降严重。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ActQuant，这是一个动作引导的混合精度PTQ框架，分两个阶段运行：（1）层间比特分配器，根据每个权重矩阵对代理动作预测的贡献度为其分配位宽；（2）块内尺度优化器，利用动作感知曲率调整块级量化尺度，使动态范围集中在对控制影响最大的权重上。为了实现我们激进量化的端侧优势，我们进一步引入了OmniModel.cpp，这是一个将架构移植到具有高效低位内核的本地C/C++运行时的代理转换流水线。我们在模拟环境和真实世界的6自由度UR3机械臂上评估了ActQuant，所有模型均通过OmniModel.cpp部署。在LIBERO基准测试中，ActQuant是唯一一种在3比特/权重或以下运行的方法，在OpenVLA-OFT上保留了95.0%的性能，在π0.5上保留了94.8%的性能。进一步推演，ActQuant在OpenVLA-OFT上以2.5 bpw达到了90.1%的性能，将骨干网络从14.3 GB压缩至2.7 GB（5.3倍）。在物理UR3机械臂上，使用ActQuant量化的π0.5保留了基准的成功率，同时将内存占用减少了2.5倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ActQuant，一种针对VLA模型的动作引导混合精度后训练量化框架。该方法通过评估权重对动作预测的影响来动态分配比特位和优化量化尺度，结合高效的OmniModel.cpp运行环境，实现了在保持高任务性能的同时大幅压缩模型尺寸。
AI.keywords: 具身智能, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 模型量化, 边缘计算, 动作引导
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将“动作引导”引入量化过程，不仅关注权重本身，更关注权重对最终动作预测的影响，这是解决VLA模型超低比特量化性能下降的关键。此外，配套的OmniModel.cpp部署工具使得该方案具备了极高的落地价值。

title: Deep Learning-Based Automated Quantification of TIMI Myocardial Perfusion Frame Count (DL-TMPFC) from Coronary Angiography: A Novel Framework for Rapid Assessment of Microvascular Dysfunction
summary:
Aims: Coronary microvascular dysfunction (CMVD) affects approximately 40%-60% of patients with ischemia and non-obstructive coronary arteries, yet diagnosis remains challenging due to reliance on invasive functional testing or subjective Thrombolysis In Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) flow grade. The TIMI Myocardial Perfusion Frame Count (TMPFC) offers an objective, angiography-based quantitative measure of CMVD, but its clinical translation is hindered by cumbersome manual calculation and insufficient validation. This study aims to develop and validate a deep learning-powered TMPFC calculation (DL-TMPFC), enabling integration into clinical workflows.
  Methods and results: DL-TMPFC framework comprised two components. A stenosis detection network first excluded obstructive coronary artery disease (CAD). A territory-aware segmentation network then identified perfusion territories and TMPFC calculation module automatically determined the first and last frames from angiographic sequences. The framework was validated in a cohort of 655 patients (445 of obstructive CAD, 100 of confirmed CMVD, 110 of control group) from three independent institutions. DL-TMPFC showed excellent agreement with expert manual measurements (bias: -0.93 frames; 95% LoA: -5.33 to +3.47; r =0.98). DL-TMPFC markedly enhanced clinical feasibility by fully automating TMPFC and removing observer dependence. Clinically, DL-TMPFC accurately identified CMVD across a full spectrum of coronary pathologies and captured the continuous severity of CMVD beyond binary classification, enabling quantitative risk stratification.
  Conclusion: DL-TMPFC enabled automatic, standardized, and accurate quantification of CMVD directly from routine angiography. By providing an automatic and objective measure, this tool provided immediate diagnostic information for timely recognition and management of CMVD in clinical practice.

AI.title_translation: 基于深度学习的TIMI心肌灌注帧数（DL-TMPFC）冠状动脉造影自动量化：一种快速评估微血管功能障碍的新框架
AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于深度学习的TIMI心肌灌注帧数（DL-TMPFC）计算方法，实现了冠状动脉微血管功能障碍（CMVD）的自动化、标准化和准确量化，为临床诊断和管理提供了即时客观的工具。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉微血管功能障碍（CMVD）影响大量缺血且无阻塞性冠状动脉的患者，但其诊断因依赖侵入性功能测试或主观的TIMI血流分级而具有挑战性。TIMI心肌灌注帧数（TMPFC）提供了一种客观、基于血管造影的CMVD定量测量方法，但其临床转化受到繁琐的手动计算和验证不足的阻碍。本研究旨在开发和验证一种深度学习驱动的TMPFC计算（DL-TMPFC），以实现其在临床工作流程中的整合。
AI.method: DL-TMPFC框架包含两个主要组件。首先，一个狭窄检测网络用于排除阻塞性冠状动脉疾病（CAD）。其次，一个区域感知分割网络识别灌注区域，然后TMPFC计算模块自动确定血管造影序列中的第一帧和最后一帧。该框架在来自三个独立机构的655名患者（445名阻塞性CAD、100名确诊CMVD、110名对照组）队列中进行了验证。
AI.result: DL-TMPFC与专家手动测量显示出极好的一致性（偏差：-0.93帧；95%一致性界限：-5.33至+3.47；r =0.98）。DL-TMPFC通过完全自动化TMPFC并消除观察者依赖性，显著增强了临床可行性。在临床上，DL-TMPFC能够准确识别各种冠状动脉病理的CMVD，并捕捉到超越二元分类的CMVD连续严重程度，从而实现定量风险分层。
AI.conclusion: DL-TMPFC实现了直接从常规血管造影中对CMVD进行自动化、标准化和准确的量化。通过提供自动和客观的测量，该工具为临床实践中及时识别和管理CMVD提供了即时诊断信息。
AI.translation:
目的：冠状动脉微血管功能障碍（CMVD）影响约40%-60%的缺血且无阻塞性冠状动脉患者，但由于依赖侵入性功能测试或主观的TIMI（心肌梗死溶栓）血流分级，诊断仍然具有挑战性。TIMI心肌灌注帧数（TMPFC）提供了一种客观的、基于血管造影的CMVD定量测量方法，但其临床转化受到繁琐的手动计算和验证不足的阻碍。本研究旨在开发和验证一种深度学习驱动的TMPFC计算（DL-TMPFC），以实现其在临床工作流程中的整合。
方法和结果：DL-TMPFC框架包含两个组件。一个狭窄检测网络首先排除了阻塞性冠状动脉疾病（CAD）。然后，一个区域感知分割网络识别灌注区域，TMPFC计算模块自动确定血管造影序列中的第一帧和最后一帧。该框架在来自三个独立机构的655名患者（445名阻塞性CAD、100名确诊CMVD、110名对照组）队列中进行了验证。DL-TMPFC与专家手动测量显示出极好的一致性（偏差：-0.93帧；95%一致性界限：-5.33至+3.47；r =0.98）。DL-TMPFC通过完全自动化TMPFC并消除观察者依赖性，显著增强了临床可行性。在临床上，DL-TMPFC能够准确识别各种冠状动脉病理的CMVD，并捕捉到超越二元分类的CMVD连续严重程度，从而实现定量风险分层。
结论：DL-TMPFC实现了直接从常规血管造影中对CMVD进行自动化、标准化和准确的量化。通过提供自动和客观的测量，该工具为临床实践中及时识别和管理CMVD提供了即时诊断信息。
AI.summary: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于深度学习的TIMI心肌灌注帧数（DL-TMPFC）框架，旨在自动化和标准化冠状动脉微血管功能障碍（CMVD）的量化。该框架包含狭窄检测和区域感知分割网络，用于从冠状动脉造影中自动计算TMPFC。在包含655名患者的多中心队列中，DL-TMPFC显示出与专家手动测量高度一致的结果，并显著提高了临床可行性。它能准确识别CMVD并量化其严重程度，为CMVD的诊断和风险分层提供了快速、客观的工具。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, TIMI心肌灌注帧数, 冠状动脉微血管功能障碍, 冠状动脉造影, 自动化量化
AI.comments: 该研究通过深度学习自动化了TMPFC的计算，解决了现有方法手动繁琐和主观性强的问题，是CMVD诊断领域的一个重要创新。其多中心验证和与专家测量的高度一致性表明了该工具的潜力和可靠性。此方法有望显著提高CMVD的诊断效率和标准化程度，从而改善患者管理。

title: SkySeg: Collaborative Onboard Semantic Segmentation with Heterogeneous UAVs in the Wild
summary: The demand for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based image acquisition and analysis has surged, with UAVs increasingly utilized for semantic segmentation tasks. To meet the real-time analysis requirements of UAV remote sensing missions, performing onboard computation and making decisions based on the results is a natural approach. However, deploying semantic segmentation on resource-constrained UAV platforms presents two significant challenges: 1) hardware constraints limit the ability of UAVs to perform real-time semantic segmentation, and 2) environmental variations during flight cause data distribution shifts, deviating from the original training data. To address these issues, this paper introduces SkySeg, a heterogeneous multi-UAV air-air cooperation framework that integrates computer vision and flight pattern to enable onboard semantic segmentation using low-cost sensors. SkySeg employs an efficient information fusion inference method, combining low-definition, wide-area images with high-definition, focused-area images. Additionally, it incorporates a cross-device test-time adaptation (TTA) strategy to enhance segmentation performance in dynamic environments by collaboratively addressing distribution shifts of test data streams across UAVs. Experimental results demonstrate that our SkySeg framework accelerates inference latency by approximately 3.6x, improves onboard segmentation accuracy by 5.91\%, and achieves a 10.91\% average accuracy gain in the wild.

AI.title_translation: SkySeg：野外异构无人机协同机载语义分割
AI.tldr: SkySeg提出了一个异构多无人机空对空协作框架，通过信息融合和跨设备测试时自适应，解决了资源受限无人机平台上的实时语义分割挑战，显著提升了推理速度和分割精度。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的无人机平台上部署语义分割面临两大挑战：一是硬件限制导致难以进行实时语义分割；二是飞行中的环境变化导致数据分布偏移，与原始训练数据不符。
AI.method: 本文提出了SkySeg，一个异构多无人机空对空协作框架，集成了计算机视觉和飞行模式，利用低成本传感器实现机载语义分割。该方法采用高效的信息融合推理，结合低清广域图像和高清聚焦区域图像。此外，它还引入了跨设备测试时自适应（TTA）策略，通过协作解决无人机之间测试数据流的分布偏移，以增强动态环境中的分割性能。
AI.result: SkySeg框架将推理延迟加快了约3.6倍，将机载分割精度提高了5.91%，并在野外实现了10.91%的平均精度增益。
AI.conclusion: SkySeg通过其异构多无人机协作框架、高效信息融合和跨设备测试时自适应策略，成功解决了无人机机载实时语义分割的挑战，显著提升了性能。
AI.translation: 无人机（UAV）图像采集和分析的需求激增，无人机越来越多地用于语义分割任务。为了满足无人机遥感任务的实时分析要求，进行机载计算并根据结果做出决策是一种自然的方法。然而，在资源受限的无人机平台上部署语义分割面临两大挑战：1）硬件限制了无人机执行实时语义分割的能力；2）飞行期间的环境变化导致数据分布偏移，偏离了原始训练数据。为了解决这些问题，本文介绍了SkySeg，一个异构多无人机空对空协作框架，它集成了计算机视觉和飞行模式，以使用低成本传感器实现机载语义分割。SkySeg采用高效的信息融合推理方法，将低清晰度、广域图像与高清晰度、聚焦区域图像相结合。此外，它还引入了跨设备测试时自适应（TTA）策略，通过协作解决无人机之间测试数据流的分布偏移，以增强动态环境中的分割性能。实验结果表明，我们的SkySeg框架将推理延迟加快了约3.6倍，将机载分割精度提高了5.91%，并在野外实现了10.91%的平均精度增益。
AI.summary: SkySeg是一个针对资源受限无人机平台上的实时语义分割提出的异构多无人机空对空协作框架。它通过结合高效的信息融合推理方法（整合低清广域与高清聚焦图像）和跨设备测试时自适应（TTA）策略来解决硬件限制和数据分布偏移问题。实验证明，SkySeg显著提高了推理速度（3.6倍）和分割精度（机载5.91%，野外10.91%）。
AI.keywords: 无人机, 语义分割, 机载计算, 异构协作, 测试时自适应
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个将计算机视觉与飞行模式相结合的异构多无人机协作框架，有效地解决了无人机机载实时语义分割面临的硬件限制和环境动态变化导致的数据分布偏移问题。通过信息融合和跨设备TTA，SkySeg在实际应用中展现了显著的性能提升，对于推动无人机在复杂环境下的智能应用具有重要意义。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Learning for Graph Collaborative Filtering: Limitations and a Simple Remedy
summary: Graph collaborative filtering (GCF) is a dominant paradigm in recommender systems, where contrastive learning (CL) objectives such as the Sampled Softmax (SSM) loss are widely used for optimization. However, it remains unclear how CL interacts with the prediction mechanism of GCF. By unfolding the prediction mechanism of GCF, we show that the user-item prediction score is computed by aggregating learnable weights over a large number of neighbor pairs formed by the multi-hop neighbors of the user and the item. This analysis suggests that effective optimization critically depends on which neighbor pairs are upweighted during training. Empirically, we find that effective recommendation is achievable by selectively upweighting only a small subset of neighbor pairs whose constituent neighbors are structurally similar to the target user and item, and that the effect of such selective upweighting varies across different neighbor pair types. Based on these findings, we analyze SSM and identify key limitations in its neighbor pair weight update dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose NT-SSM, an effective and principled CL objective that induces type-aware neighbor pair weight update dynamics. Experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements over SSM across multiple datasets and GCF models.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考图协同过滤中的对比学习：局限性与一种简单的补救措施
AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了图协同过滤中对比学习的加权机制缺陷，并提出了NT-SSM算法以实现更精准的邻居对加权，从而提升推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 目前在图协同过滤（GCF）中广泛使用的对比学习目标函数（如SSM）与其预测机制之间的交互机制尚不明确，且在邻居对加权方面存在局限性。
AI.method: 通过拆解GCF预测机制，分析SSM在邻居对权重更新上的局限，提出了一种具有类型感知（type-aware）能力的对比学习目标函数NT-SSM。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和GCF模型上的实验表明，NT-SSM相比传统的SSM具有一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过引入NT-SSM，成功解决了传统对比学习在图协同过滤中邻居对权重更新不灵活的问题，显著提升了推荐性能。
AI.translation: 图协同过滤（GCF）是推荐系统中的主流范式，其中对比学习（CL）目标（如采样Softmax（SSM）损失）被广泛用于优化。然而，CL与GCF预测机制之间如何交互仍不清楚。通过拆解GCF的预测机制，我们展示了用户-物品预测分数是通过在大量由用户和物品的多跳邻居形成的邻居对上聚合可学习权重来计算的。这一分析表明，有效的优化关键取决于训练过程中哪些邻居对被加权。实证发现，通过仅选择性地加权一小部分结构上与目标用户和物品相似的邻居对，可以实现有效的推荐，且这种选择性加权的效果在不同邻居对类型间存在差异。基于这些发现，我们分析了SSM并确定了其在邻居对权重更新动态方面的关键局限。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了NT-SSM，这是一种有效且有原则的CL目标，能够诱导类型感知的邻居对权重更新动态。实验证明，在多个数据集和GCF模型上，该方法相比SSM均有持续的性能提升。
AI.summary: 该研究重新审视了图协同过滤中的对比学习，发现其核心在于如何有效加权多跳邻居对。通过识别采样Softmax（SSM）的局限，提出了类型感知对比学习目标NT-SSM，有效提升了推荐效果。
AI.keywords: 图协同过滤, 对比学习, 邻居加权, 推荐系统, NT-SSM
AI.comments: 该论文通过深入剖析图协同过滤（GCF）的预测机制，揭示了对比学习（CL）目标函数（如SSM）在处理邻居对加权方面的不足，并提出了针对性的改进方法，具有很强的理论深度和实践价值。

title: SA-Kura: An Energy-Efficient Systolic Array Accelerator for Locally-Coupled Kuramoto Drift in Diffusion Sampling
comments: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table; ACM/IEEE ISLPED 2026 accepted paper
summary: Diffusion inference remains costly for edge deployment, yet existing accelerators focus almost exclusively on score networks because standard drift is merely a trivial linear scaling. Kuramoto orientation diffusion replaces this trivial drift with locally coupled phase interactions, improving sampling efficiency but introducing a new hardware bottleneck: a center-dependent nonlinear 5 x 5 stencil evaluated at every reverse step. This kernel maps poorly to conventional CNN accelerators and matrix-oriented engines. We present SA-Kura, to our knowledge the first digital systolic-array accelerator dedicated to locally coupled Kuramoto drift. By reformulating pair-wise sinusoidal coupling into neighbor accumulation independent of the center phase followed by a single center-dependent multiply-subtract combination, SA-Kura eliminates in-PE transcendental units and enables regular systolic execution with register-level reuse. SA-Kura was implemented in synthesizable RTL, integrated into a lightweight RISC-V-based SoC, prototyped on FPGA, and evaluated through 45 nm CMOS synthesis and power analysis. For the drift kernel only, compared with software execution of the same kernel on the processor core in the same SoC platform, SA-Kura reduces latency and energy by 193x and 69.4x, respectively. Compared with a standalone Jetson Orin Nano CUDA implementation of the same kernel, it is 6.57x faster and achieves approximately 46.0x lower energy per pixel.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table; ACM/IEEE ISLPED 2026 accepted paper

AI.title_translation: SA-Kura：一种用于局部耦合的坂本龙一漂移的节能脉动阵列加速器
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为SA-Kura的新型数字脉动阵列加速器，专门用于加速扩散模型中的坂本龙一漂移计算。与传统的加速器不同，SA-Kura通过优化计算方法，显著提高了计算效率并降低了能耗，特别是在边缘设备部署方面。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型推理加速器主要关注得分网络，而忽略了标准漂移的计算瓶颈。然而，坂本龙一方向扩散模型引入了更复杂的、依赖于局部耦合相相互作用的漂移计算，这成为了硬件加速的新挑战。
AI.method: SA-Kura通过将成对的正弦耦合重新表述为与中心相位无关的邻域累加，然后进行一次中心依赖的乘减组合，从而消除了每个处理单元（PE）中的超越函数单元，并实现了具有寄存器级复用的规则脉动执行。该加速器采用可综合RTL实现，并集成到基于RISC-V的SoC中。
AI.result: 与同一SoC平台上的处理器核心软件执行相比，SA-Kura仅在漂移内核上就分别将延迟和能耗降低了193倍和69.4倍。与独立的Jetson Orin Nano CUDA实现相比，SA-Kura的速度提高了6.57倍，每像素能耗降低了约46.0倍。
AI.conclusion: SA-Kura是首个专门用于局部耦合坂本龙一漂移的数字脉动阵列加速器，它通过创新的计算方法有效解决了扩散模型推理中的硬件瓶颈，并在能效和性能方面取得了显著的改进，为在边缘设备上部署扩散模型提供了有力的支持。
AI.translation: 扩散推理对于边缘部署仍然成本高昂，但现有的加速器几乎完全专注于得分网络，因为标准漂移仅仅是平凡的线性缩放。坂本龙一方向扩散取代了这种平凡的漂移，采用了局部耦合的相相互作用，提高了采样效率，但引入了一个新的硬件瓶颈：在每个反向步骤中评估的、依赖于中心的非线性5x5模板。该内核与传统的CNN加速器和面向矩阵的引擎匹配不佳。我们提出了SA-Kura，据我们所知，这是第一个专门用于局部耦合坂本龙一漂移的数字脉动阵列加速器。通过将成对的正弦耦合重新表述为与中心相位无关的邻域累加，然后进行一次中心依赖的乘减组合，SA-Kura消除了PE中的超越函数单元，并实现了具有寄存器级复用的规则脉动执行。SA-Kura采用可综合RTL实现，集成到一个轻量级的基于RISC-V的SoC中，在FPGA上进行了原型验证，并通过45nm CMOS综合和功耗分析进行了评估。仅就漂移内核而言，与同一SoC平台上的处理器核心的相同内核软件执行相比，SA-Kura分别将延迟和能耗降低了193倍和69.4倍。与相同内核的独立Jetson Orin Nano CUDA实现相比，它的速度提高了6.57倍，并且实现了每像素约46.0倍的更低能耗。
AI.summary: SA-Kura是一种新颖的数字脉动阵列加速器，专门设计用于解决扩散模型中由局部耦合的坂本龙一漂移引起的计算瓶颈。该加速器通过重新设计计算方法，避免了昂贵的超越函数计算，实现了高效的脉动执行。实验结果表明，SA-Kura在延迟和能耗方面相较于软件和现有硬件方案均有显著优势，特别适合资源受限的边缘设备。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 坂本龙一漂移, 脉动阵列加速器, 边缘计算, 能效
AI.comments: 该研究解决了扩散模型在边缘部署中的一个关键硬件瓶颈问题。SA-Kura通过创新的算法优化和硬件架构设计，实现了显著的能效提升和性能加速，为在资源受限的边缘设备上运行复杂的扩散模型提供了有效的解决方案。其脉动阵列的设计也具有通用性，可能适用于其他类似计算模式的应用。

title: CMAX-CAMEL: A Coarse-to-Fine Adaptive, Memory-Efficient, and Low-Power Edge Processor for Contrast Maximization
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, tables; ACM/IEEE ISLPED 2026 accepted paper
summary: Contrast maximization (CMAX) is a direct geometric framework for event-based motion estimation, but its iterative warp-and-accumulate pipeline incurs input-dependent computation and frequent memory accesses, challenging real-time, low-power edge deployment. We present CMAX-CAMEL, a coarse-to-fine adaptive, memory-efficient, low-power edge processor for CMAX. CMAX-CAMEL combines a runtime-adaptive execution strategy with a memory-centric processor architecture. It adjusts coarse-to-fine execution according to the observed event distribution, prioritizing stages likely to improve estimation accuracy while suppressing low-value iterations and unnecessary stage transitions. Architecturally, a banked parallel memory organization sustains real-time throughput while reducing latency, and a subsampling-coupled accumulation structure lowers memory-access activity along the warp-and-accumulate dataflow. On a Virtex FPGA prototype operating at 200 MHz, CMAX-CAMEL improves estimation accuracy by up to 19% over fixed coarse-to-fine schedules, reduces processing latency by 53.3%, lowers effective memory accesses by 42%, and cuts total system energy by 52.2%, including adaptation overheads. These results show that CMAX-CAMEL is an HW-SW co-design that co-optimizes execution policy and data movement for real-time, low-power event-based motion estimation at the edge.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, tables; ACM/IEEE ISLPED 2026 accepted paper

AI.title_translation: CMAX-CAMEL：一种粗粒度到细粒度的自适应、内存高效、低功耗的对比度最大化边缘处理器
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为CMAX-CAMEL的处理器，用于事件驱动的运动估计中的对比度最大化（CMAX）。它通过自适应粗粒度到细粒度的执行策略和内存优化的架构，实现了更快的速度、更低的功耗和更高的精度，非常适合在边缘设备上进行实时低功耗应用。
AI.motivation: 事件驱动的运动估计中的对比度最大化（CMAX）由于其迭代计算和频繁的内存访问，在实时、低功耗的边缘设备上部署存在挑战。
AI.method: CMAX-CAMEL采用运行时自适应执行策略，根据事件分布调整粗粒度到细粒度的执行，并采用内存中心的设计，包括分块并行内存组织和子采样耦合累积结构，以减少内存访问。
AI.result: 在200 MHz的Virtex FPGA原型上，CMAX-CAMEL将估计精度提高了19%，处理延迟降低了53.3%，有效内存访问减少了42%，总系统能耗降低了52.2%。
AI.conclusion: CMAX-CAMEL是一种软硬件协同设计的解决方案，通过协同优化执行策略和数据移动，实现了实时、低功耗的事件驱动运动估计。
AI.translation: 对比度最大化（CMAX）是事件驱动运动估计的直接几何框架，但其迭代的变形和累积流水线会产生依赖于输入的计算和频繁的内存访问，这对实时、低功耗的边缘部署提出了挑战。我们提出了CMAX-CAMEL，一种用于CMAX的粗粒度到细粒度的自适应、内存高效、低功耗边缘处理器。CMAX-CAMEL结合了运行时自适应执行策略和以内存为中心的处理器架构。它根据观察到的事件分布调整粗粒度到细粒度的执行，优先处理可能提高估计精度的阶段，同时抑制低价值的迭代和不必要的阶段转换。在架构上，分块并行内存组织支持实时吞吐量，同时降低延迟，而子采样耦合累积结构则沿着变形和累积数据流降低了内存访问活动。在运行在200 MHz的Virtex FPGA原型上，CMAX-CAMEL相比固定的粗粒度到细粒度调度，将估计精度提高了高达19%，处理延迟降低了53.3%，有效内存访问减少了42%，并削减了总系统能耗52.2%（包括自适应开销）。这些结果表明，CMAX-CAMEL是一种软硬件协同设计的解决方案，它协同优化执行策略和数据移动，以实现边缘的实时、低功耗事件驱动运动估计。
AI.summary: CMAX-CAMEL 是一种专为事件驱动运动估计中的对比度最大化（CMAX）设计的边缘处理器。它通过结合自适应的粗粒度到细粒度执行策略和内存优化的架构，解决了传统 CMAX 方法在实时性和功耗方面的挑战。该处理器能够根据事件分布动态调整计算，优先处理关键阶段，并减少不必要的内存访问。实验结果表明，CMAX-CAMEL 在精度、延迟和能耗方面均取得了显著的改进，非常适合资源受限的边缘设备。
AI.keywords: 对比度最大化, 事件驱动运动估计, 边缘处理器, CMAX-CAMEL, 自适应执行
AI.comments: 该研究成功地为事件驱动的运动估计中的对比度最大化问题设计了一个高效的边缘处理器。其自适应执行策略和内存优化的架构是该设计的关键创新点，有效地解决了实时性和低功耗的挑战。未来的工作可以探索该处理器在更复杂的场景和不同类型的事件传感器上的应用。

title: EvoSci: A Bio-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for the Evolution of Scientific Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs), have shown strong potential in scientific discovery, yet existing methods still face substantial challenges in the design of research workflows and multi-role collaboration mechanisms. To mitigate these issues, we propose EvoSci, a multi-agent scientific collaboration framework, which integrates bio-inspired evolution with knowledge graph modeling. To iteratively generate, evaluate, and refine research ideas, EvoSci incorporates multiple role-based agents, including mentor, researcher, and reviewer. By combining collaborative reasoning, shared memory, and evolutionary feedback, EvoSci significantly enhances the coherence and creativity of scientific exploration. Experiments on real-world research topics demonstrate that EvoSci significantly outperforms strong baselines in LLM-based structured peer-review and comparative ranking evaluations, achieving the highest overall peer-review score (ICLR 4.90) and top ranking (Top-10 = 54). These results suggest its superiority in both scientific idea generation and continuous discovery.

AI.title_translation: EvoSci：一种用于科学发现演进的生物启发式多智能体框架
AI.tldr: EvoSci通过结合生物进化机制与多智能体协作，显著提升了大语言模型在科学创意生成和研究工作流设计中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的科学发现方法在设计研究工作流和多角色协作机制方面仍面临显著挑战，需要更高效的框架来提升科学探索的连贯性和创造力。
AI.method: 提出了EvoSci框架，该框架采用多角色智能体（导师、研究员、审稿人），结合了生物启发式进化、知识图谱建模、协作推理、共享记忆以及进化反馈机制。
AI.result: 在真实科研课题的实验中，EvoSci显著优于强基线模型，在结构化同行评审中获得了最高评分（ICLR 4.90），并在Top-10排名中达到54次，证明了其在科学创意生成和持续发现方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: EvoSci 框架通过集成生物启发式进化和多智能体协作，在科学创意生成和持续发现方面表现出显著优势，优于现有的LLM基准模型。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在科学发现中展现出巨大潜力，但现有方法在研究工作流设计和多角色协作机制方面仍面临重大挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了EvoSci，这是一个集成了生物启发式进化与知识图谱建模的多智能体科学协作框架。为了迭代生成、评估和完善研究想法，EvoSci纳入了多个基于角色的智能体，包括导师、研究员和审稿人。通过结合协作推理、共享记忆和进化反馈，EvoSci显著增强了科学探索的连贯性和创造力。在真实科研课题上的实验表明，EvoSci在基于LLM的结构化同行评审和比较排名评估中显著优于强基线模型，获得了最高的同行评审总分（ICLR 4.90）和最高排名（Top-10 = 54）。这些结果表明其在科学想法生成和持续发现方面具有优越性。
AI.summary: EvoSci是一个旨在优化科学发现流程的多智能体框架。它通过整合生物启发式进化与知识图谱，利用导师、研究员和审稿人等角色进行迭代式想法生成与评估，有效提升了科研协作的创造力与连贯性。实验证明，该框架在科学创意生成任务中具有卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 科学发现, 多智能体系统, 生物启发式进化, 知识图谱
AI.comments: EvoSci的创新之处在于将生物启发式进化机制与知识图谱建模相结合，引入了多智能体协作框架来模拟科研流程。这种方法不仅改善了科研工作流的设计，还通过多角色互动（导师、研究员、审稿人）增强了科学探索的连贯性和创造力。其局限性可能在于对复杂科学领域深度知识的长期推理能力仍需进一步验证。

title: MGVQ: Synergizing Multi-dimensional Sensitivity-Aware and Gradient-Hessian Fusion for Vector Quantization
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance, yet their huge model size severely hinders deployment on edge devices with limited resources. As an efficient model compression technique, vector quantization (VQ) excels in ultra-low-bit representation, which maps model weights to discrete codewords in a compact codebook to cut memory consumption and transmission overhead while preserving model capability. Direct VQ application to VLMs still has two core limitations. First, cross-modality weight distribution differences brought by visual and textual inputs cannot be well fitted by a single unified codebook. Second, current second-order error compensation ignores first-order gradient information, causing weight deviation from pre-trained optimal states, gradient drift and biased compensation results. This work proposes MGVQ, a novel vector quantization framework integrating multi-dimensional sensitivity perception and gradient-Hessian fusion. It consists of two core modules: sensitivity-guided structured mixed-precision quantization dynamically assigns different bit-widths according to channel sensitivity via combined global and local sensitivity analysis for refined resource allocation; gradient-aware second-order error compensation embeds first-order gradients into error correction, and adopts Kronecker and Block-LDL decomposition to ensure low computational cost. Extensive experiments on mainstream VLMs including LLaVA-onevision, InternVL2 and Qwen2-VL verify the effectiveness of MGVQ. In 2-bit quantization settings, MGVQ surpasses existing advanced post-training quantization methods significantly, achieving a maximum accuracy improvement of 4.9 points (71.4% vs 67.0% on InternVL2-26B). The proposed method realizes stable and efficient ultra-low-bit VLM quantization, greatly promoting the practical deployment of multimodal large models in resource-limited environments.

AI.title_translation: MGVQ：面向向量量化的多维敏感性感知与梯度-Hessian融合协同机制
AI.tldr: MGVQ是一种针对视觉语言模型的超低比特量化框架，通过动态敏感性感知和梯度-Hessian优化，在保持模型精度的同时大幅压缩了模型体积，促进了多模态大模型在边缘侧的部署。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）模型规模巨大，难以在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。现有的向量量化（VQ）方法在应用于VLM时存在局限：单一码本无法适配跨模态权重分布，且现有的二阶误差补偿忽略了一阶梯度信息，导致权重偏离预训练最优状态。
AI.method: 提出了MGVQ框架，包含两个核心模块：1. 敏感性引导的结构化混合精度量化，通过全局和局部敏感性分析动态分配位宽；2. 梯度感知二阶误差补偿，将一阶梯度嵌入误差校正，并利用Kronecker和Block-LDL分解降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-onevision、InternVL2和Qwen2-VL等主流VLM上进行了验证。在2-bit量化设置下，MGVQ显著优于现有的先进后训练量化方法，在InternVL2-26B模型上实现了最高4.9个百分点的精度提升（71.4% vs 67.0%）。
AI.conclusion: MGVQ通过敏感性感知量化与梯度-Hessian融合误差补偿，实现了高效的VLM超低比特量化，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低了存储和计算开销，为多模态大模型的边缘部署提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）取得了出色的性能，但其巨大的模型规模严重阻碍了其在资源受限的边缘设备上的部署。作为一种高效的模型压缩技术，向量量化（VQ）在超低比特表示方面表现出色，它将模型权重映射到紧凑码本中的离散码字，从而在保持模型能力的同时减少了内存消耗和传输开销。将VQ直接应用于VLM仍存在两个核心限制。首先，视觉和文本输入带来的跨模态权重分布差异无法通过单一统一的码本很好地拟合。其次，当前的二阶误差补偿忽略了一阶梯度信息，导致权重偏离预训练的最优状态、梯度漂移和有偏的补偿结果。本文提出了MGVQ，这是一个集成了多维敏感性感知和梯度-Hessian融合的新型向量量化框架。它由两个核心模块组成：敏感性引导的结构化混合精度量化通过结合全局和局部敏感性分析，根据通道敏感性动态分配不同的位宽，以实现精细的资源分配；梯度感知的二阶误差补偿将一阶梯度嵌入到误差校正中，并采用Kronecker和Block-LDL分解来确保低计算成本。在包括LLaVA-onevision、InternVL2和Qwen2-VL在内的主流VLM上的大量实验验证了MGVQ的有效性。在2-bit量化设置下，MGVQ显著超越了现有的先进后训练量化方法，最高实现了4.9个百分点的精度提升（在InternVL2-26B上为71.4% vs 67.0%）。该方法实现了稳定且高效的超低比特VLM量化，极大地促进了多模态大模型在资源受限环境中的实际部署。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MGVQ框架，旨在解决VLM在边缘设备上的超低比特向量量化问题。通过引入多维敏感性感知以动态分配位宽，并结合梯度-Hessian融合技术进行误差补偿，MGVQ在克服跨模态权重差异和二阶补偿缺陷的同时，实现了模型性能与效率的平衡。实验证明该方法在2-bit量化下表现优异。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 向量量化, 模型压缩, 敏感性分析, 梯度-Hessian融合
AI.comments: 该论文针对多模态大模型（VLM）在边缘设备部署困难的问题，提出了MGVQ框架。其创新点在于结合了多维敏感性分析和梯度-Hessian融合的误差补偿，有效解决了单一码本难以适应跨模态权重分布以及传统二阶补偿忽略一阶梯度信息的问题。在2-bit极端量化场景下表现出色，具有很高的工程应用价值。

title: Machine Intelligence that Understands Visual and Linguistic Information and Interacts with Humans and Environments
comments: Doctoral dissertation, Tohoku University, 2022. Uploaded for archival purposes. 146 pages
summary:
Advancements at the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing are crucial for applications like assistive tech, multimedia querying, and robotics. This dissertation proposes novel architectures to improve intelligent agents across three key vision-language tasks: image captioning, visual dialog, and interactive instruction following.
  First, we address limitations in visual representation for image captioning. Traditional models rely on region-based features from CNN detectors, which lack global context and suffer from high computational overhead. We propose GRIT (Grid and Region-based Image captioning Transformer), a transformer-only architecture. By integrating grid and region features using a DETR-based detector, GRIT enables end-to-end training and out-performs prior methods in both inference accuracy and speed.
  Second, we tackle visual dialog, which requires multi-turn conversation about an image. The challenge lies in efficiently modeling interactions between multiple inputs (image, question, history). We introduce LTMI (Light-weight Transformer for Many Inputs). Utilizing a specialized attention block, an LTMI layer matches the representational power of a standard Transformer extension while utilizing less than one-tenth of its parameters, as validated on the VisDial dataset.
  Finally, we study interactive instruction-following for embodied AI using the ALFRED dataset. We propose a framework featuring a two-stage instruction interpretation: it first decodes language directives independently of visual context to predict a tentative action-object sequence, which is then fused with visual features for final execution. Using multiple egocentric views and hierarchical attention, our method accurately localizes objects and achieves a state-of-the-art unseen success rate of 8.37%.

title: Extending the (Elementary) Mathematical Data Model and MatBase with two new constraint types: inexistence and anti-existence
comments: Submitted to the Primera Scientific Engineering J., Denton, TX, on 5/20/2026
summary: This research paper introduces two new constraint types and four subtypes of database constraints added to our (Elementary) Mathematical Data Model, which are the duals of the existence and non-existence ones. They are formally defined, characterized, and exemplified with real-life instances. The well-formedness, satisfiability, coherence, and minimality of sets of all 7 subtypes of existence constraints are studied. Corresponding SQL-embedded pseudocode algorithms for managing such sets are provided and proved to be of constant complexity, sound, complete, and optimal. Also provided are algorithms for enforcing these new types of constraints, called inexistence and anti-existence. Their characterization proves that they have linear complexity in the sum of the arities of the function (Cartesian product)s involved, and are sound, complete, and optimal as well. All these algorithms were implemented in both versions of our intelligent data and knowledge base management system prototype MatBase, which automatically generates code for enforcing all the 7 subtypes of existence constraints.
comment: Submitted to the Primera Scientific Engineering J., Denton, TX, on 5/20/2026

title: Adaptive KV Cache Reuse for Fast Long-Context LLM Serving
summary:
In long-context Large Language Model (LLM) inference, the Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency incurred by the prefill stage has become the foremost bottleneck limiting interactive performance and deployment cost. KV Cache reuse offers a direct path to reduce redundant prefill, yet traditional prefix caching applies only to strict-prefix scenarios; directly reusing KV Cache in non-prefix settings breaks the cross-chunk global attention relationships and causes significant degradation in generation quality. When reusable KV Cache is offloaded to GPU-external cache pools, I/O overheads across heterogeneous hardware tiers further emerge as a new TTFT bottleneck. Efficient non-prefix KV Cache reuse therefore requires both semantic-consistency recovery and compute-I/O co-optimization.
  This paper presents CacheTune, a frequency-guided and hardware-aware KV Cache reuse system for long-context LLM serving. CacheTune first identifies, offline, the KV pairs most critical to cross-attention recovery through frequency-domain analysis, and then selectively recomputes only these semantic-critical tokens online while reusing the remaining KVs. To turn this semantic selection into end-to-end latency reduction, CacheTune further combines sparse KV transfer, multi-stream asynchronous overlap, deferred positional-encoding recovery, and hardware-aware adaptive recomputation-ratio tuning to balance computation and data movement across heterogeneous cache pools. Evaluations on mainstream LLMs and long-context tasks show that CacheTune achieves 3.72x-4.86x TTFT speedup and 3.93x-6.21x higher throughput while maintaining generation quality close to full recompute. Even when caches are offloaded to I/O-bound SSD/HDD storage, CacheTune sustains 2.34x-2.36x TTFT speedup through adaptive recomputation.

title: Soft Tuy-Completeness for Robust Projection Selection in Cone-Beam CT
summary:
This work introduces a continuous soft near-orthogonality score and a resolution-aware saturated coverage objective for projection selection in region-of-interest focused cone-beam CT, grounded in Tuy's completeness theory. Replacing the binary hit-or-miss model of classical Tuy completeness with a graded, differentiable formulation preserves a direct link to achievable feature sizes while enabling both efficient approximate and exact optimisation.
  We establish that the underlying discrete decision problems are NP-complete via polynomial-time reductions from Set Cover, motivating a submodular greedy algorithm with proven $(1-1/\mathrm{e})$ approximation guarantees and a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) that provides certified optimality bounds. The MILP serves as a quality certificate for the greedy solution rather than a competing optimiser.
  The primary empirical finding confirms this relationship: across a systematic benchmark spanning six target regions, multiple projection budgets, and four controlled occlusion conditions, the pooled median greedy-to-MILP objective ratio was 0.998, with a substantial fraction of cases certified globally optimal. A binary formulation is included as a diagnostic baseline; it strengthens hard directional completeness but is weaker on the continuous coverage scale.
  We additionally introduce Effective Spatial Resolution (ESR), a physically interpretable trajectory-level diagnostic that maps directional sampling gaps to achievable feature sizes. ESR correlates reliably with matched reconstruction quality across projection budgets and occlusion levels, providing a practical bridge between the selection stage and the image domain without requiring reconstruction.

title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Causal Route Gating
comments: Accepted as a Spotlight Paper at ICML 2026. 33 pages, 8 figures
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate content that is fluent yet unsupported by the image, limiting their reliability in real-world deployment. We show that a key failure mode arises from route competition: even when visual tokens receive attention, the final token decision can be dominated by the textual pathway, causing the decoder to follow linguistic priors over visual evidence. To mitigate this, we propose a training-free, decision-aligned intervention that decomposes each attention head into a visual route and a text route, and estimates their token-level effects using an efficient one-forward/one-gradient approximation. These estimates reveal route conflict within heads and identify prior-dominant ones, enabling selective suppression of only the text route while keeping the visual route intact. Across five benchmarks spanning discriminative and generative settings, our method consistently reduces hallucination-related errors across models with limited impact on overall multimodal performance, while incurring a modest inference-time overhead.
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight Paper at ICML 2026. 33 pages, 8 figures

title: Towards Large Model Feature Coding
summary: Large models have delivered remarkable performance across a wide range of perception and generation tasks, yet practical deployment is increasingly constrained by computational and memory budgets, as well as privacy requirements. Split execution alleviates these constraints by partitioning computation across devices, but it inevitably introduces intensive transmission and storage of intermediate features. Unlike conventional feature coding for CNNs that typically targets homogeneous spatial activation maps, modern large models generate heterogeneous features with varying statistical distributions and compression tolerances, e.g., multi-level/multi-modal representations and autoregressive context caches. These characteristics necessitate treating large model feature coding (LaMoFC) as a fundamental system component and call for a systematic evaluation framework. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark and evaluation framework for LaMoFC. We first build the feature dataset LaMoFCBench, covering diverse task requirements across 4 categories and 16 scenarios while integrating widelyadopted architectures and various split-computing settings. We then specify representative split points according to practical application scenarios to extract intermediate features, establishing a unified pipeline for fair and reproducible comparisons. Finally, we benchmark mainstream universal feature codecs, exposing the profound misalignment between existing coding paradigms and the heterogeneous nature of large model features. These findings reveal that LaMoFC demands a fundamental departure from existing paradigms, and LaMoFCBench provides the shared empirical foundation to drive this transition. The data and code will be available at https://github.com/lartpang/LaMoFCBench.

title: A Per-Access Upper Bound for Shared-Resource Interference in Direct-Mapped Multicore Architectures
summary: We present a formal bounding analysis for maximum credible interference in multicore processors under strict architectural invariants: direct-mapped L2 cache (1-way associativity), disabled Miss Status Handling Registers (MSHRs), single-bank main memory, deterministic pinned tasks with fixed physical memory mapping, and a pessimistic L2/memory arbitration policy. We prove that, under these invariants, the per-critical-access stall imposed on a target task T is bounded above by (N-1)Lmem, and that this bound is attained by a synchronized adversarial workload of N-1 congruent-different-tag memory requests issued in phase with T's critical accesses. The argument is per-access and direct, requiring no informal multiplicative interference function. The derivation is purely analytical and discussed in the context of DO-178C/CAST-32A certification objectives for airborne software. Limitations and conditions for applicability are explicitly stated. This work provides a traceable method for separating multicore interference from Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET) budgets under fixed architectural constraints.

title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often identifies circuits inside Transformer models, but explanations of those circuits are usually validated through examples, ablations, and manual reasoning. This leaves a gap between finding a plausible circuit and proving what the circuit does. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for converting task-localized Transformer circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims. Given a behavior, a finite task domain, and a candidate-token projection, we extract a task circuit and verify properties such as projected functional equivalence, edge necessity, task-relevant invariance, and final-residual robustness. Direct verification encodes the extracted circuit itself into an SMT solver. When a circuit contains operators that are not exactly or tractably encodable, surrogate-mediated verification fits an SMT-encodable surrogate, validates it against the extracted circuit over the bounded domain, and verifies symbolic explanations against the surrogate. We instantiate direct verification with a GPT-style architecture using Signed L1 BandNorm, sparsemax attention, and LeakyReLU. On small symbolic sequence tasks, we train an SMT-representable Transformer, extract sparse circuits for quote closing and bracket type tracking, and exhaustively verify projected functional equivalence, content invariance, edge necessity, and final-residual robustness. At GPT-2 scale, the same operator stack trains stably on OpenWebText, although naive direct SMT verification remains intractable. We also demonstrate surrogate-mediated verification on task-localized circuits with hard-to-encode attention, showing both verified symbolic explanations and solver-generated counterexamples. The goal is not full-model verification, but a concrete path for turning mechanistic circuit explanations into formal propositions that can be proven or refuted.

title: Intent-Driven Computing: A Computational Model for Governed Autonomous Systems
comments: 18 pages, 6 theorems, 2 tables, 3 figures. Companion proofs: https://github.com/mashin-live/governance-proofs. Project: https://mashin.live
summary: Programming languages assume programs directly execute effects. When autonomous systems generate behavior dynamically, this assumption becomes problematic: there is no structural mediation point between deciding to act and acting. We define intent-driven computing: a programming model where programs produce intents (finite data values describing proposed actions) rather than directly executing effects. A governed runtime examines each intent against a decidable policy language, records every decision in a tamper-evident ledger, and only then realizes the effect. The language provides no alternative path to effects. The model does not decide arbitrary behavioral properties of programs (which Rice's theorem shows is impossible). Instead, it constrains the language so that all effectful interaction is reified as finite intent values, shifting governance from the undecidable domain of program semantics to the decidable domain of intent data. This yields emergent properties: event sourcing by construction, governance simulation via intent replay, structural audit completeness, and improved human comprehensibility. We specify the model formally, implement it in a concrete language compiling to the BEAM virtual machine, and verify key properties in Rocq (454 theorems, 36 modules, zero admitted lemmas). Property-based testing (70,000+ random inputs, zero disagreements) validates that the implementation matches the specification.

title: Mode-as-Sequence: Translating Multimodal Motion Prediction into Unified Sequential Mode Modeling
summary: Multimodal motion forecasting is inherently under-supervised: each training scene provides only one realized future, yet multiple plausible futures exist. This sparse supervision often leads to mode collapse (redundant hypotheses and insufficient mode coverage) and unreliable confidence ranking when predicting a small set of trajectories. We propose Mode-as-Sequence, a unified decoding framework that translates an unordered mode set into an ordered mode sequence and explicitly models mode-to-mode dependency. Under this framework, we develop two complementary instantiations. ModeSeq performs recurrent mode decoding, where each mode is generated conditioned on the previously generated modes, encouraging diverse, non-redundant hypotheses with calibrated confidence ordering. To remove the mode-by-mode autoregressive bottleneck, we further propose Parallel ModeSeq, which preserves the same causal dependency using masked mode-to-mode self-attention while decoding all modes in a single forward pass, enabling efficient large-$K$ inference and scalable joint-scene prediction. To learn representative modes and calibrated confidence under sparse labels, we introduce Early-Match-Take-All (EMTA) and its joint-scene extension MA-EMTA, together with a lightweight ranking regularizer that reduces confidence inversions. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in both ranking-oriented metrics and best-of-K accuracy across datasets, horizons, and object types. In the Waymo Open Dataset challenges, ModeSeq achieves 1st place in the 2024 LiDAR-free motion prediction track, and Parallel ModeSeq achieves 1st place in the 2025 Interaction Prediction Challenge, validating the effectiveness of Mode-as-Sequence for both accuracy and efficiency.

title: Learning to See Like Humans: Gaze-Aligned Cycling Safety Prediction
comments: Accepted to be published as part of the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Cycling delivers significant public-health and environmental benefits, yet its uptake in cities is often limited by perceived safety. When street environments appear unsafe, individuals are less likely to cycle, making perception a key barrier to adoption. Recent work has shown that pairwise comparisons of street-view images provide a scalable way to learn subjective safety judgments. However, existing approaches do not explicitly model human visual attention, which plays a central role in how humans perceive safety. We propose an Eye-Tracking-Guided Perceived Cycling Safety framework (EG-PCS) that integrates gaze data into a pairwise learning pipeline based on vision transformers. By supervising the model's attention mechanism with eye-tracking signals, we encourage alignment between learned attention maps and human fixation patterns. Experiments show that gaze-guided models achieve similar ranking performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches while producing attention maps that more accurately reflect human visual attention behavior. Our results demonstrate that incorporating eye-tracking information enhances both predictive accuracy and interpretability in perception-based urban analytics.

title: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation
comments: 47 pages; accepted to ICML 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator
