Furthermore, to address the data scarcity in multi-style texture reconstruction, we construct CANVAS, the first comprehensive paired texture reconstruction dataset covering realistic and diverse stylized domains.
  To the best of our knowledge, OMGTex is the first geometry-free inference framework that achieves robust, style-consistent, and editable facial texture reconstruction across diverse domains. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple facial texture benchmarks.

title: Double Triangle Annotation: A Scalable Human-in-the-Loop Framework for High-Precision Historical Document Annotation
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures. ACL ARR 2026 March submission
summary: Evaluating structured-information extraction from historical documents at scale requires high-precision ground-truth annotations, yet traditional manual labeling is expensive and fully automated pipelines built on large language models are prone to hallucination. We propose Double Triangle Annotation, a two-layer human-in-the-loop framework that leverages cross-model consensus to automate the majority of annotation work while ensuring high-precision outputs. In the first layer, two architecturally independent Multimodal Large Language Models annotate each document in parallel; when they agree, the label is auto-accepted, and disagreements are routed to a human jury. A second layer cross-checks two such systems against each other, escalating residual conflicts to a domain expert. The framework rests on a single assumption -- error independence between models -- requires no distributional priors or task-specific calibration, and becomes more autonomous as model capability improves. On the Guides Rosenwald, a corpus of French medical directories spanning 1887-1906, the framework achieves a final Word Error Rate of 0.003. Applied at scale, model consensus auto-accepts over 85% of 13,595 fields. We release the resulting benchmark -- the first structured-extraction ground truth for the Rosenwald Guides -- to support future work on historical document processing.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. ACL ARR 2026 March submission

title: ParkourFormer: Integrating Predictive Supervision and Sequence Modeling into Parkour Locomotion
summary: Humanoid parkour requires locomotion policies to coordinate whole-body dynamics across rapidly changing terrains such as stairs, gaps, slopes, and obstacles. Existing reinforcement learning policies are largely reactive, mapping observations directly to actions without explicitly modeling future body states. Such modeling becomes critical in agile locomotion tasks where successful motion execution depends strongly on anticipating upcoming contact transitions and body dynamics.We present ParkourFormer, a Transformer-based sequence modeling framework that reformulates humanoid locomotion as a future-conditioned decision-making problem. The current robot state queries historical sensorimotor trajectories through cross-attention, while a lightweight prediction head forecasts short-horizon future proprioceptive states. The predicted future states, trained with supervised signals, are fused with temporal features to generate actions, enabling the policy to jointly reason over motion history and anticipated future dynamics. We evaluate ParkourFormer on a diverse multi-terrain humanoid parkour benchmark including stairs, gaps, slopes, rough terrain, and obstacle traversal. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot show that ParkourFormer achieves a 93.85% average traversal success rate on highly challenging terrains, with improvements of up to 42.73% over strong MLP, MoE-based MLP, and vanilla Transformer baselines, while maintaining a single unified policy across all terrain types. These results demonstrate that explicit future-state modeling significantly improves robustness and generalization for agile whole-body locomotion.

title: VertiCue-Bench: Diagnosing Whether MLLMs Use Height Cues to Resolve 2D Ambiguity in Remote Sensing Natural Scenes
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently shown promising progress in geospatial reasoning. However, existing remote sensing benchmarks remain largely 2D-centric, evaluating models primarily on optical appearance. In natural environments, this paradigm breaks down due to severe spectral confusion, where ecologically distinct regions share similar textures but differ fundamentally in vertical structure. In such cases, explicit 3D structural data, such as Canopy Height Models (CHMs), become essential geometric evidence for semantic disambiguation. Yet, it remains unclear whether current MLLMs can genuinely leverage vertical cues to resolve appearance-level ambiguity. To address this gap, we introduce VertiCue-Bench, the first diagnostic benchmark for CHM-grounded geospatial reasoning. VertiCue-Bench comprises 1,534 carefully curated instances across 17 tasks, explicitly disentangling low-level height perception from ambiguity-aware semantic reasoning. Evaluations on 14 state-of-the-art general and remote-sensing-specialized MLLMs, combined with counterfactual modality testing, reveal a striking perception-reasoning dissociation. While models exhibit emerging competence in reading raw CHM height cues, they largely fail to translate geometric perception into reliable semantic reasoning, often underperforming RGB-only baselines when joint constraints are required. Overall, VertiCue-Bench exposes a critical geometry-to-semantics gap in natural scene understanding, offering actionable insights for advancing geospatial MLLMs.

title: A Scalable Benchmark Test Suite for Dynamic Multi-Objective Optimization with a Changing Number of Objectives
summary: Dynamic multi-objective optimization with a changing number of objectives has recently attracted increasing attention due to its relevance to real-world problems whose evaluation criteria may evolve over time. However, existing benchmark test suites for this problem setting suffer from a fundamental limitation: when the number of objectives changes, the objective functions themselves also change implicitly. This makes it difficult to isolate and evaluate an algorithm's capability to handle dynamics in the number of objectives alone. In this paper, we analyze this issue in detail and show that several theoretical properties claimed in prior studies rely on an assumption that is violated by commonly used test suites. To address this problem, we propose a scalable benchmark test suite in which the objective functions are fixed throughout the optimization process, while the number of active objectives changes over time. Our benchmark is constructed by defining a maximum-objective problem and dynamically selecting subsets of objectives. To avoid degeneracy issues in classical DTLZ and WFG problems, we adopt Minus-DTLZ and Minus-WFG formulations, in which all objectives are mutually conflicting. Extensive benchmark studies using representative algorithms from the literature demonstrate the usefulness and flexibility of the proposed test suite.

title: NPSolver: Neural Poisson Solver with Iterative Physics Supervision
summary: Efficiently solving Poisson equations on complex, irregular domains remains a fundamental challenge in scientific computing, as classical iterative solvers often suffer from prohibitive runtime due to ill-conditioned systems. While neural operators offer a fast alternative, they typically rely on large-scale labeled datasets or struggle with unstable training dynamics when using physics-informed residual losses. We propose \textsc{NPSolver}, a neural Poisson solver trained without solution labels via iterative physics supervision. Instead of relying on fully converged numerical solutions or raw PDE residuals, \textsc{NPSolver} utilizes a small number of preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) steps to refine its own predictions, providing a more stable and well-scaled training signal. Theoretical analysis confirms that this iterative supervision serves as a well-conditioned error proxy and that a stop-gradient design is essential for optimization stability. To better capture boundary-driven features under mixed boundary conditions, we further introduce the Boundary-Aware Transolver (\textsc{BA-Transolver}) architecture that explicitly separates interior and boundary tokenization. Extensive evaluations on 2D and 3D irregular geometries demonstrate that \textsc{NPSolver} outperforms both physics-informed and data-driven baselines. Furthermore, a downstream thermal control task highlights the model's capability for conducting efficient and reliable gradient-based boundary control. We will release our codes and data at https://github.com/intell-sci-comput/NPSolver.

AI.title_translation: NPSolver：具有迭代物理监督的神经泊松求解器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需真实标签的神经泊松求解器NPSolver，通过少量PCG迭代步骤修正自身预测作为稳定的物理监督，并结合BA-Transolver架构，实现了在复杂不规则区域上的高效、稳定求解。
AI.motivation: 在复杂不规则区域上高效求解泊松方程是一大挑战。传统迭代求解器因系统病态而运行缓慢；而神经算子虽然计算迅速，但要么依赖大规模有标签数据集，要么在采用物理信息残差损失时面临训练不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 提出NPSolver方法，无需真实解标签，而是利用少量的预条件共轭梯度（PCG）步骤来细化自身的预测，以此作为稳定且尺度合理的物理监督信号。同时，采用梯度阻断（stop-gradient）设计以确保优化稳定性，并引入了边界感知Transolver（BA-Transolver）架构，通过显式分离内部和边界的Token化来处理混合边界条件。
AI.result: 在2D和3D不规则几何形状上的广泛评估表明，NPSolver的性能显著优于现有的物理信息和数据驱动基线方法。此外，在下游热控制任务中，该模型展示出了高效且可靠的基于梯度的边界控制能力。
AI.conclusion: 迭代物理监督可以作为一种良态的误差代理，结合梯度阻断设计和边界感知架构，能够实现无监督、稳定且高性能的偏微分方程神经求解。
AI.translation: 在复杂、不规则区域上高效求解泊松方程仍然是科学计算中的一个根本性挑战，因为传统的迭代求解器往往由于系统病态而面临极高的运行时间成本。虽然神经算子提供了一种快速的替代方案，但它们通常依赖于大规模的有标签数据集，或者在使用物理信息残差损失时面临训练不稳定的问题。我们提出了 \textsc{NPSolver}，这是一种通过迭代物理监督进行无解标签训练的神经泊松求解器。与依赖完全收敛的数值解或原始 PDE 残差不同，\textsc{NPSolver} 利用少量的预条件共轭梯度（PCG）步骤来细化自身的预测，从而提供更稳定且尺度合理的训练信号。理论分析证实，这种迭代监督可以作为一种良态的误差代理，并且梯度阻断（stop-gradient）设计对于优化稳定性至关重要。为了在混合边界条件下更好地捕获边界驱动的特征，我们进一步引入了边界感知 Transolver（\textsc{BA-Transolver}）架构，该架构显式分离了内部和边界的 token 化。在 2D 和 3D 不规则几何体上的广泛评估表明，\textsc{NPSolver} 的性能优于物理信息和数据驱动的基线方法。此外，下游的热控制任务突出了该模型进行高效且可靠的基于梯度的边界控制的能力。我们将在 https://github.com/intell-sci-comput/NPSolver 发布我们的代码和数据。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为NPSolver的神经泊松方程求解器，采用迭代物理监督进行无标签训练。该方法利用少量预条件共轭梯度（PCG）迭代来细化自身预测，从而提供稳定的训练信号，并配合梯度阻断设计保证稳定性。此外，文章还引入了BA-Transolver架构以更好地处理混合边界条件。实验表明，NPSolver在2D和3D不规则几何体上的表现优于传统和深度学习基线，并成功应用于下游控制任务。
AI.keywords: 泊松方程, 神经算子, 迭代物理监督, 预条件共轭梯度, 边界感知Transolver
AI.comments:
创新性：该工作巧妙地将经典数值方法（PCG迭代）与深度学习相结合，利用迭代细化作为物理监督，为无监督神经偏微分方程求解开辟了新途径。
重要性：解决了物理信息神经网络（PINN）在复杂不规则边界上训练不稳定和传统求解器耗时的问题，具有很强的实用价值。
局限性：摘要中未提及PCG步骤的引入对整体训练时间和计算资源开销的具体影响。

title: On the Benefits of Free Exploration for Regret Minimization in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study a stochastic multi-armed bandit problem where an agent is granted a free exploration budget before regret accumulates, a setting not captured by the classic regret minimization or pure exploration paradigms. The goal is to design an adaptive policy that strategically explores the bandit instance in the initial free exploration phase and minimizes the cumulative regret in the subsequent phase. We formalize this regret minimization with free exploration problem and identify an interesting regime where the free exploration budget scales logarithmically with the time horizon. To quantify the amount of regret saved with high probability as a result of the availability of the free exploration phase, we introduce a novel set of policies known as $(α,β)$-probably saving policies. We propose a two-phase, probably saving algorithm, UFE-KLUCB-H, which consists of a principled free exploration policy, UFE, and a history-aware regret minimization policy KLUCB-H. Instance-dependent upper bounds on UFE-KLUCB-H are derived, showing that UFE-KLUCB-H accumulates strictly less regret than policies that do not have access to a free exploration phase. Complementarily, we derive instance-dependent lower bounds based on novel multi-instance perturbation arguments tailored to the free-exploration setting, demonstrating the near-optimality of UFE-KLUCB-H for two-valued bandits. Our upper and lower bounds reveal sharp phase transitions in the accumulated regret depending on the amount of available free exploration. Simulations are conducted to demonstrate that forced exploration and adaptivity in the algorithm lead to greater regret savings.

AI.title_translation: 论多臂老虎机中自由探索对最小化遗憾的益处
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在开始累积遗憾前拥有自由探索预算的多臂老虎机问题，提出了UFE-KLUCB-H算法，并证明其能显著降低累积遗憾。
AI.motivation: 传统的遗憾最小化或纯探索范式无法涵盖在遗憾累积之前给予智能体自由探索预算的场景。本文旨在探索如何在此类设定下通过自适应策略最大化地减少后续的累积遗憾。
AI.method: 形式化了带自由探索的遗憾最小化问题，引入了$(\alpha,\beta)$-可能节省策略的概念。提出了一个名为UFE-KLUCB-H的双阶段算法（结合了自由探索策略UFE和历史感知遗憾最小化策略KLUCB-H），并推导了其实例相关的上界和基于多实例扰动论证的下界。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，UFE-KLUCB-H积累的遗憾显著低于无自由探索的策略，且在两值老虎机上接近最优。上下界分析揭示了累积遗憾随自由探索预算变化的相变规律。模拟实验证实，强制探索与算法的自适应性带来了更大的遗憾节省。
AI.conclusion: 在多臂老虎机问题中引入前期的自由探索阶段能显著降低后续的累积遗憾。所提出的UFE-KLUCB-H算法在理论和实验上均证明了其利用自由探索预算实现遗憾最小化的优越性与近乎最优性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一种随机多臂老虎机问题，其中智能体在遗憾累积之前被赋予了自由探索预算，这一设定是经典的遗憾最小化或纯探索范式所无法涵盖的。其目标是设计一种自适应策略，在初始的自由探索阶段策略性地探索老虎机实例，并在随后的阶段中最小化累积遗憾。我们形式化了这种带有自由探索的遗憾最小化问题，并确定了一个有趣的机制，即自由探索预算随时间跨度呈对数级缩放。为了量化由于自由探索阶段的存在而大概率节省的遗憾量，我们引入了一类新颖的策略，称为 $(\alpha, \beta)$-可能节省策略。我们提出了一种双阶段的、可能节省的算法 UFE-KLUCB-H，它由原则性的自由探索策略 UFE 和感知历史的遗憾最小化策略 KLUCB-H 组成。我们推导了 UFE-KLUCB-H 与实例相关的上界，表明 UFE-KLUCB-H 积累的遗憾明显少于无法获得自由探索阶段的策略。作为补充，我们基于量身定制于自由探索设置的新型多实例扰动论证，推导了与实例相关的下界，证明了 UFE-KLUCB-H 在两值老虎机上的近乎最优性。我们的上界和下界揭示了累积遗憾根据可用自由探索量的急剧相变。进行了模拟实验以证明算法中的强制探索和自适应性可以带来更大的遗憾节省。
AI.summary: 本文提出并研究了一种新型的多臂老虎机设定，即在正式计算累积遗憾前允许智能体进行无成本的自由探索。作者提出了双阶段算法UFE-KLUCB-H，并证明了该算法能有效利用自由探索预算来显著减少后续的遗憾。通过严格的上下界理论分析和模拟实验，展示了自由探索对遗憾最小化的显著效益及算法的近最优性。
AI.keywords: 多臂老虎机, 自由探索, 遗憾最小化, 算法设计, 理论界限
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将“无成本探索”与“遗憾最小化”结合起来，非常符合实际应用中（如推荐系统或临床试验上线前的测试期）的场景。论文提出的理论框架和上下界分析十分扎实，特别是揭示了遗憾随预算变化的相变现象，为多臂老虎机理论开辟了新的研究视角。

title: HoLoArm: Deformable Arms for Collision-Tolerant Quadrotor Flight
comments: 8 pages, 15 figures, 1 table, Accepted at the IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) and the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA), 2026
summary: The increasing use of drones in human-centric applications highlights the need for designs that can survive collisions and recover rapidly, minimizing risks to both humans and the environment. We present HoLoArm, a quadrotor with compliant arms inspired by the nodus structure of dragonfly wings. This design provides natural flexibility and resilience while preserving flight stability, which is further reinforced by the integration of a Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy that enhances both recovery and hovering performance. Experimental results demonstrate that HoLoArm can passively deform in any direction, including axial one, and recover within 0.3-0.6 s depending on the direction and level of the impact. The drone can survive collisions at speeds up to 7.6 m/s and carry a 540 g payload while maintaining stable flight. This work contributes to the morphological design of soft aerial robots with high agility and reliable safety, enabling operation in cluttered and human shared environments, and lays the groundwork for future fully soft drones that integrate compliant structures with intelligent control.
comment: 8 pages, 15 figures, 1 table, Accepted at the IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) and the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA), 2026

AI.title_translation: HoLoArm：用于抗碰撞无人机飞行的可变形机臂
AI.tldr: HoLoArm通过仿生柔性机臂与强化学习控制，实现了无人机在高速碰撞下的快速恢复与稳定飞行，提升了其在复杂环境下的安全性。
AI.motivation: 随着无人机在以人为中心的环境中应用日益广泛，迫切需要一种能够承受碰撞并快速恢复的无人机设计，以降低对人类和环境的风险。
AI.method: 设计了一种受蜻蜓翅膀结构启发的柔性可变形机臂（HoLoArm），并集成了一套强化学习（RL）控制策略，以优化无人机的碰撞后恢复能力与悬停稳定性。
AI.result: HoLoArm能够实现全方位（包括轴向）被动变形，碰撞后恢复时间仅需0.3-0.6秒；最高可在7.6 m/s的速度下承受碰撞，并能在携带540克载荷的同时保持飞行稳定。
AI.conclusion: HoLoArm展示了柔性形态设计与强化学习控制在提升无人机抗碰撞能力与环境适应性方面的巨大潜力，为未来研发全柔性无人机奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 无人机在以人为中心的应用中日益普及，这凸显了对能够在碰撞中幸存并快速恢复的设计需求，以最大限度地降低对人类和环境的风险。我们提出了HoLoArm，这是一种受蜻蜓翅膀节点结构启发、带有柔性机臂的四旋翼无人机。该设计提供了自然的灵活性和弹性，同时保持了飞行稳定性，并通过集成强化学习（RL）控制策略进一步增强了恢复和悬停性能。实验结果表明，HoLoArm可以向任何方向（包括轴向）被动变形，并根据冲击的方向和程度在0.3-0.6秒内恢复。该无人机可以在高达7.6 m/s的速度下承受碰撞，并携带540克的有效载荷，同时保持稳定飞行。这项工作为具有高敏捷性和可靠安全性的软体空中机器人的形态设计做出了贡献，使其能够在杂乱和共享的人类环境中运行，并为未来将柔性结构与智能控制相结合的全柔性无人机奠定了基础。
AI.summary: HoLoArm是一种新型四旋翼无人机，其机臂采用仿生蜻蜓翅膀结构，具备出色的被动变形与抗冲击能力。结合强化学习控制策略，该无人机在碰撞后展现出极快的恢复速度与高稳定性，能够在复杂及人机共存环境中安全运行。
AI.keywords: 柔性无人机, 抗碰撞设计, 蜻蜓翅膀结构, 强化学习, 飞行稳定性
AI.comments: 该论文通过仿生设计（蜻蜓翅膀结构）与强化学习控制相结合，解决了无人机在复杂环境下的抗碰撞安全性问题。其创新点在于结合了物理柔性结构与智能控制策略，显著提升了无人机的生存能力与恢复速度。局限性在于未提及在极端天气或复杂动态障碍物中的具体表现。

title: Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Distribution Statistics Analytics on Mobile Spatial Data
summary: With the rapid development of mobile computing technology, massive amounts of spatial data are continuously generated from various mobile terminals and sensing devices, such as smartphones, connected vehicles, and drones. Performing efficient distributed statistical analysis on this data is crucial for real-time mobile computing applications. However, the constrained and dynamic nature of mobile environments exacerbates the privacy challenge: centralizing sensitive data for analysis risks severe privacy leaks, while existing privacy-preserving techniques often introduce excessive overhead or inaccuracies In this paper, we design, implement, and evaluate the first system that supports efficient and privacy-preserving distribution statistics analysis for mobile spatial data. First, we propose eSpat-B, which leverages two non-colluding servers and a newly designed improved distributed point functions (DPF) with octree partitioning. Furthermore, considering the frequent updates of spatial data, we propose another more efficient scheme, eSpat+. The core idea of this scheme is to utilize a K-Dimensional tree for spatial partitioning, combine it with incremental DPF for performing statistics analysis, and design an efficient update algorithm. Security analysis demonstrates that our schemes effectively protect data privacy throughout the statistical process. Theoretical analysis and experimental results on real-world mobile trajectory datasets demonstrate that our proposed schemes achieve a reduction of approximately 1.2* in computation overhead, 20* in communication overhead, and maintain 100% accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 移动空间数据上高效且隐私保护的分布统计分析
AI.tldr: 本文设计并实现了首个支持移动空间数据高效且隐私保护的分布统计分析系统，通过eSpat-B和eSpat+两种方案，显著降低计算和通信开销，同时保持100%准确性。
AI.motivation: 随着移动计算技术的发展，大量移动空间数据产生，对其进行高效分布式统计分析对实时移动应用至关重要。然而，移动环境的限制性加剧了隐私挑战：集中式分析存在严重隐私泄露风险，而现有隐私保护技术常引入过高开销或不准确性。
AI.method: 本文设计并实现了两种方案。首先，eSpat-B利用两个非串通服务器和新设计的改进分布式点函数（DPF）结合八叉树分区。其次，针对空间数据频繁更新，提出更高效的eSpat+方案，其核心思想是利用K-D树进行空间分区，结合增量DPF进行统计分析，并设计了高效的更新算法。
AI.result: 安全分析表明方案有效保护数据隐私。理论分析和真实移动轨迹数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方案计算开销降低约1.2倍，通信开销降低约20倍，并保持100%的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的eSpat-B和eSpat+方案能够实现移动空间数据的高效且隐私保护的分布统计分析，有效解决了现有技术开销大或准确性低的问题，并在保护数据隐私的同时，显著提升了计算和通信效率，并保持了数据统计的准确性。
AI.translation: 随着移动计算技术的快速发展，来自智能手机、联网车辆和无人机等各种移动终端和传感设备持续生成海量的空间数据。对这些数据进行高效的分布式统计分析对于实时移动计算应用至关重要。然而，移动环境的受限和动态特性加剧了隐私挑战：集中化敏感数据进行分析存在严重的隐私泄露风险，而现有的隐私保护技术往往引入过高的开销或不准确性。在本文中，我们设计、实现并评估了第一个支持移动空间数据高效且隐私保护的分布统计分析系统。首先，我们提出了eSpat-B，它利用两个非串通服务器和一种新设计的结合八叉树分区的改进分布式点函数（DPF）。此外，考虑到空间数据的频繁更新，我们提出了另一个更高效的方案eSpat+。该方案的核心思想是利用K-D树进行空间分区，结合增量DPF进行统计分析，并设计了高效的更新算法。安全分析表明，我们的方案在整个统计过程中有效保护了数据隐私。在真实世界移动轨迹数据集上的理论分析和实验结果表明，我们提出的方案计算开销降低了大约1.2倍，通信开销降低了20倍，并保持了100%的准确性。
AI.summary: 本文针对移动空间数据高效且隐私保护的分布统计分析需求，提出了eSpat-B和eSpat+两种系统。eSpat-B利用改进的分布式点函数和八叉树分区，而eSpat+则通过K-D树分区和增量DPF处理频繁更新。实验证明，所提方案在保护数据隐私的同时，显著降低了计算和通信开销，并保持了100%的统计准确性。
AI.keywords: 移动空间数据, 隐私保护, 分布式统计, 分布式点函数, K-D树
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次为移动空间数据设计了高效且隐私保护的分布统计分析系统。通过结合改进的DPF、八叉树/K-D树分区以及增量DPF，有效解决了移动环境中隐私保护与效率之间的矛盾。在计算和通信开销上取得了显著的优化，同时保证了数据准确性，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: When Can We Trust Early Warnings? Leakage-Excluded Early Outcome Prediction from LMS Interaction Logs
summary: Early-warning models built from Learning Management System (LMS) logs aim to predict end-of-course outcomes early enough to enable timely learner support. However, reported "early" performance is often inflated by temporal leakage. This occurs when the pipeline uses information that would not yet be available at the time of prediction. We formalize cutoff-based early outcome prediction under a temporal availability constraint and introduce LEAP (Leakage-Excluded Early-Availability Protocol), which enforces cutoff-first truncation prior to joins and aggregation and audits feature provenance to prevent post-cutoff evidence from entering the benchmark. We instantiate LEAP on the public Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) as a multi-step protocol for leakage-controlled evaluation across weekly cutoffs. Using several standard learning methods, we evaluate performance using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier score, and F1@0.5. Results show improving performance as the observation window expands, with a marked gain around week~3; Random Forest performs best at the earliest cutoffs, while Gradient Boosting dominates thereafter. Leakage ablations further show that temporal violations, especially through assessment information, can inflate apparent "early" performance.

AI.title_translation: 我们何时能信任早期预警？基于LMS交互日志的排除泄漏早期结果预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了LEAP协议，通过强制执行时间截断和特征审计，解决了教育早期预警模型中因使用未来信息导致的性能评估虚高问题。
AI.motivation: 学习管理系统中的早期预警模型往往因时间泄漏（即使用了预测时刻之后的信息）导致性能指标虚高，使得模型在实际应用中的有效性受到质疑。
AI.method: 提出了LEAP（Leakage-Excluded Early-Availability Protocol）协议，该协议通过在数据连接和聚合之前执行“截断优先”策略，并审计特征来源，以防止未来信息进入基准测试。在OULAD数据集上进行了多步骤的验证，并对比了多种机器学习模型。
AI.result: 实验证明，随着观察窗口的扩大，模型性能逐步提升，在第3周出现明显增益。随机森林在早期截断点表现最佳，而梯度提升模型在后续阶段占优。对比实验显示，包含评估信息的时间违反会导致早期性能指标被显著高估。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，严格控制时间泄漏对于准确评估早期预警模型至关重要。通过LEAP协议，可以更真实地反映模型在不同观察窗口下的预测能力，同时也揭示了评估信息对性能表现的显著影响。
AI.translation: 基于学习管理系统（LMS）日志构建的早期预警模型，旨在尽早预测课程结束时的结果，以便及时提供学习支持。然而，报告的“早期”性能往往因时间泄漏而被高估。这种情况发生在流水线使用了在预测时刻尚不可用的信息时。我们形式化了时间可用性约束下的截断式早期结果预测，并引入了LEAP（排除泄漏的早期可用性协议），该协议在连接和聚合之前强制执行截断，并审核特征来源，以防止截断后的证据进入基准测试。我们在公开的开放大学学习分析数据集（OULAD）上实例化了LEAP，作为一个跨周截断的泄漏受控评估的多步协议。使用几种标准学习方法，我们通过ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、Brier分数和F1@0.5评估了性能。结果显示，随着观察窗口的扩大，性能有所提高，在第3周左右有显著增益；随机森林在最早的截断点表现最好，而梯度提升在之后占据主导地位。泄漏消融研究进一步表明，时间违规，尤其是通过评估信息造成的违规，会夸大表面的“早期”性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对学习管理系统（LMS）中早期预警模型存在的时间泄漏问题，提出了LEAP协议。通过在特征工程阶段严格执行时间截断，确保模型仅使用预测时刻可用的信息。在OULAD数据集上的实验验证了该协议的有效性，并揭示了避免时间泄漏对于准确评估模型性能的重要性。
AI.keywords: 早期预警, 学习管理系统, 时间泄漏, LEAP协议, 教育数据挖掘
AI.comments: 本文针对教育数据挖掘中的一个关键问题——时间泄漏（temporal leakage）进行了系统性研究。创新之处在于提出了LEAP协议，强制在数据聚合前进行时间截断，有效地解决了评估指标虚高的问题，为教育早期预警系统的可靠性评估提供了标准化的范式。

title: SAMark: A Self-Anchored Text Watermarking with Paragraph-Level Paraphrase Robustness
summary: Semantic-level watermarking (SWM) improves robustness against text modifications by treating sentences as the basic unit. However, robustness to paragraph-level paraphrasing remains difficult because such attacks globally disrupt watermark signals by changing sentence order. In this work, we propose SAMark, a self-anchored watermarking framework that removes the dependency on sentence order by establishing a step-independent green region in semantic space. To improve detectability, we introduce a multi-channel hyperbolic scoring mechanism that amplifies watermark signals while suppressing noise from weakly aligned candidates. We further propose a diversity-aware filtering strategy that combines hard filtering with soft regularization, extending beyond simple n-gram repetition filters to address semantic redundancy. Experimental results show that SAMark achieves up to 90.2% TP@FP1% under typical paragraph-level paraphrasing attacks, outperforming the strongest prior baseline by more than 30% on average, while maintaining generation quality competitive with unwatermarked text and breaking the robustness-quality trade-off that limits prior methods.

AI.title_translation: SAMark：一种具有段落级改写鲁棒性的自锚定文本水印技术
AI.tldr: SAMark通过自锚定机制和双曲评分策略，解决了语义水印在面对段落改写时鲁棒性不足的问题，大幅提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义级水印方法在面对段落级改写攻击（如改变句子顺序）时，由于依赖句子顺序而导致水印信号被破坏，鲁棒性较差。
AI.method: 提出SAMark框架，核心包括：1. 建立与句子顺序无关的自锚定绿色区域；2. 采用多通道双曲评分机制以增强信号并抑制噪声；3. 引入结合硬过滤与软正则化的多样性感知过滤策略。
AI.result: 在典型的段落级改写攻击下，SAMark的检测性能达到90.2% TP@FP1%，平均比现有最强基线提升了超过30%，且在保持生成质量的同时打破了鲁棒性与质量之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: SAMark通过自锚定机制和多通道双曲评分，成功实现了对段落级改写攻击的强鲁棒性，同时保持了良好的生成质量，突破了以往方法在鲁棒性与文本质量之间的权衡瓶颈。
AI.translation: 语义级水印（SWM）通过将句子视为基本单元，提高了对文本修改的鲁棒性。然而，由于段落级改写通过改变句子顺序在全球范围内破坏了水印信号，因此在这种攻击下保持鲁棒性仍然很困难。在这项工作中，我们提出了SAMark，这是一个自锚定的水印框架，它通过在语义空间中建立一个与步骤无关的绿色区域，消除了对句子顺序的依赖。为了提高可检测性，我们引入了一种多通道双曲评分机制，在抑制弱对齐候选词噪声的同时放大了水印信号。我们进一步提出了一种多样性感知过滤策略，将硬过滤与软正则化相结合，超越了简单的n-gram重复过滤器，以解决语义冗余问题。实验结果表明，SAMark在典型的段落级改写攻击下达到了90.2%的TP@FP1%，平均超过最强基线30%以上，同时保持了与未加水印文本相当的生成质量，打破了限制先前方法的鲁棒性与质量之间的权衡。
AI.summary: SAMark是一种针对段落级改写攻击的自锚定文本水印框架。它通过在语义空间构建与顺序无关的绿色区域，结合多通道双曲评分与多样性感知过滤策略，显著提升了水印在复杂改写场景下的鲁棒性与检测精度，并实现了高质量的文本生成。
AI.keywords: 语义水印, 段落级改写, 自锚定, 鲁棒性, 文本生成
AI.comments: 该论文解决了语义水印在段落级改写（如打乱句子顺序）下的鲁棒性难题。创新点在于引入了“自锚定”机制，通过在语义空间建立与顺序无关的绿色区域，有效解决了传统方法对句子顺序的依赖，并在保持高质量文本生成的同时显著提升了检测性能，是文本水印领域的一个重要进展。

title: DiSC: Resolution-Scalable Acceleration of Diffusion Models by Exploiting Sparsity and Cached Token Reuse with Hash-based Distribution
summary:
Transformer-based diffusion models offer superior scalability and performance but suffer from high computational overhead due to the iterative nature and quadratic complexity of self-attention at high resolutions. In this paper, we propose DiSC, a resolution-scalable, sparsity-aware hardware accelerator. At the software level, DiSC introduces two algorithms: Cached Token Reuse (CTR), and Softmax Thresholding with Sparsity Mask Reuse (ST). CTR introduces a mechanism that translates spatial variations in the input latent difference across steps into a token-level reuse decision, effectively eliminating redundant token computation. ST induces sparsity in attention operations by reusing a generated sparsity pattern, leveraging temporal similarity to bypass costly prediction overhead. Together, these algorithms provide resolution-scalable computational benefits and yield a moderate sparsity and hybrid dense-sparse workload.
  To exploit this efficiently, we design a specialized hardware architecture and unified dataflow. This architecture avoids dedicated sparsity-handling components; instead, a hash-based distribution over on-chip memory banks allows DiSC to reuse its existing compute engines for sparse operations, efficiently exploiting the induced sparsity with minimal hardware overhead. Evaluated on DiT and PixArt-Sigma, DiSC achieves 3.47-4.74x and 2.48-3.50x speedups over NVIDIA A100 and H100 GPUs, respectively, with energy savings ranging from 46.4% to 68.1%.

AI.title_translation: DiSC：通过利用稀疏性和基于哈希分布的缓存令牌重用，实现扩散模型的分辨率可扩展加速
AI.tldr: DiSC通过软硬协同设计，利用算法诱导的稀疏性和令牌重用技术，在不增加额外硬件开销的前提下，显著提升了Transformer扩散模型的推理速度和能效。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的扩散模型因其迭代特性和自注意力机制在高分辨率下的二次计算复杂度，导致计算开销巨大，亟需提高计算效率。
AI.method: 提出名为DiSC的硬件加速器及两种软件算法：1) 缓存令牌重用 (CTR)：通过分析输入潜变量差异进行令牌级重用；2) 带有稀疏掩码重用的Softmax阈值处理 (ST)：利用时间相似性诱导并重用稀疏模式。在硬件层面，采用基于哈希的片上内存分布数据流，无需专用稀疏硬件即可复用现有计算引擎。
AI.result: 在DiT和PixArt-Sigma模型上，DiSC相比NVIDIA A100实现了3.47-4.74倍加速，相比H100实现了2.48-3.50倍加速，能耗降低了46.4%至68.1%。
AI.conclusion: DiSC通过创新的软件算法和低开销的硬件架构，成功解决了Transformer扩散模型在高分辨率下的高计算负载问题，实现了显著的速度提升和节能效果。
AI.translation: 基于Transformer的扩散模型虽然提供了卓越的可扩展性和性能，但由于其迭代特性和高分辨率下自注意力机制的二次复杂度，导致了高昂的计算开销。在本文中，我们提出了DiSC，一种分辨率可扩展、感知稀疏性的硬件加速器。在软件层面，DiSC引入了两种算法：缓存令牌重用（CTR）和带有稀疏掩码重用的Softmax阈值处理（ST）。CTR引入了一种机制，将输入潜变量在不同步骤间的空间差异转化为令牌级的重用决策，从而有效消除了冗余的令牌计算。ST通过重用生成的稀疏模式来诱导注意力操作中的稀疏性，利用时间相似性绕过高昂的预测开销。这些算法共同提供了分辨率可扩展的计算优势，并产生了中等稀疏性和混合稠密-稀疏的工作负载。为了高效利用这一点，我们设计了专门的硬件架构和统一的数据流。该架构避免了专用稀疏处理组件；相反，通过片上存储库的基于哈希的分布，使得DiSC能够复用其现有的计算引擎进行稀疏操作，以最小的硬件开销有效地利用诱导的稀疏性。在DiT和PixArt-Sigma上的评估结果显示，DiSC相比NVIDIA A100和H100 GPU分别实现了3.47-4.74倍和2.48-3.50倍的加速，节能范围为46.4%至68.1%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DiSC，一种针对Transformer扩散模型的硬件加速器。通过CTR算法消除冗余计算，利用ST算法诱导并重用稀疏模式，配合创新的哈希基础片上存储分布架构，在无需专用稀疏硬件的情况下，显著提升了高分辨率扩散模型的推理速度并降低了能耗。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 硬件加速器, 自注意力机制, 稀疏性, 缓存令牌重用
AI.comments: DiSC的创新之处在于通过软硬件协同设计，无需专用稀疏计算单元即可实现高效的稀疏加速。其利用哈希分布策略巧妙地解决了稀疏性带来的不规则访存问题，在高性能GPU（如A100/H100）基础上实现了显著的性能提升和能效优化，是扩散模型硬件加速领域的重要进展。

title: Addressing Exacerbated Attention Sink for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP have shown impressive generalization capabilities, yet their potential for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning (CDFSL) remains underexplored, where the model needs to transfer source-domain information to target domains with scarce training data. While the attention sink phenomenon has been observed in VLMs for certain tasks, its role in CDFSL scenarios has not been studied. In this paper, we uncover a critical issue overlooked by prior works: standard target-domain few-shot fine-tuning in CDFSL significantly exacerbates the attention sink problem, leading to poor discriminability across classes. To understand this phenomenon, through extensive experiments, we interpret it as the model's shortcut learning for domain adaptation: to overcome the huge domain gap between the source and target domains, the model shows a high tendency to push tokens that are initially closer to target-domain classes (i.e., simple tokens) to be even closer to these classes, exacerbating the attention sink and wasting the capability of learning other discriminative but initially further tokens (i.e., hard tokens). To address this, we propose a novel approach to dynamically re-weight tokens according to their relevance with target-domain classes during the target-domain finetuning, which explicitly suppresses the model's reliance on these simple tokens and enhances the learning of hard tokens, reducing sink tokens and enhancing discriminability. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets validate the rationale of our method, demonstrating new state-of-the-art performance. Our codes are available at https://github.com/shuaiyi308/TIR.

AI.title_translation: 解决面向无源跨域少样本学习的加剧注意力汇聚问题
AI.tldr: 本文发现 CDFSL 微调会加剧注意力汇聚导致性能下降，并提出通过动态调整 token 权重来抑制简单 token、学习困难 token 的方法，实现了 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究忽视了在交叉领域少样本学习（CDFSL）中，标准的微调过程会加剧视觉-语言模型的“注意力汇聚”现象，导致模型倾向于利用简单 token 进行捷径学习，从而忽略了更具判别力的困难 token。
AI.method: 提出了一种动态重加权方法，在目标域微调过程中根据 token 与目标类别的相关性对 token 进行权重调整，从而抑制模型对简单 token 的过度依赖，增强对困难 token 的学习。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法有效减少了汇聚 token 的影响，提升了模型的判别能力，并实现了新的最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功揭示了在 CDFSL 中微调会加剧注意力汇聚的问题，并提出的动态 token 重加权方法有效缓解了该现象，显著提升了模型在目标域的分类性能。
AI.translation: 像 CLIP 这样的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）展现出了令人印象深刻的泛化能力，但它们在跨域少样本学习（CDFSL）中的潜力仍未得到充分探索，在这种场景下，模型需要将源域信息迁移到训练数据稀缺的目标域。虽然在某些任务中已观察到 VLMs 中的注意力汇聚现象，但其在 CDFSL 场景中的作用尚未得到研究。在本文中，我们揭示了一个被先前工作忽视的关键问题：CDFSL 中的标准目标域少样本微调显著加剧了注意力汇聚问题，导致类间判别力较差。为了理解这一现象，通过大量实验，我们将其解释为模型进行域适应的捷径学习：为了克服源域和目标域之间的巨大领域差距，模型表现出一种强烈的倾向，即将初始时更接近目标域类别的 token（即简单 token）推得更靠近这些类别，从而加剧了注意力汇聚，并浪费了学习其他具有判别力但初始时较远的 token（即困难 token）的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，在目标域微调期间根据 token 与目标域类别的相关性动态地对 token 进行重加权，这明确地抑制了模型对这些简单 token 的依赖，并增强了对困难 token 的学习，减少了汇聚 token 并增强了判别力。在四个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的合理性，证明了新的最先进性能。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/shuaiyi308/TIR 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对交叉领域少样本学习（CDFSL）中视觉-语言模型微调导致的注意力汇聚加剧问题，揭示了其作为捷径学习的本质。作者提出了一种动态 token 重加权策略，通过抑制简单 token 并强化困难 token 的学习，有效提升了模型在目标域的分类性能。
AI.keywords: 交叉领域少样本学习, 视觉-语言模型, 注意力汇聚, 捷径学习, 动态重加权
AI.comments: 该论文敏锐地指出了交叉领域少样本学习（CDFSL）中微调过程会导致“注意力汇聚”（Attention Sink）问题加剧这一关键痛点。通过将该现象解释为一种“捷径学习”，并提出动态重加权机制来平衡简单与困难 token 的学习，不仅在理论上具有创新性，在实际性能上也达到了 SOTA。该研究为优化视觉-语言模型的迁移学习提供了重要视角。

title: PixelWizard: Towards Efficient High-Fidelity Video Generation at Ultra-Large Spatial Resolution
summary: High-resolution video generation faces a coupled bottleneck of optimization instability and prohibitive computational costs. The massive expansion of the token sequence not only biases optimization toward local textures at the expense of global coherence, leading to structural collapse, but also imposes prohibitive training costs and severe inference latency. To address this, we propose PixelWizard, a framework that hierarchically decouples global structure modeling from fine-grained detail synthesis. PixelWizard first establishes a compact spatiotemporal anchor to concentrate dense structural priors, which then guides fine-grained generation at high resolution. This mitigates the local optimization bias to ensure structural stability without compromising high-frequency details. Leveraging this structural stability, we introduce Noise-Span Aligned Shortcut Training to break the inference bottleneck. By explicitly modeling the step size, this mechanism allows the model to traverse the generation trajectory with large steps. Crucially, we incorporate Exponential Index-Biased Sampling and Adaptive Noise-Span Calibration to align optimization with the shifted noise schedules of high-resolution grids, ensuring robust few-step inference without incurring the heavy overhead of distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PixelWizard achieves superior visual quality while accelerating the generative sampling of native 2K/4K videos by over 10x.

AI.title_translation: 像素巫师：迈向超大空间分辨率的高效高保真视频生成
AI.tldr: PixelWizard通过分层解耦结构建模和细节合成来解决高分辨率视频生成的瓶颈，使用紧凑的时空锚点指导高分辨率生成，并通过噪声跨度对齐的快捷训练加速推理，实现了10倍以上的2K/4K视频生成加速和优越的视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频生成面临优化不稳定和计算成本高昂的耦合瓶颈，这会导致结构坍塌并产生高昂的训练成本和推理延迟。
AI.method: PixelWizard框架通过分层解耦全局结构建模和细粒度细节合成。它首先建立一个紧凑的时空锚点来集中密集的结构先验，然后指导高分辨率的细粒度生成。引入噪声跨度对齐快捷训练来打破推理瓶颈，通过显式建模步长来实现大步长生成。结合指数索引偏差采样和自适应噪声跨度校准，以匹配高分辨率网格的噪声调度，实现无需蒸馏的鲁棒的几步推理。
AI.result: PixelWizard实现了优越的视觉质量，并将原生2K/4K视频的生成采样速度提高了10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: PixelWizard通过其新颖的框架和训练机制，有效地解决了高分辨率视频生成中的关键挑战，实现了高效和高质量的生成。
AI.translation: 高分辨率视频生成面临优化不稳定和计算成本高昂的耦合瓶颈。密集扩展的序列不仅使优化倾向于局部纹理，牺牲了全局一致性，导致结构坍塌，而且还带来了高昂的训练成本和严重的推理延迟。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PixelWizard，一个分层解耦全局结构建模与细粒度细节合成的框架。PixelWizard首先建立一个紧凑的时空锚点来集中密集的结构先验，然后指导高分辨率的细粒度生成。这减轻了局部优化偏差，确保了结构稳定性，同时又不牺牲高频细节。利用这种结构稳定性，我们引入了噪声跨度对齐快捷训练来打破推理瓶颈。通过显式建模步长，该机制允许模型以大步长遍历生成轨迹。至关重要的是，我们结合了指数索引偏差采样和自适应噪声跨度校准，以匹配高分辨率网格的移位噪声调度，从而在不产生蒸馏的重负荷的情况下实现鲁棒的几步推理。大量的实验表明，PixelWizard在加速原生2K/4K视频生成采样超过10倍的同时，实现了优越的视觉质量。
AI.summary: PixelWizard是一个用于高效高保真视频生成的新框架，特别关注超大空间分辨率。它通过将全局结构建模与细粒度细节合成分层解耦来解决优化不稳定和计算成本高昂的问题。该框架利用紧凑的时空锚点来指导高分辨率生成，并引入了噪声跨度对齐快捷训练（Noise-Span Aligned Shortcut Training）等技术来加速推理过程，实现了显著的性能提升和优越的视觉质量。
AI.keywords: 高分辨率视频生成, PixelWizard, 时空锚点, 噪声跨度对齐快捷训练, 推理加速
AI.comments: 该研究在解决高分辨率视频生成中的关键挑战方面取得了显著进展，特别是优化稳定性和计算效率。通过引入分层解耦方法和创新的训练技术，PixelWizard在生成质量和速度方面都取得了出色的成果，为该领域带来了重要的贡献。然而，关于其在不同硬件平台上的可扩展性和实际部署的限制仍有待进一步研究。

title: Rethinking VLM Representation for VLA Initialization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models widely adopt pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as policy backbones, yet it remains unclear what kind of pretrained VLM representation is useful as a VLA initialization. In this paper, we study VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem along three axes: capability-level embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. Our experiments show that the original pretrained VLM representation is a key source of action performance. However, embodied VQA adaptation does not yield uniform gains: its benefit depends on downstream bottlenecks, and gains from different capability domains are not simply additive. For update strategy, LoRA provides a more reliable initialization than Full Finetune, indicating that overly reshaping the pretrained representation can weaken VLA initialization. Robot-data pretraining further improves VLA initialization, with the strongest variant obtained by staged LoRA-based training. Together, these findings suggest that effective VLM-to-VLA adaptation should inject action-relevant embodied and robot-trajectory signals while preserving the pretrained VLM representation that remains useful for action learning.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考VLA初始化中的VLM表示
AI.tldr: 预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型初始化中很重要，但其表示的有效性取决于具体应用。研究表明，在保持VLM原有表示的同时，注入与动作相关的具身和机器人轨迹信号，并通过分阶段的LoRA微调进行预训练，可以获得最佳的VLA初始化效果。
AI.motivation: 不清楚哪种预训练的VLM表示对VLA初始化有用，因此需要研究VLA初始化中的表示设计问题。
AI.method: 通过三个维度研究VLA初始化：1. 能力级具身视觉问答（VQA）监督；2. 参数更新策略；3. 机器人数据预训练。实验比较了不同方法的效果，包括LoRA和全量微调。
AI.result: 原始预训练的VLM表示对动作性能有重要影响。具身VQA适应的增益并非普遍，取决于下游瓶颈，不同能力域的增益不具有累加性。LoRA比全量微调提供更可靠的初始化。机器人数据预训练能进一步提升初始化效果，其中分阶段LoRA训练效果最强。
AI.conclusion: 有效的VLM到VLA适应应注入与动作相关的具身和机器人轨迹信号，同时保留对动作学习有用的预训练VLM表示。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型广泛采用预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为策略主干，但目前尚不清楚哪种预训练的VLM表示可用于VLA初始化。在本文中，我们研究VLA初始化作为一个受控的表示设计问题，涵盖三个维度：能力级别的具身视觉问答（VQA）监督、参数更新策略和机器人数据预训练。我们的实验表明，原始预训练的VLM表示是影响动作性能的关键因素。然而，具身VQA适应并未带来普遍的收益：其益处取决于下游瓶颈，并且来自不同能力域的收益并非简单累加。对于更新策略，LoRA比全量微调（Full Finetune）提供了更可靠的初始化，这表明过度重塑预训练表示可能会削弱VLA初始化。机器人数据预训练进一步改善了VLA初始化，其中分阶段的LoRA训练获得了最强的效果。总而言之，这些发现表明，有效的VLM到VLA适应应注入与动作相关的具身和机器人轨迹信号，同时保留对动作学习仍然有用的预训练VLM表示。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型初始化中，视觉-语言模型（VLM）表示的有效性。通过在能力级具身VQA监督、参数更新策略和机器人数据预训练三个维度上进行实验，研究发现原始VLM表示对动作性能至关重要。具身VQA适应的效果因下游瓶颈而异，且不同能力域的增益不具有累加性。LoRA微调比全量微调更能保持VLM表示的有效性，而机器人数据预训练（特别是分阶段LoRA训练）能进一步提升初始化效果。最终结论是，有效的VLM到VLA适应应在保留关键VLM表示的同时，融入动作相关的具身和机器人轨迹信息。
AI.keywords: VLA初始化, VLM表示, 具身VQA, LoRA, 机器人数据预训练
AI.comments: 该研究系统地探讨了VLM表示对VLA初始化的影响，并提出了具体的优化策略，为未来VLA模型的设计提供了有价值的指导。研究结果强调了在适应过程中保持预训练模型原有优势的重要性，以及结合具身和机器人数据进行微调的必要性。

title: ATV-Net: Adaptive Triple-View Network with Dynamic Feature Fusion
summary: Recent semantic segmentation research has increasingly moved toward stronger context modeling, dense attention, and transformer-based architectures. Although these models achieve impressive performance, classical CNN-based segmentation pipelines remain attractive because of their simplicity, efficiency, and ease of implementation. This paper revisits a practical question: how far can a ResNet-based segmentation model be improved by only modifying the segmentation head? We propose ATV-Net, an Adaptive Triple-View Network that strengthens a ResNet-101 backbone using three simple but complementary receptive-field views. The micro view captures point-wise semantic responses, the local view models neighborhood structures and object boundaries, and the scout view provides enlarged contextual cues. Instead of fusing these views with fixed weights, ATV-Net introduces an Adaptive Decision Gate that dynamically selects receptive-field responses according to input scene characteristics. A compact global coordination layer is further applied to improve spatial and semantic consistency. Experiments on the Cityscapes validation set show that ATV-Net achieves 80.31\% mIoU. This result suggests that classical CNN-based segmentation is still far from obsolete: with simple receptive-field views and adaptive fusion, a ResNet-based pipeline can reach a competitive accuracy level without relying on transformer-style global attention or overly complex context modules.

AI.title_translation: 自适应三视图网络动态特征融合的ATV-Net
AI.tldr: 通过结合三种不同感受野的视图（微观、局部、侦察）并使用动态门控自适应融合，ATV-Net 增强了 ResNet-101 分割模型，在 Cityscapes 数据集上达到了 80.31% 的 mIoU，证明了经典 CNN 分割方法的潜力。
AI.motivation: 探讨如何仅通过修改分割头来改进基于 ResNet 的分割模型，并证明经典 CNN 分割方法仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出 ATV-Net，一个自适应三视图网络，使用三种互补的感受野视图（微观、局部、侦察）来增强 ResNet-101 主干网络。通过自适应决策门动态融合这些视图，并使用全局协调层来提高空间和语义一致性。
AI.result: 在 Cityscapes 验证集上实现了 80.31% 的 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单的感受野视图和自适应融合，基于 ResNet 的分割方法可以达到具有竞争力的精度，而无需依赖 Transformer 风格的全局注意力或复杂的上下文模块，表明经典 CNN 分割方法并未过时。
AI.translation: 近期，语义分割研究越来越多地转向更强的上下文建模、密集注意力和基于 Transformer 的架构。尽管这些模型取得了令人印象深刻的性能，但经典的基于 CNN 的分割流水线因其简单性、效率和易于实现而仍然具有吸引力。本文重新审视了一个实际问题：仅通过修改分割头，基于 ResNet 的分割模型可以提高多远？我们提出了 ATV-Net，一个自适应三视图网络，它使用三种简单但互补的感受野视图来增强 ResNet-101 主干网络。微观视图捕捉逐点语义响应，局部视图模拟邻域结构和对象边界，侦察视图提供放大的上下文线索。ATV-Net 没有使用固定的权重融合这些视图，而是引入了一个自适应决策门，根据输入场景的特征动态地选择感受野响应。此外，还应用了一个紧凑的全局协调层来提高空间和语义一致性。在 Cityscapes 验证集上的实验表明，ATV-Net 达到了 80.31% 的 mIoU。这一结果表明，经典的基于 CNN 的分割距离过时还差得很远：通过简单的感受野视图和自适应融合，基于 ResNet 的流水线可以达到具有竞争力的精度水平，而无需依赖 Transformer 风格的全局注意力或过于复杂的上下文模块。
AI.summary: ATV-Net 是一种增强的 ResNet-101 分割模型，通过结合三种具有不同感受野的视图（微观、局部和侦察）来捕捉不同尺度的语义信息。该模型引入了一个自适应决策门，能够根据输入场景动态融合这些视图的特征，并辅以全局协调层以提高一致性。实验结果表明，ATV-Net 在 Cityscapes 数据集上取得了 80.31% 的 mIoU，证明了经典 CNN 方法通过改进分割头和特征融合策略，仍然可以实现与先进模型相媲美的性能。
AI.keywords: ATV-Net, 语义分割, CNN, 自适应特征融合, 感受野视图
AI.comments: 该研究有效地展示了通过优化分割头和特征融合策略，经典 CNN 模型在语义分割任务中的潜力。ATV-Net 的自适应决策门机制是其亮点，能够根据场景动态调整特征融合，提高了模型的灵活性和性能。然而，与其他更复杂的模型相比，其在 Cityscapes 数据集上 80.31% 的 mIoU 仍有提升空间。未来的工作可以探索更精细的特征融合方法或与其他先进模块的结合。

title: Event-to-Video Reconstruction using Spatio-Temporal and Frequency-Enhanced Deep Neural Networks
summary: Event cameras offer significant advantages over conventional frame-based counterparts, including high temporal resolution, low latency, and energy efficiency. These characteristics make them suitable for high-speed and high-dynamic range scene acquisition scenarios; however, the lack of dense intensity frames limits the direct applicability of conventional computer vision methods for scene understanding. Event-to-video (E2V) reconstruction seeks to bridge this gap by converting asynchronous event streams into a sequence of synchronous video frames. Existing E2V reconstruction methods based on convolutional neural networks and transformers operate primarily in the spatial domain and often struggle to recover fine structural details while suppressing severe reconstruction artifacts. To address these issues, we propose MSFET-E2V, a novel multiscale frequency-enhanced transformer model. At its core lies a cross-domain attention module, which fuses spatio-temporal features with frequency-aware representations derived from the discrete wavelet transform. Unlike prior methods relying solely on spatial attention, our approach effectively captures both local and global structures by taking into account low- and high-frequency components, enhancing detail preservation and robustness across various motion scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a lightweight wavelet-enhanced skip block that serves as a skip connection, facilitating artifact suppression and structural detail refinement through joint spatial-frequency domain processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MSFET-E2V achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods on multiple real-world event datasets, offering significant gains in reconstruction quality. Moreover, compared to the existing transformer-based method, our proposed model significantly reduces the number of parameters, the GPU memory usage, and inference time.

AI.title_translation: 基于时空和频域增强的深度神经网络事件到视频重建
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MSFET-E2V的新型多尺度频域增强Transformer模型，用于将事件相机数据重建为视频帧。该模型通过融合时空特征和离散小波变换提取的频域信息，以及引入轻量级的提升小波增强跳跃连接模块，有效解决了现有方法在细节恢复和伪影抑制方面的不足。实验结果表明，MSFET-E2V在重建质量上优于现有最先进方法，同时显著减少了模型参数量、GPU内存占用和推理时间。
AI.motivation: 事件相机虽然具有高时间分辨率、低延迟和低功耗等优点，但其生成的稀疏事件流限制了传统计算机视觉方法的应用。事件到视频（E2V）重建旨在将事件流转换为同步视频帧，但现有方法在恢复精细结构细节和抑制重建伪影方面存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为MSFET-E2V的新型多尺度频域增强Transformer模型。核心是一个跨域注意力模块，融合了时空特征和通过离散小波变换（DWT）获得的频域表示。还提出了一种轻量级的提升小波增强跳跃连接模块，作为跳跃连接，用于伪影抑制和结构细节细化。
AI.result: MSFET-E2V在多个真实世界事件数据集上实现了优于现有最先进方法的性能，重建质量显著提高。与现有的基于Transformer的方法相比，MSFET-E2V显著减少了参数数量、GPU内存使用和推理时间。
AI.conclusion: MSFET-E2V通过融合时空信息和频域信息，并结合有效的跳跃连接机制，在事件到视频重建任务上取得了显著的性能提升，同时实现了更高效的模型。
AI.translation: 事件相机相比于传统的基于帧的相机具有显著优势，包括高时间分辨率、低延迟和高能效。这些特性使其适用于高速和高动态范围的场景采集；然而，缺乏密集的强度帧限制了传统计算机视觉方法在场景理解上的直接应用。事件到视频（E2V）重建旨在通过将异步事件流转换为同步视频帧序列来弥合这一差距。现有的基于卷积神经网络和Transformer的E2V重建方法主要在空间域操作，并且常常在恢复精细结构细节的同时难以抑制严重的重建伪影。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的多尺度频域增强Transformer模型MSFET-E2V。其核心在于一个跨域注意力模块，它融合了时空特征和从离散小波变换（DWT）派生的频域感知表示。与仅依赖空间注意力的先前方法不同，我们的方法通过考虑低频和高频分量，有效地捕捉局部和全局结构，从而在各种运动场景中增强细节保持和鲁棒性。此外，我们提出了一种轻量级的提升小波增强跳跃连接模块，作为跳跃连接，通过联合的时频域处理来促进伪影抑制和结构细节细化。大量的实验表明，MSFET-E2V在多个真实世界的事件数据集上取得了优于现有最先进方法的性能，在重建质量上实现了显著的提升。此外，与现有的基于Transformer的方法相比，我们提出的模型显著减少了参数数量、GPU内存使用和推理时间。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为MSFET-E2V的新型多尺度频域增强Transformer模型，用于解决事件相机数据到视频重建的挑战。该模型通过引入一个跨域注意力机制，有效地融合了图像的空间-时间特征和通过离散小波变换提取的频率域特征，从而在恢复精细结构细节和抑制重建伪影方面取得了显著进展。此外，研究还设计了一种轻量级的提升小波增强跳跃连接模块，进一步提升了伪影抑制和细节细化能力。实验结果表明，MSFET-E2V在多个真实数据集上超越了现有的最先进方法，并且在模型效率方面（参数量、内存占用、推理时间）也具有明显优势。
AI.keywords: 事件到视频重建, 深度神经网络, Transformer, 频域增强, 小波变换
AI.comments: 该研究提出的MSFET-E2V模型在事件到视频重建领域具有重要意义。通过融合时空和频域信息，并采用创新的跨域注意力和跳跃连接模块，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。模型在重建质量和效率上的双重提升，使其在实际应用中具有广阔前景。然而，对于不同类型事件相机和场景的泛化能力，以及在更复杂动态场景下的表现，仍有待进一步探索。

title: An Analysis Focused on Womens Safety: Can VAD Models Be Enhanced by a Multi-modal Dataset?
summary: Women's safety and security are paramount for a modern society. Crimes against women occur in daylight as well as in low-light conditions. Often, such events are captured through real-world surveillance cameras that operate at lower resolutions. Despite substantial progress in CV-related research, video anomaly detection (VAD) focused on women's safety has not yet been adequately addressed. Existing video anomaly datasets contain well-lit, high-resolution, close-shot videos, and fail to represent women-centric anomalies such as chain snatching, stalking, inappropriate touch, and other subtle forms of crime against women. To address these problems, we propose the ExtrAnom dataset, a new multi-modal benchmark containing 1001 videos with textual descriptions, 500 normal and 501 anomalous, classified into 5 different types of women-centric crimes. The dataset comprises low-light (8%), low-resolution videos (13%), long-shot (15%), along with daylight (64%) anomalous videos. And it covers anomalous events like stalking (3.9%), chain snatching (17.6%), kidnapping (7.3%), assassinations (2.3%), harassment (18.9%), and normal (50%). Each video is supplemented with 4 textual annotations, including one human-generated and three LLM-generated descriptions, enabling cross-modal and VLM-based validations. The aim of creating a women-centric dataset is to accurately detect the women-centric anomaly patterns, which are possible to observe visually. The dataset supplements the VLMs to accurately generate video-level descriptions. ExtrAnom has been benchmarked against popular unimodal and multi-modal VAD datasets (e.g., XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UCA) and SOTA methods. Experiments reveal that the existing datasets are insufficient to train models for detecting women-centric anomalies.

AI.title_translation: 聚焦女性安全的分析：多模态数据集能否增强视频异常检测模型？
AI.tldr: 针对女性安全的视频异常检测研究不足，本文提出了包含多模态标注的ExtrAnom数据集，旨在通过引入真实监控挑战场景，提升模型对女性受害行为的检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视频异常检测数据集多为高质量、光线充足的场景，无法有效识别针对女性的隐蔽性异常行为（如跟踪、骚扰等），且缺乏针对性的数据集进行模型训练。
AI.method: 提出名为ExtrAnom的多模态数据集，包含1001段视频（500正常，501异常），涵盖5种女性中心犯罪类型；视频配备人类与LLM生成的文本标注，支持跨模态及视觉语言模型（VLM）验证。
AI.result: 通过对比实验发现，现有主流数据集在检测女性中心异常行为方面表现不佳；ExtrAnom数据集能有效辅助VLM生成更精确的视频描述，提升异常检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 现有数据集不足以支撑针对女性安全相关异常行为的精确检测，提出的ExtrAnom数据集通过多模态标注和真实场景覆盖，为解决该问题提供了关键基准和研究工具。
AI.translation: 女性的安全与保障是现代社会的首要任务。针对女性的犯罪既发生在白天，也发生在光线不足的情况下。这些事件通常由分辨率较低的现实监控摄像头捕捉。尽管计算机视觉研究取得了实质性进展，但针对女性安全的视频异常检测（VAD）尚未得到充分解决。现有的视频异常数据集多包含光线充足、高分辨率、近景视频，未能代表以女性为中心的异常行为，如抢夺项链、跟踪、不当触摸以及其他形式的针对女性的隐蔽犯罪。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ExtrAnom数据集，这是一个包含1001个带有文本描述视频的新型多模态基准，其中500个为正常，501个为异常，分为5种不同类型的女性中心犯罪。该数据集包括低光（8%）、低分辨率（13%）、远景（15%）以及白天（64%）的异常视频。它涵盖了跟踪（3.9%）、抢夺项链（17.6%）、绑架（7.3%）、暗杀（2.3%）、骚扰（18.9%）和正常（50%）等异常事件。每个视频都补充了4条文本注释，包括一条人工生成的和三条LLM生成的描述，支持跨模态和基于VLM的验证。创建以女性为中心的数据集的目的是准确检测视觉上可观察到的女性中心异常模式。该数据集补充了VLM以准确生成视频级描述。ExtrAnom已针对流行的单模态和多模态VAD数据集（如XD-Violence、UCF-Crime和UCA）以及SOTA方法进行了基准测试。实验表明，现有数据集不足以训练用于检测女性中心异常的模型。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有视频异常检测数据集在女性安全关注度上的缺失，构建了ExtrAnom多模态数据集。该数据集包含多种真实监控场景（含低光、低分辨率视频）及针对女性的异常行为标注，并结合文本描述以支持跨模态分析，旨在提升AI系统对女性受害犯罪行为的识别能力。
AI.keywords: 女性安全, 视频异常检测, 多模态数据集, 计算机视觉, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地填补了视频异常检测（VAD）领域在女性安全防范方面的空白。通过引入多模态（视频+文本）的ExtrAnom数据集，研究不仅关注了传统的高质量视频，还特意包含了低光照、低分辨率和远景等真实监控场景，对于提升实际安防系统的鲁棒性具有重要意义。局限性在于，数据集规模相对较小，且依赖于VLM的辅助，未来可能需要进一步扩大样本多样性。

title: Deterministic and Nonblocking Supervisory Control of Discrete Event Systems under Cyber Attacks
summary: We investigate deterministic and nonblocking supervisory control of discrete event systems under cyber-attacks using the ALTER (Attack Language for Transition-basEd Replacement) model. While prior works consider supervisory control that achieves either the large (upper bound) language or small (lower bound) language separately, deterministic supervisory control achieves both large language and small language at the same time to ensure that the language generated by the supervised system is unique and deterministic. We introduce two new concepts of CA-D-controllability and CA-D-observability and prove that they are necessary and sufficient for the existence of a deterministic supervisor. For nonblocking supervisory control, the objective is to ensure that the supervised system can always reach marked states under any attack scenario. We prove that relative closure, CA-D-controllability, and CA-D-observability together are necessary and sufficient for the existence of a nonblocking supervisor. We further develop methods to verify CA-D-controllability and CA-D-observability. We also illustrate our results using a robotic system example.

AI.title_translation: 离散事件系统在网络攻击下的确定性和非阻塞监督控制
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了在网络攻击下控制离散事件系统的新方法，解决了确定性和非阻塞控制问题，并引入了新的可控性和可观测性概念。
AI.motivation: 解决在网络攻击下实现离散事件系统的确定性和非阻塞监督控制问题，并确保系统行为的唯一性和可达性。
AI.method: 引入了CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability两个新概念，并证明它们是存在确定性监督器的充要条件。对于非阻塞控制，证明了相对闭包、CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability是存在非阻塞监督器的充要条件。开发了验证这些属性的方法。
AI.result: 证明了CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability是确定性监督器存在的充要条件。证明了相对闭包、CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability是实现非阻塞监督器存在的充要条件。开发了验证这些属性的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功地解决了在网络攻击下离散事件系统的确定性和非阻塞监督控制问题，并提出了相应的理论和方法。
AI.translation: 我们使用ALTER（基于转换的攻击语言替换）模型，研究了在网络攻击下离散事件系统的确定性和非阻塞监督控制。虽然先前的工作分别考虑实现大（上限）语言或小（下限）语言的监督控制，但确定性监督控制同时实现大语言和小语言，以确保监督系统生成的语言是唯一和确定的。我们引入了CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability两个新概念，并证明它们是存在确定性监督器的充要条件。对于非阻塞监督控制，目标是确保在任何攻击场景下监督系统都能始终达到标记状态。我们证明了相对闭包、CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability一起是存在非阻塞监督器的充要条件。我们进一步开发了验证CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability的方法。我们还使用机器人系统示例说明了我们的结果。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种在网络攻击下对离散事件系统进行确定性和非阻塞监督控制的新方法。研究引入了CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability两个概念，并证明了它们在实现确定性控制中的必要性和充分性。对于非阻塞控制，研究表明相对闭包、CA-D-controllability和CA-D-observability是实现非阻塞控制的充要条件。此外，研究还开发了验证这些属性的方法，并通过机器人系统示例进行了说明。
AI.keywords: 离散事件系统, 监督控制, 网络攻击, 确定性控制, 非阻塞控制, CA-D-controllability, CA-D-observability
AI.comments: 这项研究在网络安全领域具有重要意义，为应对离散事件系统面临的网络攻击提供了新的理论框架和实用方法。研究提出的新概念和验证方法为设计更鲁棒的控制系统奠定了基础。

title: A multilevel sketch-and-solve method for overdetermined least squares problems
summary:
Sketch-and-solve (SAS) is a very successful method to efficiently estimate the solution of heavily overdetermined large linear least squares problems. It uses random sketching to reduce the size of the problem, hence reducing the computational cost. Several authors have shown that averaging several solutions from SAS further improves the accuracy, which is measured by the residual associated to the approximate solution.
  Going further, we combine solutions from sketch-and-solve in a multilevel manner, such that the approximate solution is a combination of SAS samples obtained from small sketches and more accurate correction terms obtained from larger sketches. We first consider the variance of the estimator, which depends on the variance of the coarse samples and the correction terms. We show that the variance of the correction terms on each level follows a trend and decreases faster than the variance of the simple SAS estimator. However, we then show that the overall computational cost of our multilevel framework is slightly higher than that of the simple average estimator, so a naive application of multilevel methods appears unattractive for least squares problems.

AI.title_translation: 多层草图-求解方法求解超定最小二乘问题
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种多层草图-求解（SAS）方法来提高超定最小二乘问题的求解精度，但计算成本略有增加。
AI.motivation: 现有SAS方法在求解超定最小二乘问题时计算成本高，但通过平均多个SAS解可以提高精度。
AI.method: 将SAS解以多层方式组合，结合了来自小草图的SAS样本和来自大草图的更精确的校正项。
AI.result: 多层SAS方法的校正项方差呈下降趋势，且下降速度比简单SAS估计量的方差快。然而，多层框架的总计算成本略高于简单平均估计量。
AI.conclusion: 虽然多层SAS方法在理论上可以提高精度，但其计算成本的增加使得直接应用对最小二乘问题并不具有吸引力。
AI.translation:
草图-求解（SAS）是一种非常成功的方法，可以有效地估计超定大型线性最小二乘问题的解。它使用随机草图来减小问题的大小，从而降低计算成本。几位作者已经证明，平均SAS的多个解可以进一步提高精度，这种精度通过近似解的残差来衡量。
更进一步，我们将SAS解以多层方式组合，使得近似解是来自小草图的SAS样本和来自大草图的更精确的校正项的组合。我们首先考虑估计量的方差，它取决于粗糙样本和校正项的方差。我们证明了每个层上的校正项方差遵循一个趋势，并且比简单SAS估计量的方差下降得更快。然而，我们随后证明了我们的多层框架的整体计算成本略高于简单平均估计量，因此，对于最小二乘问题，多层方法的简单应用似乎没有吸引力。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种多层草图-求解（SAS）方法，通过结合不同大小草图的SAS样本和校正项来提高超定最小二乘问题的求解精度。虽然该方法在理论上显示出校正项方差的下降趋势，但整体计算成本略高于简单的平均SAS方法，因此其直接应用对最小二乘问题可能不具吸引力。
AI.keywords: 草图-求解, 最小二乘问题, 多层方法, 方差分析, 计算成本
AI.comments: 该研究在SAS方法的基础上提出了多层组合思想，试图在精度和计算成本之间取得更好的平衡。虽然结果表明直接应用可能不具吸引力，但该思路为后续研究提供了借鉴，例如通过优化草图大小选择或结合策略来降低计算成本，同时保持或提高精度。

title: Data-driven Head Motion Generation through Natural Gaze-Head Coordination
summary: We present the first data-driven approach to model temporal gaze-head coordination from large-scale in-the-wild facial videos. To obtain training data for generalizable learning, we propose an automatic pipeline that extracts natural yet diverse gaze and head motions with off-the-shelf appearance-based gaze estimators. To capture the probabilistic correlation and temporal dynamics of gaze-head coordination, we build our model on a generative conditional Variational Autoencoder for plausible yet diverse gaze-conditioned head motion generations. We further apply our framework to gaze-controlled facial video generation, where we enable video generation with natural and realistic head motion correlated to the input gaze - an aspect that has not been emphasized before. Human evaluation and quantitative comparisons demonstrate our method's effectiveness and validate our design choices, with evaluators showing statistically significant preference for our approach over baseline methods.

AI.title_translation: 通过自然注视-头部协调实现数据驱动的头部运动生成
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用条件变分自编码器学习自然注视-头部协调模式的方法，实现了由注视引导的、具有高度真实感的头部运动生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的面部视频生成技术往往忽视了注视与头部运动之间自然的协调关系，导致生成结果缺乏真实感。作者旨在通过数据驱动的方法学习这种协调模式，从而提升生成视频的自然度。
AI.method: 构建了一个自动处理流水线，从大规模野外视频中提取注视和头部运动数据；采用生成式条件变分自编码器（CVAE）建模注视与头部运动之间的概率相关性和时间动态，实现注视引导的头部运动生成。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该模型能够生成与输入注视自然相关的逼真头部运动；人类评估和定量对比显示，该方法在自然度和真实性方面显著优于基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的方法能够有效捕捉注视与头部运动之间的概率相关性和时间动态，为实现更自然、更具交互性的面部动画生成提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 我们提出了首个从大规模野外面部视频中建模时间性注视-头部协调的数据驱动方法。为了获得可泛化学习的训练数据，我们提出了一个自动流水线，利用现成的基于外观的注视估计器提取自然且多样的注视和头部运动。为了捕捉注视-头部协调的概率相关性和时间动态，我们将模型构建在生成式条件变分自编码器上，用于生成合理且多样的注视条件下的头部运动。我们进一步将该框架应用于注视控制的面部视频生成，实现了与输入注视相关联的自然且逼真的头部运动生成——这是一个之前未被强调的方面。人类评估和定量比较证明了我们方法的有效性并验证了我们的设计选择，评估者在统计学上显著偏好我们的方法而非基准方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，用于从大规模野外视频中学习注视与头部运动的协调模式。作者设计了一个自动数据提取流程，并利用条件变分自编码器建模两者间的动态相关性，实现了注视驱动的逼真头部运动生成，有效提升了面部视频生成的自然感。
AI.keywords: 注视-头部协调, 数据驱动, 条件变分自编码器, 视频生成, 面部动画
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次利用大规模野外视频数据，构建了基于自然注视-头部协调的数据驱动模型，并将其成功应用于注视驱动的逼真面部视频生成，填补了该领域在头部运动关联性方面的空白。

title: Extending Embodied Question Answering from Perception to Decision
summary: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) connects perception, reasoning, and interaction within embodied environments. However, existing datasets and benchmarks remain fragmented, each focusing on a limited subset of reasoning skills such as spatial understanding or procedural reasoning, without offering a unified large-scale framework for comprehensive evaluation. We present EQA-Decision, a large-scale embodied QA dataset that systematically covers four complementary dimensions of embodied reasoning: static scene construction, spatial understanding, task dynamics reasoning, and instant decision. The dataset contains over four million question-answer pairs with hierarchical annotations across diverse embodied scenarios. In addition, we develop RoboDecision, a strong baseline model aligned with the EQA-Decision Benchmark, providing a unified framework that jointly evaluates perception, reasoning, and action-level decision-making in embodied environments. Results demonstrate that EQA-Decision effectively benchmarks and enhances VLM capabilities in spatial and interaction reasoning, providing a solid foundation for advancing embodied intelligence research.

title: Adaptive Graph Refinement and Label Propagation with LLMs for Cost-Effective Entity Resolution
summary: Dirty entity resolution (ER), which identifies records referring to the same real-world entity from a single, messy dataset, is a fundamental task in data management and mining. However, the dominant blocking-matching-clustering paradigm for ER suffers from critical flaws. Its cascaded, decoupled workflow essentially produces a static, sparse graph plagued by missing edges (due to blocking failures) and noisy links (due to matching errors), causing error propagation and yielding suboptimal clusters, particularly when rigid transitivity is imposed in the clustering. We contend that matching and clustering are fundamentally synergistic, both optimizing for the construction of an ideal entity graph. Building upon this insight, we propose Alper, a unified framework that integrates these steps into an iterative probabilistic label propagation process over a global, evolving graph. Unlike disjoint blocking, Alper refines the graph structure and labels dynamically by adaptively integrating "weak but cheap" signals from graph propagation with "strong but expensive" LLM-based pairwise queries. For higher cost-effectiveness, we formulate the signal selection as a constrained optimization problem maximizing cumulative marginal gain under a query budget, solved via our greedy algorithm with provable theoretical guarantees. Our extensive experiments over eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that Alper is consistently superior to state-of-the-art cascaded pipelines.

title: Behind EvoMap: Characterizing a Self-Evolving Agent-to-Agent Collaboration Network
summary: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks enable autonomous AI agents to collaborate by sharing reusable problem-solving instructions. However, how these decentralized ecosystems operate in practice remains largely unexplored. We present the first large-scale empirical study of EvoMap, a prominent A2A collaboration network. By analyzing over 1.5M assets and 128K agents, we show how design choices that prioritize scalable growth introduce trade-offs in reusability, evolution, and auditability. First, EvoMap's credit economy rewards agents for publishing valuable assets. Although this design encourages participation at scale, rewards are tied primarily to publication rather than adoption. This leads agents to mass-produce assets to accumulate credits. As a result, 98% of assets are never reused, while rewards become highly concentrated among a small fraction of agents. Second, EvoMap employs an algorithm (referred to as GDI) to score and rank the quality of these shared assets. We demonstrate that this scoring system is flawed: rather than measuring objective performance, an asset's rank is heavily dictated by unverified, self-reported metadata (e.g., claimed lines of code modified). This allows agents to trivially manipulate their asset's scores. Finally, EvoMap relies on agents to provide local execution logs as evidence that uploaded assets function correctly. Because these validations are not independently verified, over 84% of approved assets bypass quality checks using vacuous tests (e.g., console.log). Our findings show that future A2A collaboration networks cannot rely on unverified self-reporting alone. Scalable collaboration requires mechanisms that balance open participation with verifiable execution and trustworthy evaluation.

title: Fine-Tuning Over Architectural Complexity: Broad-Coverage PII Detection on PIIBench with DeBERTa
summary: Personally identifiable information (PII) detection systems are frequently trained within narrow source or domain boundaries, limiting coverage when deployed on heterogeneous text. We study model fine-tuning on a corrected multi-source PIIBench preparation spanning 82 retained entity types across ten source datasets. We evaluate three DeBERTa-based approaches: direct token classification fine-tuning, a source-conditioned hierarchical model (SC+H), and a three-phase curriculum extension (SC+H+Curr). Against eight published comparator systems on a reproducible 5,000-record held-out subset (test_5k), direct fine-tuned DeBERTa achieves F1 0.6476, while SC+H and the curriculum variant achieve 0.5899 and 0.2772 respectively; the strongest published comparator reaches only 0.1723. Because validation initially favoured SC+H, we perform a final streamed evaluation on the complete 100,002-record held-out split. Direct fine-tuning remains superior, achieving F1 0.6455 versus 0.5894 for SC+H. Entity-level analysis shows that direct fine tuning wins 54 of 82 fine entity types and all ten coarse groups by support-weighted entity F1, while SC+H retains localised advantages on 28 types. The results indicate that diverse task-specific training data and a simple weighted cross-entropy objective contribute more to broad-coverage PII detection than the tested architectural and curriculum complexity.

title: Hardware-Efficient and Performance-Enhanced Joint Pulse Shaping and Dispersion Compensation for Coherent Data Center Interconnects
summary: With the explosion of data traffic triggered by 5G/6G and Generative artificial intelligence, coherent optical communication is moving towards higher baud rates and more complex modulation formats. This leads to a significant increase in the computational complexity and power consumption of digital signal processing (DSP) at the transmitter and receiver ends, especially in the chromatic dispersion(CD) Compensation and low roll-off shaping filter modules. We propose a joint shaping filtering and CD compensation (JFS-CD) algorithm. This algorithm moves the CD compensation to the transmitter side and utilizes the characteristics of discrete fourier transform and the spectral features of shaping filtering for integrated processing. Aiming at the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) problem caused by chromatic dispersion pre-compensation, we propose a low-complexity square boundary clipping algorithm(SBC). Simulation results show that, under the premise of maintaining unchanged performance, JFS-CD can reduce the real multiplication complexity by about 46%. Meanwhile, benefiting from the suppression of the effects of system nonlinearity and receiver IQ imbalance, the joint JFS-CD and SBC scheme improves the Q-factor by about 0.3 dB in experiments compared to the traditional post-chromatic dispersion compensation scheme. This research provides a highly potential transmitter DSP solution for next-generation low-power and high-performance data center interconnects (DCI).

title: On Reliability of Efficient Membership Inference Vulnerability Evaluation
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are popular methods for empirically assessing the leakage of sensitive information in the training data through models or statistics learned from the data. The MIA vulnerability is often evaluated through false positive rate (FPR) and true positive rate (TPR) of a binary classifier that tries to predict whether a particular sample was in the training data. However, in order to reliably estimate the TPR especially for low FPR values, a lot of observations are needed, which in case of MIA translates to many target models, leading to large computational cost. To avoid excessive compute requirements, the MIA scores are often averaged over multiple individuals and multiple targeted models. We demonstrate two key weaknesses in this efficient MIA evaluation pipeline. First, we show that evaluating the TPR based on MIA scores concatenated across multiple individuals, commonly used to study vulnerabilities in the very low FPR regime, is not calibrated across the per-sample FPRs. This makes it unreliable as a tool for auditing differential privacy. To solve this, we propose a post-processing method to effectively calibrate the FPR across different samples. Second, we identify a finite population bias in the commonly used efficient likelihood-ratio attack (LiRA) implementation proposed by Carlini et al. 2022, leading to a positive bias in the per-sample vulnerability.

title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps. Existing confidence-based decoding ranks masked positions independently and commits the top-K positions, largely ignoring whether the committed tokens provide complementary visual grounding. We identify a step-level limitation of this strategy in multimodal settings: high-confidence tokens selected in the same step can rely on overlapping visual grounding, introducing visual redundancy among the committed tokens and leaving less complementary visual grounding available for later decoding. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Visual Redundancy Index (VRI), which measures visual grounding overlap among tokens committed in parallel. To control this redundancy during decoding, we propose Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Decoding (VRCD), a training-free inference-time decoding method that uses token-to-image attention to prioritize visually complementary positions. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks, VRCD reduces visual redundancy and remaining-position entropy with modest runtime overhead. In longer decoding experiments, it also achieves relative accuracy gains of up to 18.8% on M^3CoT and 6.9% on MMBench over confidence-based decoding. Code will be released at https://github.com/infiniteYuanyl/VRCD.

title: [CLS] is Not Enough: Multi-Label Recognition via Patch-Level Inference and Adaptive Aggregation
summary: Vision-Language Models such as CLIP exhibit strong zero-shot recognition capability by aligning images with textual concepts, yet they often underperform on multi-label recognition where multiple objects co-exist. A key bottleneck is that the [CLS] token, as a single global visual representation, is insufficient to faithfully encode diverse targets with varying scales, contexts, and co-occurrence patterns. To address this limitation, we present a new multi-label image recognition framework, termed PIAA, which formulates prediction as Patch-level Inference followed by Adaptive Aggregation. Specifically, we first enhance patch-wise predictions from two complementary perspectives: (i) mitigating semantic entanglement in the visual encoder to obtain more discriminative patch representations, and (ii) learning an unsupervised visual classifier to narrow the vision-language modality gap. We then introduce an adaptive aggregation module that consolidates patch-level scores into the final multi-label prediction. Notably, the entire pipeline is fully training-free, requiring no gradient updates or parameter fine-tuning. Experiments show that our method achieves strong improvements with minimal extra computation, exceeding a 6% mAP gain on the challenging NUS-WIDE benchmark over representative baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/akang-wang/PIAA.

title: "What is the Problem Space?" Defining Host-space Adversarial Perturbations against Network Intrusion Detection Systems
summary:
Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) are now increasingly leveraging Machine Learning (ML) techniques to detect malicious network activities. Numerous papers have scrutinized the security of ML-based NIDS (ML-NIDS) by testing them against various attacks involving adversarial perturbations. The findings were oftentimes worrying: by making imperceptible changes to a given input, powerful ML models would be bypassed. In this context, we took a step back and wondered: where (i.e., in what "space") have these perturbations been applied?
  We argue that real-world adversaries can apply adversarial perturbations only by operating on the hosts they can control -- a concept which we define as _host-space perturbations_. To some, such an observation may seem trivial. And yet, through a systematic literature review (n=316), we found that prior work applied perturbations by manipulating pre-collected datapoints (e.g., a packet _captured by the router_, or a network flow _analysed by the ML-NIDS_). Such operations, while not impossible, may be outside the reach of an attacker who can only control some (unprivileged) hosts in a network. Hence, to demonstrate how to craft host-space perturbations and study some of their effects, we experimented on well-known benchmarks and a real-world network. We show that ML-NIDS that can detect the SSH-bruteforcing attempts launched via a given command string cannot detect any attempt launched by changing _a single character_ of such a string. We then examined how such a minuscule change in the "problem space" (i.e., the attacker's host) can lead to devastating effects on the "feature space". We derive lessons learned on how to practically assess host-space perturbations. Our stance is that the security of ML-NIDS should be re-assessed.

title: Branched Signature Kernel Solvers for ODEs with rough Single-Trajectory signals
summary: We develop a branched signature kernel solver for linear and nonlinear ordinary differential equations driven by a \emph{single observed trajectory} of a possibly rough forcing signal -- a setting that arises naturally in earthquake engineering, finance, biology, and structural health monitoring, where the forcing is observed exactly once and the solver must respect the underlying physical law without recourse to an ensemble of realizations. Two ingredients are new. First, a \emph{count-sampling} construction turns the single observation into a hierarchical family of $N+1$ nested training paths on which the branched signature kernel can be evaluated; this allows the signature kernel machinery, originally designed for multi-realization regression problems, to operate on a single-trajectory observation. Second, a kernel-collocation framework places the ansatz either on the highest-order derivative of the solution (with lower derivatives recovered by integrating the kernel) or on the solution itself (after $m$-fold integration of the ODE). We prove a universal approximation theorem for the branched signature kernel, leveraging the Hairer--Kelly morphism to express branched signature evaluations through geometric signatures of time-extended paths. The offline solver is extended to a streaming Test/Train/Retrain protocol with closed-form online updates in the linear case and scalar Newton steps in the nonlinear case. Numerical experiments on six benchmarks (El-Centro earthquake displacement, the Solow capital-stock model, an fBM-driven second-order ODE, a forced Duffing oscillator, a path-dependent Arias-intensity-degraded oscillator with variable coefficients, and a noisy Kuramoto phase-oscillator system) show that the branched signature-kernel solver delivers accurate, stable predictions across all regimes.

title: OASIS: Observation-Action Space Alignment via SE(3) Trajectory Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs) advance robotic manipulation by enriching intermediate representations with auxiliary spatial features or future visual-state prediction. However, these representations largely remain within the observation space and do not share the rigid-body geometry of the action space, forcing the action decoder to implicitly recover this geometry. We propose OASIS, a visuomotor policy that aligns the intermediate representation with the action space via $SE(3)$ end-effector trajectory prediction. OASIS couples a 3D-aware feature encoder that fuses vision-language and metric-depth features with an $SE(3)$ trajectory predictor that produces a camera-frame end-effector trajectory. Conditioned on the predictor's pose-supervised hidden states, the action decoder generates action chunks consistent with rigid-body motion. Across simulation and real-world experiments, OASIS outperforms VLA and WAM baselines in success rate and out-of-distribution generalization. Our project page is available at https://npuhandsome.github.io/OASIS_web.

title: Clarify, Abstain or Answer? Strategising in Conversation with Belief-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) define a distribution over text, which can be viewed as a probabilistic representation of uncertainty: sampling K responses yields a belief state - responses a model deems plausible. Existing work exploits this representation for narrow tasks like either decoding or selective prediction, and often requires manual interventions, not controlling generation directly. We propose Belief-Augmented Generation (BAG): grounding LLMs in their own belief state via the prompt and letting them reason over these K samples to decide on a conversational strategy: answer, clarify, or abstain. In a multi-turn ambiguous QA setting, we find that LLMs by default rarely clarify or abstain, ignoring uncertainty about the input or facts. BAG improves QA accuracy across six models and yields strategy decisions more faithful to the belief state than prompt-only baselines. Disentangling when to clarify from when to abstain, however, remains challenging.

title: When Search Becomes Memory: Turning Robot Design Trials into Transferable Skills
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proposal generators for evolutionary robot design, yet most loops remain memoryless: simulator results shape the next population but are not preserved as reusable design knowledge. We present Auto-Robotist, a self-evolving LLM agent that distills morphology-search traces into an explicit natural-language skill library. Each skill stores a structural archetype, evidence-grounded positive and negative rules, and the evaluated designs that support them, making design memory inspectable rather than implicit in a population. During search, the agent retrieves skills to condition LLM edits of elite bodies while retaining a Genetic Algorithm (GA) mutation path for exploration; after evaluation, it updates the library through Add, Diagnose, and Merge. Across seven EvoGym tasks spanning locomotion, traversal, and object interaction, Auto-Robotist improves cold-start 5x5 search and transfers learned skills to 10x10 design spaces, where reference-conditioned transfer outperforms GA on every task. These results suggest that LLM agents can convert expensive physical evaluations into reusable, auditable design principles. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

title: Context-Instrumental Data Distillation for Kubernetes Manifest Generation: Method and Experimental Evaluation
summary: This paper examines the specialization of Small Language Models (SLMs) with up to 4 billion parameters for generating artifacts in domain-specific languages (DSL). Kubernetes manifests are chosen as the target domain. We propose the context-instrumental data distillation method: the source corpus is formed through synthetic generation and, in an extended scheme, through reverse instruction generation from real Kubernetes YAML files, with pairs included in training only upon passing external validators and matching the domain context model. Unlike classical KL-divergence knowledge distillation, the baseline implementation reduces to supervised fine-tuning on instrumentally verified examples. The experimental section presents a pilot implementation under resource-constrained conditions: the DeepSeek-V4 Flash API serves as the teacher for synthetic generation, while Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct is fine-tuned via LoRA on CPU. On the K8s-Distill-Pilot corpus (train_1200, validation_100, test_200), we achieved full-pass@1 = 91.5% (183/200) with a stricter prompt formulation and max_new_tokens=768. The key empirical finding is that for Kubernetes YAML, result quality in the pilot depended more on strict output format requirements than on simply increasing the number of training examples.

title: TTPrint: Evidence-Grounded TTP Extraction via Diverge-then-Converge Verification
summary: Extracting MITRE ATT&CK techniques from cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports is an open-set, multi-label problem requiring both high recall (not missing techniques) and high precision (not hallucinating unsupported ones). Existing methods--rule-based, supervised, and LLM-based--struggle to achieve both: rule-based and supervised approaches lack generalizability across diverse attack descriptions, while LLM-based approaches that couple candidate generation and validation within a single inference step suffer from limited recall and precision simultaneously. We propose TTPrint, which addresses this challenge through a diverge-then-converge design inspired by how human analysts work: first extracting broadly, then verifying rigorously. In the divergent phase, reports are decomposed into atomic behaviors and candidate techniques are proposed broadly. A deterministic span localization stage then anchors each candidate to a specific evidence window in the source text. A convergent verification stage retains only candidates supported by both the localized evidence and the authoritative MITRE definition. We contribute two evaluation resources--a cleaned TRAM benchmark (TRAM-Clean) and a new annotated dataset (TTPrint-Bench)--to address known annotation noise in existing benchmarks and elevate the task to document-level TTP extraction. On TRAM-Clean and TTPrint-Bench, TTPrint achieves 76.48% and 87.39% macro-F1 respectively, outperforming the leading baseline by 63.5% and 29.4%. A multi-backbone analysis across six LLMs and a threshold sensitivity study further demonstrate generalizability across model choices and provide practical guidance for parameter selection.

title: Same Data, Different Schemas: Robustness of LLM-based Text-to-SQL
comments: Accepted for publication at Nineth International Workshop on Exploiting Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Data Management (aiDM '26), co-located with ACM SIGMOD 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) consistently achieve strong results on text-to-SQL benchmarks, but their robustness to schema variations remains poorly understood. Recent work suggests that the schema structure matters, but does not provide a clear and systematic way to evaluate model behavior when different schemas represent the same underlying data. We address this problem by presenting a framework to evaluate and benchmark text-to-SQL techniques over equivalent relational schemas generated from a common E/R model. By varying the ``shredding'' choices used to translate the conceptual design into relations, we create multiple schema variants that differ structurally while preserving the same underlying semantics. This gives us a controlled setting in which the natural language questions and data remain fixed, and only the schema changes. We use this framework to evaluate four leading LLMs on the same questions across multiple schema variants (for two separate domains), and summarize consistency patterns using pairwise comparison heatmaps. Our results show that schema structure significantly affects LLM behavior: across conceptually equivalent schemas, models often produce SQL queries with very different answers. We also find that providing additional context (specifically, the original E/R specification) improves the performance, but does not fully ameliorate the inconsistencies. In addition to demonstrating that the current text-to-SQL evaluations miss an important notion of robustness, our framework provides a way to generate a large number of synthetic datasets that can be used to train new models, and suggests a mechanism to make text-to-SQL more robust by generating additional candidate plans for a given natural language query through systematic schema variations.
