AI.title_translation: PolySAE：通过多项式解码建模稀疏自编码器中的特征交互
AI.tldr: PolySAE通过多项式解码器捕获稀疏自编码器中的特征交互，提高了可解释性并区分了组合结构与共现。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏自编码器（SAEs）假设特征通过线性重建进行加性组合，无法捕获组合结构，例如无法区分“星巴克”是来自“星”和“咖啡”特征的组合还是仅仅它们的共现。这导致SAEs为复合概念分配整体特征，而非将其分解为可解释的组成部分。
AI.method: 引入PolySAE，通过高阶项扩展SAE解码器来建模特征交互，同时保留了对可解释性至关重要的线性编码器。通过在共享投影子空间上进行低秩张量分解，PolySAE以较小的参数开销（GPT2上为3%）捕获成对和三重特征交互。
AI.result: PolySAE在探测F1分数上平均提高了约8%，同时保持了相当的重建误差。在类别条件特征分布之间产生了2-10倍大的Wasserstein距离。学习到的交互权重与共现频率的相关性可忽略不计（r = 0.06 vs r = 0.82 for SAE feature covariance），表明多项式项捕获的组合结构与表面统计数据基本无关。学习到的交互方向因果地将模型输出引导至相应的组合语义。
AI.conclusion: PolySAE通过建模特征交互成功地捕获了组合结构，提高了可解释性，并且其交互权重独立于表面统计数据，能够因果地影响模型输出。
AI.translation: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）通过将激活分解为字典原子的稀疏组合来解释神经网络表示。然而，SAEs假设特征通过线性重建进行加性组合，这一假设无法捕获组合结构：线性模型无法区分“星巴克”是来自“星”和“咖啡”特征的组合还是仅仅它们的共现。这迫使SAEs为复合概念分配整体特征，而不是将其分解为可解释的组成部分。我们引入了PolySAE，它通过高阶项扩展了SAE解码器以建模特征交互，同时保留了对可解释性至关重要的线性编码器。通过在共享投影子空间上进行低秩张量分解，PolySAE以较小的参数开销（GPT2上为3%）捕获成对和三重特征交互。在四种语言模型和三种SAE变体上，PolySAE在探测F1分数上平均提高了约8%，同时保持了相当的重建误差，并在类别条件特征分布之间产生了2-10倍大的Wasserstein距离。重要的是，学习到的交互权重与共现频率的相关性可忽略不计（r = 0.06，而SAE特征协方差为r = 0.82），这表明多项式项捕获的组合结构在很大程度上独立于表面统计数据。最后，学习到的交互方向因果地将模型输出引导至相应的组合语义。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PolySAE，一种扩展稀疏自编码器（SAE）的方法，通过引入多项式解码器来建模特征之间的非线性交互。与传统SAE的线性加性假设不同，PolySAE能够捕获更复杂的组合结构，区分概念的组合与简单共现。它通过低秩张量分解实现，参数开销小，并在语言模型上显著提升了特征的可解释性和性能，同时证明其捕获的交互独立于表面共现频率，并能因果地影响模型输出。
AI.keywords: 稀疏自编码器, 特征交互, 多项式解码, 可解释性, 组合结构
AI.comments: PolySAE的创新之处在于通过引入多项式解码器来解决传统SAE无法捕获特征组合结构的问题，同时保持了编码器的线性以确保可解释性。它通过低秩张量分解有效地控制了参数开销，并在实验中证明其捕获的组合结构与表面共现频率无关，这对于理解神经网络的深层语义表示具有重要意义。该方法为提高神经网络的可解释性提供了一个新颖且有效途径。

title: Generative Visual Code Mobile World Models
summary: Mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) World Models (WMs) offer a promising path for improving mobile GUI agent performance at train- and inference-time. However, current approaches face a critical trade-off: text-based WMs sacrifice visual fidelity, while the inability of visual WMs in precise text rendering led to their reliance on slow, complex pipelines dependent on numerous external models. We propose a novel paradigm: visual world modeling via renderable code generation, where a single Vision-Language Model (VLM) predicts the next GUI state as executable web code that renders to pixels, rather than generating pixels directly. This combines the strengths of both approaches: VLMs retain their linguistic priors for precise text rendering while their pre-training on structured web code enables high-fidelity visual generation. We introduce gWorld (8B, 32B), the first open-weight visual mobile GUI WMs built on this paradigm, along with a data generation framework (gWorld) that automatically synthesizes code-based training data. In extensive evaluation across 4 in- and 2 out-of-distribution benchmarks, gWorld sets a new pareto frontier in accuracy versus model size, outperforming 8 frontier open-weight models over 50.25x larger. Further analyses show that (1) scaling training data via gWorld yields meaningful gains, (2) each component of our pipeline improves data quality, and (3) stronger world modeling improves downstream mobile GUI policy performance.

AI.title_translation: 生成式视觉代码移动世界模型
AI.tldr: gWorld提出了一种通过生成可渲染网络代码而非直接生成像素的视觉世界建模新范式，解决了当前移动GUI世界模型在视觉保真度和文本渲染上的权衡问题，并在准确性和模型尺寸方面取得了显著优势。
AI.motivation: 当前移动图形用户界面（GUI）世界模型面临关键权衡：基于文本的世界模型牺牲视觉保真度，而视觉世界模型无法精确渲染文本，导致其依赖缓慢、复杂的外部模型管道。
AI.method: 提出了一种通过可渲染代码生成进行视觉世界建模的新范式。一个单一的视觉-语言模型（VLM）预测下一个GUI状态为可执行的网络代码，该代码渲染为像素，而不是直接生成像素。这结合了两种方法的优点，即VLM保留其语言先验以进行精确文本渲染，并通过结构化网络代码预训练实现高保真视觉生成。引入了gWorld（8B，32B），第一个基于此范式的开源视觉移动GUI世界模型，以及一个自动合成基于代码的训练数据的数据生成框架（gWorld）。
AI.result: 在4个分布内和2个分布外基准测试的广泛评估中，gWorld在准确性与模型尺寸方面设定了新的帕累托前沿，性能优于8个前沿开源模型，且模型尺寸小50.25倍以上。进一步分析表明：(1) 通过gWorld扩展训练数据可获得显著收益；(2) 管道的每个组件都提高了数据质量；(3) 更强的世界建模改进了下游移动GUI策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成可渲染代码的视觉世界建模范式（gWorld）有效解决了移动GUI世界模型的现有挑战，实现了卓越的准确性和效率，并提升了下游策略性能。
AI.translation: 移动图形用户界面（GUI）世界模型（WMs）为在训练和推理时提高移动GUI智能体性能提供了一条有前景的道路。然而，当前方法面临一个关键的权衡：基于文本的世界模型牺牲了视觉保真度，而视觉世界模型无法精确渲染文本，导致它们依赖缓慢、复杂的、依赖众多外部模型的管道。我们提出了一种新颖的范式：通过可渲染代码生成进行视觉世界建模，其中一个单一的视觉-语言模型（VLM）将下一个GUI状态预测为可执行的网络代码，该代码渲染为像素，而不是直接生成像素。这结合了两种方法的优点：VLM保留其语言先验以进行精确文本渲染，同时其在结构化网络代码上的预训练能够实现高保真视觉生成。我们引入了gWorld（8B，32B），第一个基于此范式的开源视觉移动GUI世界模型，以及一个自动合成基于代码的训练数据的数据生成框架（gWorld）。在对4个分布内和2个分布外基准的广泛评估中，gWorld在准确性与模型尺寸方面设定了新的帕累托前沿，性能优于8个前沿开源模型，且模型尺寸大50.25倍以上。进一步分析表明：(1) 通过gWorld扩展训练数据可获得显著收益，(2) 我们管道的每个组件都提高了数据质量，(3) 更强的世界建模改进了下游移动GUI策略性能。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为gWorld的新型移动GUI世界模型，通过生成可渲染的网络代码来预测下一个GUI状态，而非直接生成像素。这种方法结合了视觉-语言模型在文本渲染和高保真视觉生成方面的优势，解决了现有文本和视觉世界模型在视觉保真度与文本精确性之间的权衡。gWorld在多项基准测试中展现出卓越的性能，以更小的模型尺寸超越了现有顶级模型，并证明了其数据生成框架和世界建模能力对下游任务的有效性。
AI.keywords: 生成式视觉代码, 移动世界模型, GUI, 视觉-语言模型, gWorld
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了通过可渲染代码生成进行视觉世界建模的范式，巧妙地解决了现有移动GUI世界模型在视觉保真度和文本渲染上的固有矛盾。通过让VLM生成可执行的网络代码而非像素，模型能够同时利用语言先验进行精确文本渲染和结构化代码预训练进行高保真视觉生成，极大地提高了效率和准确性。gWorld在性能上显著优于现有模型，展示了该范式的巨大潜力。

title: Towards Long-Horizon Interpretability: Efficient and Faithful Multi-Token Attribution for Reasoning LLMs
comments: Accepted as a Spotlight paper at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/wbopan/flashtrace
summary: Token attribution methods provide intuitive explanations for language model outputs by identifying causally important input tokens. However, as modern LLMs increasingly rely on extended reasoning chains, existing schemes face two critical challenges: (1) efficiency bottleneck, where attributing a target span of M tokens within a context of length N requires O(M*N) operations, making long-context attribution prohibitively slow; and (2) faithfulness drop, where intermediate reasoning tokens absorb attribution mass, preventing importance from propagating back to the original input. To address these, we introduce FlashTrace, an efficient multi-token attribution method that employs span-wise aggregation to compute attribution over multi-token targets in a single pass, while maintaining faithfulness. Moreover, we design a recursive attribution mechanism that traces importance through intermediate reasoning chains back to source inputs. Extensive experiments on long-context retrieval (RULER) and multi-step reasoning (MATH, MorehopQA) tasks demonstrate that FlashTrace achieves over 130x speedup over existing baselines while maintaining superior faithfulness. We further analyze the dynamics of recursive attribution, showing that even a single recursive hop improves faithfulness by tracing importance through the reasoning chain.
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight paper at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/wbopan/flashtrace

AI.title_translation: 走向长距离可解释性：推理LLM的高效忠实多token归因
AI.tldr: 现有的token归因方法在处理长上下文和多步推理LLM时面临效率和忠实性挑战。FlashTrace通过跨度聚合和递归归因机制，显著提高了归因速度（>130倍）并增强了忠实性，有效解决了这些问题。
AI.motivation: 现有token归因方法在处理长上下文和多步推理LLM时，面临效率瓶颈（O(M*N)操作）和忠实性下降（中间推理token吸收归因权重，导致重要性无法回溯到原始输入）的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了FlashTrace，一种高效的多token归因方法。它采用跨度聚合（span-wise aggregation）在单次处理中计算多token目标的归因，并设计了递归归因机制（recursive attribution mechanism），将重要性从中间推理链追溯回源输入。
AI.result: 在长上下文检索（RULER）和多步推理（MATH, MorehopQA）任务上，FlashTrace比现有基线方法提速超过130倍，同时保持了卓越的忠实性。递归归因机制，即使是单次递归跳跃，也能通过追溯推理链中的重要性来提高忠实性。
AI.conclusion: FlashTrace通过其高效的跨度聚合和忠实的递归归因机制，有效解决了长上下文和多步推理LLM中token归因的效率和忠实性问题，显著提升了解释性能。
AI.translation: Token归因方法通过识别具有因果重要性的输入token，为语言模型输出提供直观解释。然而，随着现代LLM越来越依赖扩展的推理链，现有方案面临两个关键挑战：(1) 效率瓶颈，在长度为N的上下文中归因M个目标token需要O(M*N)次操作，使得长上下文归因速度极慢；(2) 忠实性下降，中间推理token吸收归因权重，阻止重要性传播回原始输入。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了FlashTrace，一种高效的多token归因方法，它采用跨度聚合在单次处理中计算多token目标的归因，同时保持忠实性。此外，我们设计了一种递归归因机制，将重要性通过中间推理链追溯回源输入。在长上下文检索（RULER）和多步推理（MATH, MorehopQA）任务上的大量实验表明，FlashTrace比现有基线方法提速超过130倍，同时保持了卓越的忠实性。我们进一步分析了递归归因的动态，表明即使是单次递归跳跃也能通过追溯推理链中的重要性来提高忠实性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FlashTrace，一种针对推理LLM的高效且忠实的多token归因方法，旨在解决现有方法在长上下文和多步推理中面临的效率和忠实性问题。FlashTrace通过跨度聚合实现单次处理多token归因，并引入递归归因机制将重要性追溯到原始输入。实验证明，FlashTrace在多种任务上实现了显著的加速（130倍以上）和更高的忠实性。
AI.keywords: token归因, LLM可解释性, FlashTrace, 递归归因, 长上下文
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过提出FlashTrace，有效地解决了大型语言模型在长上下文和多步推理场景下可解释性面临的效率和忠实性两大挑战。其创新点在于结合了跨度聚合和递归归因机制，实现了显著的性能提升。这对于理解和调试复杂LLM的推理过程具有重要意义，尤其是在需要高可解释性的应用场景中。

title: Emergent Analogical Reasoning in Transformers
summary: Analogy is a central faculty of human intelligence, enabling abstract patterns discovered in one domain to be applied to another. Despite its central role in cognition, the mechanisms by which Transformers acquire and implement analogical reasoning remain poorly understood. In this work, inspired by the notion of functors in category theory, we formalize analogical reasoning as the inference of correspondences between entities across categories. Based on this formulation, we introduce synthetic tasks that evaluate the emergence of analogical reasoning under controlled settings. We find that the emergence of analogical reasoning is highly sensitive to data characteristics, optimization choices, and model scale. Through mechanistic analysis, we show that analogical reasoning in Transformers decomposes into two key components: (1) geometric alignment of relational structure in the embedding space, and (2) the application of a functor within the Transformer. These mechanisms enable models to transfer relational structure from one category to another, realizing analogy. Finally, we quantify these effects and find that the same trends are observed in pretrained LLMs. In doing so, we move analogy from an abstract cognitive notion to a concrete, mechanistically grounded phenomenon in modern neural networks.

AI.title_translation: 变压器中涌现的类比推理
AI.tldr: 本文研究了Transformer模型中类比推理的出现机制，发现其受数据、优化和模型规模影响，并通过几何对齐和函子应用实现关系结构迁移。
AI.motivation: 尽管类比推理是人类智能的核心能力，但Transformer模型如何获取和实现类比推理的机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 作者受范畴论中函子概念的启发，将类比推理形式化为跨类别实体间对应关系的推断。他们引入合成任务来评估受控设置下类比推理的出现，并通过机械分析分解了Transformer中的类比推理机制。
AI.result: 研究发现类比推理的出现高度依赖于数据特性、优化选择和模型规模。机械分析表明，Transformer中的类比推理分解为两个关键部分：嵌入空间中关系结构的几何对齐和Transformer内部函子的应用。这些机制使模型能够将关系结构从一个类别转移到另一个类别，从而实现类比。预训练LLM中也观察到相同的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将类比从一个抽象的认知概念转变为现代神经网络中一个具体的、基于机制的现象。
AI.translation: 类比是人类智能的核心能力，它能够将在一个领域中发现的抽象模式应用于另一个领域。尽管类比推理在认知中扮演着核心角色，但Transformer模型如何获取和实现类比推理的机制仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，受范畴论中函子概念的启发，我们将类比推理形式化为跨类别实体间对应关系的推断。基于这种形式化，我们引入了合成任务，以评估在受控设置下类比推理的出现。我们发现类比推理的出现高度依赖于数据特性、优化选择和模型规模。通过机械分析，我们表明Transformer中的类比推理分解为两个关键组成部分：(1) 嵌入空间中关系结构的几何对齐，以及 (2) Transformer内部函子的应用。这些机制使模型能够将关系结构从一个类别转移到另一个类别，从而实现类比。最后，我们量化了这些效应，并发现预训练大型语言模型中也观察到相同的趋势。通过这样做，我们将类比从一个抽象的认知概念转变为现代神经网络中一个具体的、基于机制的现象。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了Transformer模型中类比推理的涌现机制。作者受范畴论启发，将类比推理定义为跨类别实体对应关系的推断，并设计合成任务进行评估。研究发现，类比推理的涌现受数据、优化和模型规模影响，其核心机制在于嵌入空间中关系结构的几何对齐和函子的应用，从而实现关系结构的跨类别迁移。这些发现也适用于预训练的大型语言模型，将类比从抽象认知概念转化为神经网络中具体的机制现象。
AI.keywords: 类比推理, Transformer, 函子, 几何对齐, 关系结构
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将类比推理与范畴论中的函子概念相结合，提供了一个新颖且机械论的视角来理解Transformer模型中的类比能力。其创新之处在于形式化了类比推理并揭示了其在模型内部的具体实现机制（几何对齐和函子应用），这对于解释大型语言模型的推理能力具有重要意义。通过在受控合成任务和预训练LLMs上进行验证，增加了研究的普适性。

title: A quasi-monolithic localized high-order ALE finite element method for multi-scale fluid-structure interaction problems
summary: This paper presents a quasi-monolithic localized high-order arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (qMLH-ALE) finite element method for multi-scale fluid-structure interaction (FSI) in microfluidic systems. The fluid momentum, the incompressible Neo-Hookean constitutive law, and the left Cauchy-Green tensor $\mathcal{B}$ are assembled into a single implicit system, while the harmonic mesh extension is updated explicitly in a staggered manner. Isoparametric $\mathcal{P}_2$ elements provide third-order geometric approximation of curved fluid-solid interfaces, and a second-order implicit-explicit partitioned Runge-Kutta scheme delivers second-order temporal accuracy without the dissipation of backward Euler. A localized updating strategy confines the moving mesh and the deformation history to a body-fitted sub-domain coupled with a precomputed steady background flow, bridging the scale disparity between local FSI dynamics and the macroscopic microchannel geometry. The Turek-Hron FSI3 benchmark, performed at unit fluid-solid density ratio, reproduces the reference beam-tip amplitude and frequency within $3\%$, confirming stability under the strong added-mass coupling that destabilizes conventional partitioned schemes. Three-dimensional particle-focusing simulations in spiral microchannels further illustrate the framework on long-range multi-scale problems.

AI.title_translation: 多尺度流固耦合问题的准整体局部高阶ALE有限元方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种准整体局部高阶ALE有限元方法（qMLH-ALE），用于稳定准确地模拟微流控系统中的多尺度流固耦合问题，克服了强附加质量耦合和尺度差异的挑战。
AI.motivation: 在微流控系统中，需要精确模拟多尺度流固耦合（FSI）问题，特别是弥合局部FSI动力学与宏观微通道几何形状之间的尺度差异，并解决传统分区方案在强附加质量耦合下不稳定性的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种准整体局部高阶任意拉格朗日-欧拉（qMLH-ALE）有限元方法。该方法将流体动量、不可压缩的Neo-Hookean本构律和左柯西-格林张量组装成一个单一的隐式系统，并显式更新谐波网格扩展。它使用等参P2单元提供三阶几何近似，并采用二阶隐式-显式分区龙格-库塔方案实现二阶时间精度。通过局部更新策略，将移动网格和变形历史限制在与预计算的稳定背景流耦合的贴体子域中。
AI.result: 该方法在单位流固密度比下的Turek-Hron FSI3基准测试中，将参考梁尖幅度和频率重现到3%以内，证实了在强附加质量耦合下的稳定性。在螺旋微通道中的三维粒子聚焦模拟进一步证明了该框架在长程多尺度问题上的适用性。
AI.conclusion: qMLH-ALE方法为微流控系统中的多尺度FSI问题提供了稳定且准确的解决方案，特别在强附加质量耦合和显著尺度差异的场景中表现出色，克服了传统方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于微流控系统中多尺度流固耦合（FSI）的准整体局部高阶任意拉格朗日-欧拉（qMLH-ALE）有限元方法。流体动量、不可压缩的Neo-Hookean本构律以及左柯西-格林张量$\\mathcal{B}$被组装成一个单一的隐式系统，而谐波网格扩展则以交错的方式显式更新。等参$\\mathcal{P}_2$单元提供了弯曲流固界面的三阶几何近似，二阶隐式-显式分区龙格-库塔方案提供了二阶时间精度，且没有后向欧拉的耗散。局部更新策略将移动网格和变形历史限制在一个与预计算的稳定背景流耦合的贴体子域中，从而弥合了局部FSI动力学与宏观微通道几何形状之间的尺度差异。在单位流固密度比下进行的Turek-Hron FSI3基准测试，将参考梁尖幅度和频率重现到3%以内，证实了在会使传统分区方案不稳定的强附加质量耦合下的稳定性。螺旋微通道中的三维粒子聚焦模拟进一步说明了该框架在长程多尺度问题上的应用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种准整体局部高阶任意拉格朗日-欧拉（qMLH-ALE）有限元方法，用于解决微流控系统中的多尺度流固耦合问题。该方法通过隐式集成流体和结构方程、显式更新网格、采用高阶单元和二阶龙格-库塔方案提高精度，并利用局部更新策略处理尺度差异。基准测试结果证实了其在强附加质量耦合下的稳定性以及对复杂多尺度问题的适用性。
AI.keywords: 流固耦合, ALE有限元方法, 多尺度, 微流控, 准整体
AI.comments: 该方法的创新之处在于其准整体方法与局部更新策略的结合，使得它能够稳定准确地模拟多尺度FSI问题，特别是在强附加质量耦合下，这是传统分区方案的已知挑战。其弥合尺度差异的能力也是一个关键优势。

title: Logic-Guided Vector Fields for Constrained Generative Modeling
summary: Neuro-symbolic systems aim to combine the expressive structure of symbolic logic with the flexibility of neural learning; yet, generative models typically lack mechanisms to enforce declarative constraints at generation time. We propose Logic-Guided Vector Fields (LGVF), a neuro-symbolic framework that injects symbolic knowledge, specified as differentiable relaxations of logical constraints, into flow matching generative models. LGVF couples two complementary mechanisms: (1) a training-time logic loss that penalizes constraint violations along continuous flow trajectories, with weights that emphasize correctness near the target distribution; and (2) an inference-time adjustment that steers sampling using constraint gradients, acting as a lightweight, logic-informed correction to the learned dynamics. We evaluate LGVF on three constrained generation case studies spanning linear, nonlinear, and multi-region feasibility constraints. Across all settings, LGVF reduces constraint violations by 59-82% compared to standard flow matching and achieves the lowest violation rates in each case. In the linear and ring settings, LGVF also improves distributional fidelity as measured by MMD, while in the multi-obstacle setting, we observe a satisfaction-fidelity trade-off, with improved feasibility but increased MMD. Beyond quantitative gains, LGVF yields constraint-aware vector fields exhibiting emergent obstacle-avoidance behavior, routing samples around forbidden regions without explicit path planning.

AI.title_translation: 逻辑引导向量场用于受限生成建模
AI.tldr: LGVF是一个神经符号框架，通过在流匹配生成模型中注入逻辑约束的可微松弛，显著减少了受限生成任务中的约束违反，并展现出避障行为。
AI.motivation: 生成模型通常缺乏在生成时强制执行声明性约束的机制。现有的神经符号系统旨在结合符号逻辑的表达结构和神经网络学习的灵活性，但如何有效地在生成模型中融入逻辑约束是一个挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了逻辑引导向量场（LGVF），一个神经符号框架。它通过以下两种机制将符号知识（表示为逻辑约束的可微松弛）注入到流匹配生成模型中：1. 训练时逻辑损失：惩罚沿连续流轨迹的约束违反，并强调目标分布附近的正确性。2. 推理时调整：使用约束梯度引导采样，作为对学习动力学的轻量级、逻辑知情的校正。
AI.result: LGVF在三种受限生成案例研究（线性、非线性和多区域可行性约束）中进行了评估。结果显示，LGVF将约束违反率比标准流匹配降低了59-82%，并在每个案例中都达到了最低的违反率。在线性和环形设置中，LGVF还改善了MMD测量的分布保真度。在多障碍设置中，LGVF提高了可行性但MMD增加，表明存在满意度-保真度权衡。LGVF还产生了具有避障行为的约束感知向量场，无需显式路径规划即可绕过禁区。
AI.conclusion: LGVF通过在流匹配生成模型中有效注入可微逻辑约束，显著提高了受限生成任务中对约束的遵守，并在某些情况下改善了分布保真度，同时展现了新颖的避障行为，为神经符号生成建模提供了一个有前景的方向。
AI.translation: 神经符号系统旨在将符号逻辑的表达结构与神经网络学习的灵活性相结合；然而，生成模型通常缺乏在生成时强制执行声明性约束的机制。我们提出了逻辑引导向量场（LGVF），一个神经符号框架，它将以逻辑约束的可微松弛形式指定的符号知识注入到流匹配生成模型中。LGVF结合了两种互补的机制：(1) 训练时逻辑损失，惩罚沿连续流轨迹的约束违反，其权重强调目标分布附近的正确性；以及 (2) 推理时调整，使用约束梯度引导采样，作为对学习动力学的一种轻量级、逻辑知情的校正。我们在涵盖线性、非线性和多区域可行性约束的三种受限生成案例研究中评估了LGVF。在所有设置中，与标准流匹配相比，LGVF将约束违反率降低了59-82%，并在每种情况下均实现了最低的违反率。在线性和环形设置中，LGVF还改善了通过MMD衡量的分布保真度，而在多障碍设置中，我们观察到满意度-保真度权衡，即可行性提高但MMD增加。除了定量增益之外，LGVF还产生了具有紧急避障行为的约束感知向量场，无需显式路径规划即可使样本绕过禁止区域。
AI.summary: 本文提出了逻辑引导向量场（LGVF），一个神经符号框架，旨在解决生成模型在生成时难以强制执行声明性约束的问题。LGVF通过在流匹配生成模型中注入逻辑约束的可微松弛，并结合训练时的逻辑损失和推理时的约束梯度调整，有效地引导生成过程遵守预设约束。实验结果表明，LGVF在多种受限生成任务中显著降低了约束违反率（59-82%），并能产生具有避障能力的约束感知向量场，展现了在受限生成建模方面的优越性和创新性。
AI.keywords: 神经符号系统, 受限生成建模, 流匹配, 逻辑引导向量场, 避障
AI.comments: LGVF的创新之处在于其将符号逻辑以可微形式融入流匹配生成模型，并通过训练时损失和推理时调整的双重机制有效强制执行约束。这种方法不仅显著提高了生成样本的约束依从性，而且在没有显式路径规划的情况下，通过 emergent 的避障行为展现了其对复杂约束的内在理解。该工作为神经符号AI在受限生成领域的应用提供了新的思路，特别是在需要高可靠性和安全性约束的场景中具有重要意义。未来的工作可以探索在更复杂的逻辑形式和不同类型的生成模型中的应用。

title: Two-Stage Coded-Sliding Beam Training and QoS-Constrained Sum-Rate Maximization for SIM-Assisted Wireless Communications
summary: Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIM) provide a cost-effective and scalable solution for large-scale antenna communications.However, efficient channel state information acquisition and phase shift optimization remain critical challenges. In this paper, we develop a unified framework of low-complexity algorithms for SIM-assisted communication systems to address these issues. Specifically, we propose a generalized two-step codebook construction (TSCC) method that leverages two-dimensional angular-domain decoupling to transform planar array beamformer design into two independent one-dimensional linear array beamformer design problems, efficiently solved via the Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm and our proposed majorization-minimization-based proximal distance (PDMM) algorithm. We further develop a two-stage coded-sliding beam training (TSCSBT) method for low-overhead and high-accuracy beam training, where error-correcting codes are embedded in the first-stage training to enhance robustness against noise, and sliding sampling is subsequently performed around the matched angular samples to improve angular resolution. The proposed framework is further extended to multi-path user channels. Finally, a variable decoupling-based block successive upper bound minimization (VD-BSUM) algorithm is proposed to directly solve the QoS-constrained sum-rate maximization problem through closed-form iterative updates with substantially reduced computational complexity. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods in achieving precise beam pattern realization, improved beam training accuracy and angular resolution, and enhanced sum-rate performance.

AI.title_translation: SIM辅助无线通信中的两阶段编码滑动波束训练和QoS约束和速率最大化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于SIM辅助无线通信的低复杂度算法统一框架，旨在解决高效信道状态信息获取和相移优化问题。该框架包括两步码本构建(TSCC)、两阶段编码滑动波束训练(TSCSBT)和基于变量解耦的块连续上界最小化(VD-BSUM)算法，通过仿真证明了其在实现精确波束模式、提高波束训练精度和角度分辨率以及增强和速率性能方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 堆叠智能超表面（SIM）在通信中面临高效信道状态信息获取和相移优化方面的关键挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个低复杂度算法的统一框架。具体包括：1. 广义两步码本构建（TSCC）方法，利用二维角度域解耦将平面阵列波束形成器设计转换为两个独立的二维线性阵列波束形成器设计问题，并通过Gerchberg-Saxton算法和所提出的基于主化最小化的近端距离（PDMM）算法解决。2. 两阶段编码滑动波束训练（TSCSBT）方法，通过在第一阶段训练中嵌入纠错码增强对噪声的鲁棒性，并在匹配的角度样本周围进行滑动采样以提高角度分辨率。3. 提出了一种基于变量解耦的块连续上界最小化（VD-BSUM）算法，通过闭式迭代更新解决QoS约束的和速率最大化问题，显著降低计算复杂度。该框架还扩展到多径用户信道。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方法在实现精确波束模式、提高波束训练精度和角度分辨率以及增强和速率性能方面是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的统一框架及其算法有效地解决了SIM辅助通信中高效信道状态信息获取和相移优化的挑战，从而显著提高了性能指标。
AI.translation: 堆叠智能超表面 (SIM) 为大规模天线通信提供了一种经济高效且可扩展的解决方案。然而，高效的信道状态信息获取和相移优化仍然是关键挑战。在本文中，我们开发了一个用于 SIM 辅助通信系统的低复杂度算法统一框架来解决这些这些问题。具体来说，我们提出了一种广义两步码本构建 (TSCC) 方法，该方法利用二维角度域解耦将平面阵列波束形成器设计转换为两个独立的二维线性阵列波束形成器设计问题，并通过 Gerchberg-Saxton 算法和我们提出的基于主化最小化的近端距离 (PDMM) 算法有效解决。我们进一步开发了一种两阶段编码滑动波束训练 (TSCSBT) 方法，用于低开销和高精度的波束训练，其中纠错码嵌入在第一阶段训练中以增强对噪声的鲁棒性，随后在匹配的角度样本周围进行滑动采样以提高角度分辨率。所提出的框架进一步扩展到多径用户信道。最后，提出了一种基于变量解耦的块连续上界最小化 (VD-BSUM) 算法，通过闭式迭代更新直接解决 QoS 约束的和速率最大化问题，大大降低了计算复杂度。仿真结果证明了所提出方法在实现精确波束模式实现、提高波束训练精度和角度分辨率以及增强和速率性能方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对SIM辅助无线通信中高效信道状态信息获取和相移优化的挑战，提出了一个低复杂度算法的统一框架。该框架包括用于高效波束形成器设计的两步码本构建（TSCC）方法、用于鲁棒和精确波束训练的两阶段编码滑动波束训练（TSCSBT）方法，以及用于QoS约束和速率最大化的基于变量解耦的块连续上界最小化（VD-BSUM）算法。仿真验证了这些方法在改善波束实现、训练精度、角度分辨率以及和速率方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 堆叠智能超表面, 波束训练, 码本构建, 和速率最大化, 低复杂度
AI.comments: 本文通过结合角度域解耦进行波束形成器设计、利用纠错码和滑动采样进行鲁棒波束训练，以及专门的优化算法进行和速率最大化，提供了一种创新的方法。该研究强调了SIM辅助系统低复杂度解决方案的重要性，这对于实际部署和可扩展性至关重要。

title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Most Large Language Model (LLM) agent memory systems rely on a small set of static, hand-designed operations for extracting memory. These fixed procedures hard-code human priors about what to store and how to revise memory, making them rigid under diverse interaction patterns and inefficient on long histories. To this end, we present \textbf{MemSkill}, which reframes these operations as learnable and evolvable memory skills, structured and reusable routines for extracting, consolidating, and pruning information from interaction traces. Inspired by the design philosophy of agent skills, MemSkill employs a \emph{controller} that learns to select a small set of relevant skills, paired with an LLM-based \emph{executor} that produces skill-guided memories. Beyond learning skill selection, MemSkill introduces a \emph{designer} that periodically reviews hard cases where selected skills yield incorrect or incomplete memories, and evolves the skill set by proposing refinements and new skills. Together, MemSkill forms a closed-loop procedure that improves both the skill-selection policy and the skill set itself. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, HotpotQA, and ALFWorld demonstrate that MemSkill improves task performance over strong baselines and generalizes well across settings. Further analyses shed light on how skills evolve, offering insights toward more adaptive, self-evolving memory management for LLM agents.

AI.title_translation: MemSkill：学习和进化自进化智能体的记忆技能
AI.tldr: MemSkill是一个用于LLM智能体的记忆系统，它将记忆操作视为可学习和可进化的技能，通过控制器、执行器和设计师的闭环过程，提高了任务性能和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大多数大型语言模型（LLM）智能体记忆系统依赖于静态、手工设计的记忆提取操作，这些操作在多样化的交互模式下僵化，在长历史记录上效率低下，且硬编码了人类关于存储什么以及如何修改记忆的先验知识。
AI.method: MemSkill将记忆操作重构为可学习和可进化的记忆技能，这些技能是用于从交互痕迹中提取、整合和修剪信息的结构化和可重用例程。它包含一个学习选择相关技能的“控制器”，一个生成技能指导记忆的基于LLM的“执行器”，以及一个“设计师”定期审查选定技能产生不正确或不完整记忆的困难案例，并通过提出改进和新技能来进化技能集。这共同形成了一个改进技能选择策略和技能集本身的闭环过程。
AI.result: MemSkill在LoCoMo、LongMemEval、HotpotQA和ALFWorld等实验中，提高了任务性能，优于强大的基线，并在不同设置下表现出良好的泛化能力。进一步的分析揭示了技能如何进化。
AI.conclusion: MemSkill为LLM智能体提供了更具适应性、自进化的记忆管理，通过学习和进化记忆技能来解决现有记忆系统在多样化交互模式下僵化和效率低下的局限性。
AI.translation: 大多数大型语言模型（LLM）智能体记忆系统依赖于一小部分静态、手工设计的操作来提取记忆。这些固定的程序硬编码了关于存储什么以及如何修改记忆的人类先验知识，使得它们在多样化的交互模式下僵化，在长历史记录上效率低下。为此，我们提出了 MemSkill，它将这些操作重新定义为可学习和可进化的记忆技能，这些技能是用于从交互痕迹中提取、整合和修剪信息的结构化和可重用例程。受智能体技能设计理念的启发，MemSkill 采用了一个“控制器”来学习选择一小部分相关技能，并与一个基于 LLM 的“执行器”配对，该执行器生成技能指导的记忆。除了学习技能选择之外，MemSkill 还引入了一个“设计师”，它定期审查选定技能产生不正确或不完整记忆的困难案例，并通过提出改进和新技能来进化技能集。MemSkill 共同形成了一个闭环过程，该过程改进了技能选择策略和技能集本身。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval、HotpotQA 和 ALFWorld 上的实验表明，MemSkill 提高了任务性能，优于强大的基线，并在不同设置下表现出良好的泛化能力。进一步的分析揭示了技能如何进化，为 LLM 智能体更具适应性、自进化的记忆管理提供了见解。
AI.summary: MemSkill提出了一种新颖的LLM智能体记忆系统，通过将记忆操作视为可学习和可进化的技能来克服传统静态记忆系统的局限性。它包含一个学习技能选择的控制器、一个生成技能指导记忆的执行器，以及一个进化技能集的设计师，形成一个闭环学习过程。实验证明MemSkill在多种任务上显著提升了性能和泛化能力，为LLM智能体提供了更自适应的记忆管理方法。
AI.keywords: LLM agents, Memory systems, Skill learning, Self-evolving, Memory management
AI.comments: MemSkill的创新之处在于其将记忆操作抽象为可学习和可进化的“技能”，并通过一个闭环系统（控制器、执行器、设计师）实现了记忆管理策略和技能集本身的持续优化。这克服了传统LLM智能体记忆系统静态和僵化的限制，为构建更具适应性和自进化能力的智能体提供了重要方向。

title: Reward-free Alignment for Conflicting Objectives
summary: Direct alignment methods are increasingly used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, many real-world alignment problems involve multiple conflicting objectives, where naive aggregation of preferences can lead to unstable training and poor trade-offs. In particular, weighted loss methods may fail to identify update directions that simultaneously improve all objectives, and existing multi-objective approaches often rely on explicit reward models, introducing additional complexity and distorting user-specified preferences. The contributions of this paper are two-fold. First, we propose a Reward-free Alignment framework for Conflicted Objectives (RACO) that directly leverages pairwise preference data and resolves gradient conflicts via a novel clipped variant of conflict-averse gradient descent. We provide convergence guarantees to Pareto-critical points that respect user-specified objective weights, and further show that clipping can strictly improve convergence rate in the two-objective setting. Second, we improve our method using some heuristics and conduct experiments to demonstrate the compatibility of the proposed framework for LLM alignment. Both qualitative and quantitative evaluations on multi-objective summarization and safety alignment tasks across multiple LLM families (Qwen 3, Llama 3, Gemma 3) show that our method consistently achieves better Pareto trade-offs compared to existing multi-objective alignment baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无奖励对齐框架（RACO），通过新颖的梯度下降变体解决大型语言模型（LLM）在冲突目标下的对齐问题，并在多目标摘要和安全对齐任务上实现了更好的帕累托权衡。
AI.motivation: 直接对齐方法在处理冲突目标时面临训练不稳定和权衡不佳的问题。现有的加权损失方法难以找到同时改进所有目标的更新方向，而多目标方法又依赖于复杂的奖励模型，引入了额外复杂性并可能扭曲用户偏好。
AI.method: 本文提出了冲突目标无奖励对齐（RACO）框架，该框架直接利用成对偏好数据，并通过一种新颖的剪裁型冲突规避梯度下降来解决梯度冲突。此外，还通过启发式方法改进了该框架。
AI.result: RACO框架提供了对尊重用户指定目标权重的帕累托临界点的收敛保证，并表明在双目标设置中，剪裁可以显著提高收敛速度。在多个LLM家族（Qwen 3、Llama 3、Gemma 3）上的多目标摘要和安全对齐任务进行的定性和定量评估表明，与现有基线相比，该方法始终能实现更好的帕累托权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的无奖励冲突目标对齐框架（RACO）能够有效解决LLM在面对冲突目标时的对齐问题，无需显式奖励模型，并能持续实现优于现有基线的帕累托权衡。
AI.translation: 直接对齐方法正越来越多地用于将大型语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐。然而，许多现实世界的对齐问题涉及多个冲突目标，其中对偏好的简单聚合可能导致训练不稳定和权衡不佳。特别是，加权损失方法可能无法识别同时改进所有目标的更新方向，而现有的多目标方法通常依赖于显式奖励模型，这引入了额外的复杂性并扭曲了用户指定的偏好。本文的贡献是双重的。首先，我们提出了一个冲突目标无奖励对齐（RACO）框架，该框架直接利用成对偏好数据，并通过一种新颖的剪裁型冲突规避梯度下降变体来解决梯度冲突。我们提供了对尊重用户指定目标权重的帕累托临界点的收敛保证，并进一步表明在双目标设置中，剪裁可以严格提高收敛速度。其次，我们使用一些启发式方法改进了我们的方法，并进行了实验，以证明所提出的框架与LLM对齐的兼容性。在多个LLM家族（Qwen 3、Llama 3、Gemma 3）上的多目标摘要和安全对齐任务进行的定性和定量评估均表明，与现有的多目标对齐基线相比，我们的方法始终能实现更好的帕累托权衡。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM在多冲突目标对齐中现有方法存在的训练不稳定、权衡不佳以及依赖奖励模型等问题，提出了一种无奖励对齐框架（RACO）。该框架通过直接利用成对偏好数据和新颖的剪裁型冲突规避梯度下降来解决梯度冲突。实验证明，RACO在多目标摘要和安全对齐任务上，能为多个LLM家族提供收敛保证，并持续实现优于现有基线的帕累托权衡。
AI.keywords: 无奖励对齐, 冲突目标, 大型语言模型, 帕累托权衡, 多目标优化
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个无需奖励模型即可处理冲突目标的LLM对齐框架RACO，通过引入剪裁型冲突规避梯度下降，有效解决了梯度冲突问题，并提供了严格的收敛性保证。这对于解决现实世界中多目标冲突的LLM应用具有重要意义，避免了奖励模型带来的复杂性和偏好扭曲，提高了对齐的稳定性和效率。

title: SPA-Cache: Singular Proxies for Adaptive Caching in Diffusion Language Models
comments: Accepted by ICML 2026.The code repository is available at https://github.com/wenhao728/spa-cache
summary: While Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a flexible, arbitrary-order alternative to the autoregressive paradigm, their non-causal nature precludes standard KV caching, forcing costly hidden state recomputation at every decoding step. Existing DLM caching approaches reduce this cost by selective hidden state updates; however, they are still limited by (i) costly token-wise update identification heuristics and (ii) rigid, uniform budget allocation that fails to account for heterogeneous hidden state dynamics. To address these challenges, we present SPA-Cache that jointly optimizes update identification and budget allocation in DLM cache. First, we derive a low-dimensional singular proxy that enables the identification of update-critical tokens in a low-dimensional subspace, substantially reducing the overhead of update identification. Second, we introduce an adaptive strategy that allocates fewer updates to stable layers without degrading generation quality. Together, these contributions significantly improve the efficiency of DLMs, yielding up to an $8\times$ throughput improvement over vanilla decoding and a $2$--$4\times$ speedup over existing caching baselines.
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026.The code repository is available at https://github.com/wenhao728/spa-cache

AI.title_translation: SPA-Cache：扩散语言模型中自适应缓存的奇异代理
AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）因其非因果性而无法使用标准KV缓存，导致解码成本高昂。SPA-Cache通过引入低维奇异代理来高效识别更新关键令牌，并采用自适应策略分配更新预算，显著提升了DLMs的效率，实现了高达8倍的吞吐量提升和2-4倍的现有缓存基线加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）由于其非因果性，无法使用标准的KV缓存，导致每个解码步骤都需要昂贵的隐藏状态重新计算。现有的DLM缓存方法通过选择性隐藏状态更新来降低成本，但仍受限于 (i) 昂贵的逐令牌更新识别启发式方法 和 (ii) 僵化、统一的预算分配，未能考虑异构的隐藏状态动态。
AI.method: SPA-Cache联合优化了DLM缓存中的更新识别和预算分配。具体方法包括：首先，推导出一个低维奇异代理，使其能够在低维子空间中识别更新关键令牌，从而大幅降低更新识别的开销。其次，引入一种自适应策略，为稳定的层分配较少的更新，同时不降低生成质量。
AI.result: 与普通解码相比，吞吐量提高了高达8倍；与现有缓存基线相比，速度提升了2-4倍。
AI.conclusion: SPA-Cache通过优化更新识别和预算分配，显著提高了扩散语言模型（DLMs）的效率。
AI.translation: 虽然扩散语言模型（DLMs）提供了一种灵活的、任意顺序的自回归范式替代方案，但其非因果性质排除了标准KV缓存，迫使在每个解码步骤中进行昂贵的隐藏状态重新计算。现有的DLM缓存方法通过选择性隐藏状态更新来降低此成本；然而，它们仍然受限于 (i) 昂贵的逐令牌更新识别启发式方法 和 (ii) 僵化、统一的预算分配，未能考虑到异构的隐藏状态动态。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SPA-Cache，它联合优化了DLM缓存中的更新识别和预算分配。首先，我们推导出一个低维奇异代理，使其能够在低维子空间中识别更新关键令牌，从而大幅降低更新识别的开销。其次，我们引入了一种自适应策略，为稳定的层分配较少的更新，同时不降低生成质量。这些贡献共同显著提高了DLMs的效率，与普通解码相比，吞吐量提高了高达8倍，与现有缓存基线相比，速度提升了2-4倍。
AI.summary: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）因缺乏标准KV缓存而面临昂贵的隐藏状态重新计算问题。现有缓存方法存在更新识别成本高和预算分配僵化等局限。SPA-Cache通过引入低维奇异代理来高效识别更新关键令牌，并采用自适应策略为稳定层分配更少的更新，从而联合优化了缓存机制。该方法显著提高了DLMs的效率，实现了高达8倍的吞吐量提升和2-4倍的现有缓存基线加速。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 缓存, 自适应缓存, 奇异代理, 效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了SPA-Cache，通过引入低维奇异代理和自适应更新分配策略，有效地解决了扩散语言模型（DLMs）中缓存效率低下的关键问题，即昂贵的更新识别和僵化的预算分配。这种双管齐下的方法显著提升了DLMs的性能，为未来DLM的实际应用提供了重要的效率优化。

title: Fine-Tuning Language Models to Know What They Know
summary: Evaluating true metacognition in Large Language Models (LLMs) is difficult due to biases and heuristics. This paper presents a framework to measure and enhance LLM metacognition while controlling for these biases. A measurement method using the $d'_{\rm type2}$ metric is established to isolate metacognitive ability. The Evolution Strategy for Metacognitive Alignment (ESMA) is proposed, demonstrating robust generalization across unseen datasets, languages, and newly acquired knowledge. Finally, parameter analysis reveals that these improvements are driven by a sparse set of parameters, offering new pathways for targeted metacognitive optimization.

AI.title_translation: 微调语言模型以了解它们所知
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个框架，用于测量和增强大型语言模型（LLM）的元认知能力，通过使用$d'_{m type2}$度量和元认知对齐进化策略（ESMA），并发现这些改进是由稀疏参数驱动的。
AI.motivation: 由于偏见和启发式方法，评估大型语言模型（LLM）的真实元认知能力非常困难。本文旨在通过控制这些偏见来测量和增强LLM的元认知能力。
AI.method: 本文建立了一种使用$d'_{m type2}$度量的测量方法来分离元认知能力。提出了元认知对齐进化策略（ESMA）。最后，进行了参数分析。
AI.result: 元认知对齐进化策略（ESMA）在未见过的数据集、语言和新获得的知识上表现出强大的泛化能力。参数分析揭示，这些改进是由一组稀疏的参数驱动的。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个框架和方法来测量和增强大型语言模型（LLM）的元认知能力，证明了其有效性，并确定了潜在的稀疏参数驱动因素，为有针对性的优化开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 评估大型语言模型（LLM）的真实元认知能力因偏见和启发式方法而变得困难。本文提出了一个框架，用于在控制这些偏见的同时测量和增强LLM的元认知能力。建立了一种使用$d'_{m type2}$度量的测量方法来分离元认知能力。提出了元认知对齐进化策略（ESMA），该策略在未见过的数据集、语言和新获得的知识上表现出强大的泛化能力。最后，参数分析表明，这些改进是由一组稀疏的参数驱动的，为有针对性的元认知优化提供了新途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个框架来解决评估大型语言模型（LLM）真实元认知能力的难题，通过控制偏见来测量和增强其元认知。研究引入了用于元认知能力测量的$d'_{m type2}$度量和元认知对齐进化策略（ESMA），该策略展现出强大的泛化能力。此外，参数分析表明元认知能力的提升是由一组稀疏参数驱动的，为未来的定向优化提供了方向。
AI.keywords: 元认知, 大型语言模型, 微调, ESMA, 参数分析
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入一个新颖的框架和度量标准来量化评估和改进LLM的元认知能力，这对于构建更可靠的人工智能至关重要。识别出稀疏参数驱动因素是一个重要发现，可能有助于实现更高效和有针对性的微调。

title: Language Movement Primitives: Grounding Language Models in Robot Motion
summary: Enabling robots to perform novel manipulation tasks from natural language instructions remains a fundamental challenge in robotics, despite significant progress in generalized problem solving with foundational models. Large vision and language models (VLMs) are capable of processing high-dimensional input data for visual scene and language understanding, as well as decomposing tasks into a sequence of logical steps; however, they struggle to ground those steps in embodied robot motion. On the other hand, robotics foundation models output action commands, but require in-domain fine-tuning or experience before they are able to perform novel tasks successfully. At its core, there still remains the fundamental challenge of connecting abstract task reasoning with low-level motion control. To address this disconnect, we propose Language Movement Primitives (LMPs), a framework that grounds VLM reasoning in Dynamic Movement Primitive (DMP) parameterization. Our key insight is that DMPs provide a small number of interpretable parameters, and VLMs can set these parameters to specify diverse, continuous, and stable trajectories. Put another way: VLMs can reason over free-form natural language task descriptions, and semantically ground their desired motions into DMPs -- bridging the gap between high-level task reasoning and low-level position and velocity control. Building on this combination of VLMs and DMPs, we formulate our LMP pipeline for zero-shot robot manipulation that effectively completes tabletop manipulation problems by generating a sequence of DMP motions. Across 31 real-world manipulation tasks, we show that LMP achieves 65% task success as compared to 35% for the best performing baseline. See videos at our website: https://collab.me.vt.edu/lmp

AI.title_translation: 语言运动原语：将语言模型植根于机器人运动
AI.tldr: LMP框架通过将VLM推理与DMP参数化结合，使机器人能够从自然语言指令执行零样本操作任务，并在实际任务中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管基础模型在通用问题解决方面取得了进展，但机器人仍难以从自然语言指令执行新颖的操作任务。主要挑战在于将抽象的任务推理与低级运动控制连接起来，因为VLMs难以将逻辑步骤具体化为机器人运动，而机器人基础模型则需要领域内微调才能执行新任务。
AI.method: 本文提出了语言运动原语（LMPs）框架，旨在解决高级任务推理与低级运动控制之间的脱节。LMPs通过将视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力与动态运动原语（DMP）的参数化相结合。关键在于DMPs提供少量可解释参数，VLMs可以设置这些参数来指定多样、连续和稳定的轨迹。该方法构建了一个零样本机器人操作管道，通过生成一系列DMP运动来有效完成桌面操作问题。
AI.result: 在31个实际操作任务中，LMP实现了65%的任务成功率，而表现最佳的基线仅为35%。
AI.conclusion: LMP框架通过有效连接高级任务推理和低级运动控制，显著提高了机器人从自然语言指令执行零样本操作任务的能力，并在实际场景中展现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 尽管基础模型在通用问题解决方面取得了显著进展，但使机器人能够根据自然语言指令执行新颖的操作任务仍然是机器人领域的一个基本挑战。大型视觉语言模型（VLM）能够处理高维输入数据以进行视觉场景和语言理解，并能将任务分解为一系列逻辑步骤；然而，它们难以将这些步骤具体化为具身机器人运动。另一方面，机器人基础模型输出动作指令，但需要领域内微调或经验才能成功执行新颖任务。其核心仍然是将抽象任务推理与低级运动控制连接起来的根本挑战。为了解决这种脱节，我们提出了语言运动原语（LMPs）框架，该框架将VLM推理植根于动态运动原语（DMP）参数化中。我们的关键见解是，DMPs提供了少量可解释的参数，并且VLMs可以设置这些参数来指定多样、连续和稳定的轨迹。换句话说：VLMs可以对自由形式的自然语言任务描述进行推理，并将其期望的运动在语义上植根于DMPs中——弥合了高级任务推理与低级位置和速度控制之间的鸿沟。基于VLMs和DMPs的这种结合，我们制定了用于零样本机器人操作的LMP管道，通过生成一系列DMP运动有效完成桌面操作问题。在31个实际操作任务中，我们表明LMP实现了65%的任务成功率，而表现最佳的基线为35%。请访问我们的网站查看视频：https://collab.me.vt.edu/lmp
AI.summary: 本文提出了语言运动原语（LMPs）框架，旨在解决机器人从自然语言指令执行新颖操作任务时，高级任务推理与低级运动控制之间的脱节问题。LMPs通过将视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力与动态运动原语（DMP）的可解释参数化相结合，使得VLM能够将自然语言任务描述语义地转化为具体的机器人运动轨迹。该零样本操作管道在31个实际操作任务中取得了65%的成功率，显著优于现有基线的35%。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作, 语言模型, 运动原语, 零样本学习, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: LMP的创新之处在于其巧妙地结合了VLM的强大推理能力和DMP在生成稳定连续轨迹方面的优势，有效地弥合了高级语义理解与低级运动控制之间的鸿沟。这种方法为零样本机器人操作提供了一个有前景的解决方案，对于推动机器人领域在复杂任务执行方面的进展具有重要意义。然而，65%的成功率在某些高精度要求的场景下可能仍有提升空间。

title: Act or Clarify? Modeling Sensitivity to Uncertainty and Cost in Communication
summary: When deciding how to act under uncertainty, agents may choose to act to reduce uncertainty or they may act despite that uncertainty. In communicative settings, an important way of reducing uncertainty is by asking clarification questions (CQs). We predict that the decision to ask a CQ depends on both contextual uncertainty and the cost of alternative actions, and that these factors interact: uncertainty should matter most when acting incorrectly is costly. We formalize this interaction in a computational model based on expected regret: how much an agent stands to lose by acting now rather than with full information. We test these predictions in two experiments, one examining purely linguistic responses to questions and another extending to choices between clarification and non-linguistic action. Taken together, our results suggest a rational tradeoff: humans tend to seek clarification proportional to the risk of substantial loss when acting under uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 行动还是澄清？建模沟通中对不确定性和成本的敏感性
AI.tldr: 智能体在不确定性下决定是采取行动还是寻求澄清，这取决于不确定性和错误行动的成本。人类在不确定性下行动时，会根据遭受重大损失的风险比例来寻求澄清。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在理解智能体在不确定性下如何决定采取行动，具体是选择减少不确定性（例如通过提出澄清问题）还是尽管存在不确定性也采取行动，并考虑上下文不确定性与替代行动成本之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 研究在一个基于预期后悔的计算模型中形式化了不确定性与行动成本的相互作用。并通过两项实验检验了这些预测，一项考察纯语言反应，另一项考察澄清与非语言行动之间的选择。
AI.result: 实验结果表明存在一种理性的权衡：人类倾向于在不确定性下行动时，根据遭受重大损失的风险比例来寻求澄清。
AI.conclusion: 人类在不确定性下行动时，会根据潜在损失的风险理性地权衡是否需要寻求澄清。
AI.translation: 当在不确定性下决定如何行动时，智能体可能会选择行动以减少不确定性，或者尽管存在不确定性也选择行动。在沟通环境中，减少不确定性的一个重要方式是提出澄清问题（CQs）。我们预测，提出澄清问题的决定取决于上下文不确定性和替代行动的成本，并且这些因素会相互作用：当错误行动的成本很高时，不确定性应该最重要。我们基于预期后悔（expected regret）在一个计算模型中形式化了这种相互作用：即智能体现在行动而不是在掌握全部信息的情况下行动可能损失多少。我们在两项实验中检验了这些预测，一项考察了对问题的纯语言反应，另一项则扩展到澄清和非语言行动之间的选择。总的来说，我们的结果表明存在一种理性的权衡：人类倾向于在不确定性下行动时，根据遭受重大损失的风险比例来寻求澄清。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了智能体在不确定性下决定行动或寻求澄清的机制。研究提出，澄清行为（如提问）取决于上下文不确定性与错误行动成本的交互作用。作者构建了一个基于预期后悔的计算模型，并通过两项实验验证了模型预测。结果显示，人类在不确定性下行动时，会根据潜在损失的风险程度理性地选择寻求澄清。
AI.keywords: 不确定性, 沟通, 澄清问题, 预期后悔, 决策
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入“预期后悔”概念来建模沟通中的不确定性决策，提供了一个新颖的视角。其创新点在于将认知心理学中的决策理论与语言沟通行为相结合，揭示了人类在寻求信息时的理性权衡。这对于理解人机交互、语言学和决策科学都有重要意义。

title: CPMobius: Iterative Coach-Player Reasoning for Data-Free Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in complex reasoning, yet their progress remains fundamentally constrained by reliance on massive high-quality human-curated tasks and labels, either through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL) on reasoning-specific data. This dependence renders supervision-heavy training paradigms increasingly unsustainable, with signs of diminishing scalability already evident in practice. To overcome this limitation, we introduce CPMöbius (CPMobius), a collaborative Coach-Player paradigm for data-free reinforcement learning of reasoning models. Unlike traditional adversarial self-play, CPMöbius, inspired by real world human sports collaboration and multi-agent collaboration, treats the Coach and Player as independent but cooperative roles. The Coach proposes instructions targeted at the Player's capability and receives rewards based on changes in the Player's performance, while the Player is rewarded for solving the increasingly instructive tasks generated by the Coach. This cooperative optimization loop is designed to directly enhance the Player's mathematical reasoning ability. Remarkably, CPMöbius achieves substantial improvement without relying on any external training data, outperforming existing unsupervised approaches. For example, on Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, our method improves accuracy by an overall average of +4.9 and an out-of-distribution average of +5.4, exceeding RENT by +1.5 on overall accuracy and R-zero by +4.2 on OOD accuracy. Our codebase has been released at https://github.com/thunlp/CPMobius.

AI.title_translation: CPMobius：面向无数据强化学习的迭代式教练-运动员推理框架
AI.tldr: CPMobius 引入了一种教练-运动员协同范式，让大模型在无外部标注数据的情况下，通过自我演化提升数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理训练严重依赖海量高质量人工标注数据，导致训练范式不可持续且难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出 CPMöbius 框架，采用教练-运动员协作范式。教练根据运动员的能力动态生成针对性指令，两者通过协同优化循环共同提升运动员的推理能力，且全程无需外部训练数据。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 上，整体准确率平均提升 4.9%，分布外（OOD）任务准确率平均提升 5.4%，性能超越了 RENT 和 R-zero 等现有无监督方法。
AI.conclusion: CPMobius 证明了通过教练-运动员协作机制，无需外部训练数据即可显著提升大模型的数学推理能力，是一种高效且可持续的训练范式。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂推理方面展现出巨大潜力，但其进步仍受限于对海量高质量人工标注数据和标签的依赖（无论是通过监督微调还是基于推理数据的强化学习）。这种对监督式训练范式的依赖正变得日益不可持续，且在实践中已出现可扩展性递减的迹象。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了 CPMöbius，这是一种用于推理模型无数据强化学习的教练-运动员协作范式。与传统的对抗性自我博弈不同，CPMobius 受现实世界体育协作和多智能体协作的启发，将教练和运动员视为独立但合作的角色。教练提出针对运动员能力的指令，并根据运动员性能的变化获得奖励，而运动员则因解决教练生成的日益具有指导性的任务而获得奖励。这种协同优化循环旨在直接增强运动员的数学推理能力。值得注意的是，CPMobius 在不依赖任何外部训练数据的情况下实现了显著提升，优于现有的无监督方法。例如，在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 上，我们的方法使整体准确率平均提高了 +4.9，分布外准确率平均提高了 +5.4，整体准确率超过 RENT +1.5，OOD 准确率超过 R-zero +4.2。我们的代码库已在 https://github.com/thunlp/CPMobius 发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 CPMöbius，一种用于大模型推理能力的无数据强化学习框架。通过建立教练与运动员的协同优化机制，模型能够自我生成指令并进行学习，从而在无需人工数据的情况下显著提升数学推理水平。
AI.keywords: 无数据强化学习, 大语言模型, 推理能力, 教练-运动员协作, 协同优化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了教练-运动员（Coach-Player）协作范式，通过非对抗性的协同优化解决了大模型推理能力提升对海量标注数据的依赖问题，为无数据强化学习提供了新的思路。其局限性在于未提及在非数学推理任务上的通用性，且协作循环的稳定性可能需要进一步探索。

title: Beyond Exposure: Optimizing Ranking Fairness with Non-linear Time-Income Functions
summary:
Ranking systems in web search and recommendation allocate attention among items and providers, and therefore need to balance relevance-based effectiveness with provider fairness. Existing fair-ranking methods commonly focus on exposure fairness, where cumulative exposure is allocated in proportion to item merit. However, exposure is often only an intermediate signal: the actual utility received by a provider may depend on context-dependent conversion from exposure to income, such as clicks, purchases, or advertising value.
  This paper studies fair ranking under context-dependent provider utility, which we refer to as income. We formalize income fairness by requiring cumulative provider income to be proportional to relevance, and define an income-unfairness metric based on this proportionality condition. We then propose DIDRF, a Dynamic-Income-Derivative-aware Ranking Fairness algorithm for income-fair ranking. DIDRF uses the quadratic structure of income-fairness violations to derive a state-aware scoring rule that jointly considers ranking effectiveness and the marginal effect of each ranking decision on cumulative income fairness.
  Experiments on standard learning-to-rank datasets with log-calibrated semi-synthetic income environments based on advertising and e-commerce logs show that DIDRF consistently improves income fairness over representative fair-ranking baselines while preserving competitive ranking effectiveness.

AI.title_translation: 超越曝光：使用非线性时间-收入函数优化排序公平性
AI.tldr: 现有公平排序方法侧重于曝光公平性，但实际效用是曝光带来的收入。本文提出了DIDRF算法，旨在实现收入公平性，实验证明其在保持排序有效性的同时显著提高了收入公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有公平排序方法普遍关注曝光公平性，然而曝光往往只是一个中间信号，提供者实际获得的效用（收入）取决于上下文相关的从曝光到收入的转化。本文旨在解决这一局限性，将公平性优化扩展到更实际的提供者收入层面。
AI.method: 本文将收入公平性形式化，要求累积提供者收入与相关性成比例，并定义了一个基于此比例条件的收入不公平性度量。在此基础上，提出了一种动态收入导数感知排序公平性算法（DIDRF）。DIDRF利用收入公平性违规的二次结构，推导出一个状态感知评分规则，该规则同时考虑了排序有效性和每个排序决策对累积收入公平性的边际效应。
AI.result: 在标准学习排名数据集上，通过基于广告和电子商务日志的对数校准半合成收入环境进行的实验表明，DIDRF在保持竞争性排序有效性的同时，始终比代表性的公平排序基线显著提高收入公平性。
AI.conclusion: DIDRF算法能够有效提高排序系统中的收入公平性，这对于超越单纯曝光的提供者效用至关重要，同时还能保持排序的有效性。
AI.translation:
网络搜索和推荐中的排序系统在项目和提供者之间分配注意力，因此需要平衡基于相关性的有效性与提供者公平性。现有的公平排序方法通常侧重于曝光公平性，即累积曝光量按项目价值比例分配。然而，曝光通常只是一个中间信号：提供者实际获得的效用可能取决于上下文相关的从曝光到收入的转化，例如点击、购买或广告价值。
本文研究了在上下文相关的提供者效用（我们称之为收入）下的公平排序。我们通过要求累积提供者收入与相关性成比例来形式化收入公平性，并基于这种比例条件定义了收入不公平性度量。然后，我们提出了DIDRF，一种动态收入导数感知排序公平性算法，用于实现收入公平排序。DIDRF利用收入公平性违规的二次结构来推导出一个状态感知评分规则，该规则共同考虑了排序有效性以及每个排序决策对累积收入公平性的边际效应。
在标准学习排名数据集上，通过基于广告和电子商务日志的对数校准半合成收入环境进行的实验表明，DIDRF在保持竞争性排序有效性的同时，始终比代表性的公平排序基线显著提高收入公平性。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有公平排序方法仅关注曝光公平性的局限性，引入了“收入公平性”的概念，即提供者实际效用（通过点击、购买等转化获得的收入）应与相关性成比例。论文形式化了这一概念，定义了收入不公平性度量，并提出了一种名为DIDRF（动态收入导数感知排序公平性）的算法。DIDRF采用状态感知评分规则，平衡排序有效性与对累积收入公平性的边际影响。实验证明，DIDRF在保持有效性的同时，显著提升了收入公平性。
AI.keywords: 排序公平性, 收入公平性, 动态排序, 推荐系统, DIDRF
AI.comments: 本文通过将公平性考量从传统的“曝光公平性”提升到更具实际意义的“收入公平性”，在排序公平性研究领域做出了重要贡献。所提出的DIDRF算法通过结合状态感知评分规则和对边际效应的考量，展现了创新性。这项工作对提升网络搜索和推荐平台长期可持续性和公平性具有重要的实际意义。

title: Agent Primitives: Reusable Latent Building Blocks for Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
While existing multi-agent systems (MAS) can handle complex problems by enabling collaboration among multiple agents, they are often highly task-specific, relying on manually crafted agent roles and interaction prompts, which leads to increased architectural complexity and limited reusability across tasks. Moreover, most MAS communicate primarily through natural language, making them vulnerable to error accumulation and instability in long-context, multi-stage interactions within internal agent histories.
  In this work, we propose \textbf{Agent Primitives}, a set of reusable latent building blocks for LLM-based MAS. Inspired by neural network design, where complex models are built from reusable components, we observe that many existing MAS architectures can be decomposed into a small number of recurring internal computation patterns. Based on this observation, we instantiate three primitives: Review, Voting and Selection, and Planning and Execution. All primitives communicate internally via key-value (KV) cache, which improves both robustness and efficiency by mitigating information degradation across multi-stage interactions. To enable automatic system construction, an Organizer agent selects and composes primitives for each query, guided by a lightweight knowledge pool of previously successful configurations, forming a primitive-based MAS.
  Experiments show that primitives-based MAS improve average accuracy by 12.0-16.5\% over single-agent baselines, reduce token usage and inference latency by approximately 3$\times$-4$\times$ compared to text-based MAS, while incurring only 1.3$\times$-1.6$\times$ overhead relative to single-agent inference and providing more stable performance across model backbones.

AI.title_translation: 智能体原语：多智能体系统的可重用潜在构建模块
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“智能体原语”，一种将多智能体系统分解为可重用潜在模块的方法。这些原语通过键值（KV）缓存进行内部通信，显著提高了多智能体系统的准确性、效率和稳定性，解决了现有系统任务特异性强和通信效率低的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）通常任务特异性强，依赖手动设计的智能体角色和交互提示，导致架构复杂且重用性有限。此外，大多数MAS主要通过自然语言通信，这在内部智能体历史的长上下文、多阶段交互中容易导致错误累积和系统不稳定。
AI.method: 本文提出了“智能体原语”，一套用于基于LLM的多智能体系统的可重用潜在构建模块。受神经网络设计的启发，作者观察到许多现有MAS架构可以分解为少量重复的内部计算模式。基于此，实例化了三个原语：审查、投票和选择、规划和执行。所有原语通过键值（KV）缓存进行内部通信，以提高鲁棒性和效率。为了实现系统自动构建，一个组织者智能体根据一个轻量级知识池（包含先前成功的配置）来选择和组合原语，形成一个基于原语的MAS。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于原语的MAS与单智能体基线相比，平均准确率提高了12.0-16.5%；与基于文本的MAS相比，token使用量和推理延迟减少了约3-4倍；相对于单智能体推理，仅产生了1.3-1.6倍的开销；并且在不同的模型骨干网络上提供了更稳定的性能。
AI.conclusion: 智能体原语通过提供可重用、高效且鲁棒的构建块，有效解决了传统多智能体系统在任务特异性、效率和稳定性方面的挑战，显著提升了LLM驱动的多智能体系统的性能和实际应用潜力。
AI.translation:
虽然现有的多智能体系统（MAS）能够通过使多个智能体协作来处理复杂问题，但它们通常高度任务特异性，依赖于手动设计的智能体角色和交互提示，这导致架构复杂性增加和跨任务重用性受限。此外，大多数MAS主要通过自然语言进行通信，这使得它们在内部智能体历史的长上下文、多阶段交互中容易受到错误累积和不稳定的影响。
在这项工作中，我们提出了“智能体原语”，一套用于基于LLM的多智能体系统的可重用潜在构建模块。受神经网络设计的启发，其中复杂模型由可重用组件构建，我们观察到许多现有MAS架构可以分解为少量重复的内部计算模式。基于这一观察，我们实例化了三个原语：审查、投票和选择，以及规划和执行。所有原语通过键值（KV）缓存进行内部通信，这通过减轻多阶段交互中的信息退化来提高鲁棒性和效率。为了实现自动系统构建，一个组织者智能体根据一个轻量级知识池（包含先前成功的配置）为每个查询选择和组合原语，形成一个基于原语的MAS。
实验表明，基于原语的MAS与单智能体基线相比，平均准确率提高了12.0-16.5％，与基于文本的MAS相比，token使用量和推理延迟减少了大约3-4倍，同时相对于单智能体推理仅产生了1.3-1.6倍的开销，并在不同模型骨干网络上提供了更稳定的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“智能体原语”的新方法，旨在解决现有大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）在任务特异性、效率和稳定性方面的局限性。通过将MAS架构分解为可重用的潜在构建模块（如审查、投票和选择、规划和执行），并利用键值（KV）缓存进行高效内部通信，该方法显著提高了系统的性能。实验结果表明，基于原语的MAS在准确率上优于单智能体基线，同时大幅减少了token使用和推理延迟，并提供了更稳定的性能。
AI.keywords: 智能体原语, 多智能体系统, 大型语言模型, 可重用模块, 键值缓存
AI.comments: 这项工作为多智能体系统的设计提供了一种新颖且模块化的范式，类似于软件工程中的组件化思想。其创新之处在于将神经网络的模块化思想应用于智能体系统，并引入了键值（KV）缓存作为高效、鲁棒的内部通信机制。这有效解决了LLM-based MAS在复杂性、效率和鲁棒性方面的挑战，为未来MAS的开发提供了重要的方向。

title: AgentArk: Distilling Multi-Agent Intelligence into a Single LLM Agent
summary: While large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems achieve superior reasoning performance through iterative debate, practical deployment is limited by their high computational cost and error propagation. This paper proposes AgentArk, a novel framework to distill multi-agent dynamics into the weights of a single model, effectively transforming explicit test-time interactions into implicit model capabilities. This equips a single agent with the intelligence of multi-agent systems while remaining computationally efficient. Specifically, we investigate three hierarchical distillation strategies across various models, tasks, scaling, and scenarios: reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning; trajectory-based augmentation; and process-aware distillation. By shifting the burden of computation from inference to training, the distilled models preserve the efficiency of one agent while exhibiting strong reasoning and self-correction performance of multiple agents. They further demonstrate enhanced robustness and generalization across diverse reasoning tasks. We hope this work can shed light on future research on efficient and robust multi-agent development. Our code is at https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/AgentArk.

AI.title_translation: AgentArk：将多智能体智能蒸馏到单个大型语言模型智能体中
AI.tldr: AgentArk是一个新颖的框架，旨在将多智能体系统的动态蒸馏到单个大型语言模型（LLM）的权重中，从而使单个智能体能够拥有多智能体的智能，同时保持计算效率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型多智能体系统虽然通过迭代辩论实现了卓越的推理性能，但其高昂的计算成本和错误传播限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 本文提出了AgentArk框架，通过将多智能体动态蒸馏到单个模型的权重中，将显式测试时交互转化为隐式模型能力。具体而言，研究了三种分层蒸馏策略：推理增强微调、基于轨迹的增强和过程感知蒸馏，并在各种模型、任务、规模和场景下进行了研究。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的模型在保持单个智能体效率的同时，展现出强大的推理和自我纠正性能，并进一步在多样化的推理任务中表现出增强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作有望为未来高效、鲁棒的多智能体开发研究提供启示。
AI.translation: 虽然大型语言模型（LLM）多智能体系统通过迭代辩论实现了卓越的推理性能，但其高昂的计算成本和错误传播限制了实际部署。本文提出了AgentArk，一个将多智能体动态蒸馏到单个模型权重中的新颖框架，有效地将显式测试时交互转化为隐式模型能力。这使得单个智能体能够拥有多智能体系统的智能，同时保持计算效率。具体而言，我们研究了在各种模型、任务、规模和场景下的三种分层蒸馏策略：推理增强微调；基于轨迹的增强；以及过程感知蒸馏。通过将计算负担从推理转移到训练，蒸馏后的模型在保持单个智能体效率的同时，展现出强大的多智能体强大的推理和自我纠正性能。它们进一步在多样化的推理任务中表现出增强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。我们希望这项工作能为未来高效、鲁棒的多智能体开发研究提供启示。我们的代码位于https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/AgentArk。
AI.summary: AgentArk是一个旨在解决多智能体系统高计算成本和错误传播问题的新框架。它通过将多智能体系统的智能蒸馏到单个大型语言模型中，实现了在保持计算效率的同时，提升单个智能体的推理、自我纠正、鲁棒性和泛化能力。该方法采用了推理增强微调、基于轨迹的增强和过程感知蒸馏三种策略。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 大型语言模型, 智能蒸馏, 计算效率, 推理性能
AI.comments: AgentArk的创新之处在于提出了一种将复杂多智能体系统智能“压缩”到单个LLM中的方法，从而解决了多智能体部署的实际瓶颈。通过将计算负担从推理转移到训练，它有效地平衡了性能和效率，对未来高效AI智能体开发具有重要意义。

title: Efficient Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models via Static-Dynamic Disentanglement
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist robotic control. Built upon vision-language model (VLM) architectures, VLAs predict actions conditioned on visual observations and language instructions, achieving strong performance and generalization across tasks. However, VLAs face two major challenges: a limited context window for input frames and inefficient inference due to the quadratic attention complexity and large parameter counts. To this end, we propose DySta, a framework that disentangles visual inputs into multi-level static and dynamic tokens, which enables (1) retaining a single copy of static tokens across frames to significantly reduce context length, and (2) reusing the key-value (KV) cache of static tokens through a lightweight recache gate that updates only when necessary. This design enables efficient multi-frame integration and efficient inference. In addition, we introduce a new benchmark that more effectively evaluates the multi-frame integration ability of VLAs. Experiments show that Dysta improves multi-frame integration by 24.5% across metrics on our benchmark and 23.3% in absolute success rate on real-world memory-dependent tasks, while accelerating inference by 2.0x (with +2.3% success rate) on simulation benchmarks and 2.2x (with +10.6% success rate) on real-world general tasks.

AI.title_translation: 高效长视域视觉-语言-动作模型，通过静态-动态解耦
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了DySta框架，通过将视觉输入解耦为静态和动态标记，解决了现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在长上下文处理和推理效率上的挑战。DySta通过保留静态标记的单一副本和选择性更新其KV缓存，显著减少了上下文长度并提高了推理速度。同时，引入了一个新的基准来评估多帧集成能力。实验证明DySta在多帧集成、成功率和推理速度方面均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人控制方面展现了巨大潜力，但面临着输入帧上下文窗口有限和由于二次注意力复杂性及模型参数量大导致的推理效率低下两大挑战。
AI.method: 提出DySta框架，将视觉输入解耦为多层级的静态标记和动态标记。静态标记在不同帧之间保留单一副本以减少上下文长度；通过一个轻量级的、仅在必要时更新的“recache gate”来重用静态标记的键值（KV）缓存，从而实现高效的多帧集成和推理。
AI.result: DySta在新的基准测试中将多帧集成能力提高了24.5%，在真实世界的记忆依赖型任务中成功率提高了23.3%。在模拟基准测试中，推理速度提高了2.0倍（成功率提升2.3%）；在真实世界的通用任务中，推理速度提高了2.2倍（成功率提升10.6%）。
AI.conclusion: DySta框架通过静态-动态解耦的创新方法，有效解决了VLA模型在长上下文处理和推理效率方面的瓶颈，并在多项基准和真实世界任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近已成为通用机器人控制的有希望的范例。VLA模型基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）架构，对视觉观察和语言指令进行条件预测动作，在跨任务的性能和泛化能力方面取得了优异的成绩。然而，VLA面临两个主要挑战：输入帧的上下文窗口有限，以及由于二次注意力的复杂性和庞大的参数数量导致的推理效率低下。为此，我们提出了DySta框架，将视觉输入解耦为多层级的静态标记和动态标记，这使得（1）在不同帧之间保留静态标记的单一副本，以显著减少上下文长度，以及（2）通过仅在必要时更新的轻量级recache门重用静态标记的键值（KV）缓存。这种设计能够实现高效的多帧集成和高效推理。此外，我们引入了一个新的基准，可以更有效地评估VLA的多帧集成能力。实验表明，DySta在我们提出的基准测试中将多帧集成能力提高了24.5%，在真实世界的记忆依赖型任务中成功率提高了23.3%，同时在模拟基准测试中将推理速度提高了2.0倍（成功率+2.3%），在真实世界的通用任务中提高了2.2倍（成功率+10.6%）。
AI.summary: 本研究提出DySta框架，旨在解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在处理长上下文和推理效率方面的挑战。DySta通过将视觉输入分解为静态和动态标记，实现了上下文长度的缩减和推理速度的提升。此外，研究还引入了一个新的基准来评估VLA的多帧集成能力。实验结果表明，DySta在多帧集成、任务成功率和推理速度方面均表现出色。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 长上下文, 推理效率, 静态-动态解耦, 多帧集成
AI.comments: DySta框架通过静态-动态解耦的思路，巧妙地解决了VLA模型在处理长序列输入时的效率问题，这是一个非常实际且重要的研究方向。其通过复用静态信息和选择性更新动态信息的设计，既保证了信息的完整性，又大大降低了计算成本。新基准的引入也为后续该领域的研究提供了有力的评估工具。然而，对于“recache gate”的具体实现细节和其在不同场景下的鲁棒性，可能还需要进一步的探讨。

title: Scalable Explainability-as-a-Service (XaaS) for Edge AI Systems
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. This version updates metadata after publication in IEEE Xplore and publication by SoutheastCon 2026
summary: Though Explainable AI (XAI) has made significant advancements, its inclusion in edge and IoT systems is typically ad-hoc and inefficient. Most current methods are "coupled" in such a way that they generate explanations simultaneously with model inferences. As a result, these approaches incur redundant computation, high latency and poor scalability when deployed across heterogeneous sets of edge devices. In this work we propose Explainability-as-a-Service (XaaS), a distributed architecture for treating explainability as a first-class system service (as opposed to a model-specific feature). The key innovation in our proposed XaaS architecture is that it decouples inference from explanation generation allowing edge devices to request, cache and verify explanations subject to resource and latency constraints. To achieve this, we introduce three main innovations: (1) A distributed explanation cache with a semantic similarity based explanation retrieval method which significantly reduces redundant computation; (2) A lightweight verification protocol that ensures the fidelity of both cached and newly generated explanations; and (3) An adaptive explanation engine that chooses explanation methods based upon device capability and user requirement. We evaluated the performance of XaaS on three real-world edgeAI use cases: (i) manufacturing quality control; (ii) autonomous vehicle perception; and (iii) healthcare diagnostics. Experimental results show that XaaS reduces latency by 38% while maintaining high explanation quality across three real-world deployments. Overall, this work enables the deployment of transparent and accountable AI across large scale, heterogeneous IoT systems, and bridges the gap between XAI research and edge-practicality.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. This version updates metadata after publication in IEEE Xplore and publication by SoutheastCon 2026

AI.title_translation: 面向边缘AI系统的可扩展“可解释性即服务”(XaaS)
AI.tldr: XaaS将可解释性从模型推理中解耦，通过分布式缓存和自适应引擎，在边缘AI系统中降低了38%的延迟，实现了高效的可解释性服务。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法在边缘设备上通常与模型推理耦合，导致计算冗余、高延迟且难以在异构设备上扩展，缺乏系统级的可解释性支持。
AI.method: 提出XaaS架构：1. 使用基于语义相似度的分布式解释缓存；2. 实施轻量级验证协议以确保解释忠实度；3. 采用自适应解释引擎，根据设备能力和需求选择解释方法。
AI.result: 在三个真实边缘AI场景中，XaaS在保持高解释质量的同时，将系统延迟降低了38%。
AI.conclusion: XaaS通过解耦推理与解释生成，实现了边缘AI系统中高效、可扩展且可靠的可解释性服务，有效弥补了XAI研究与边缘部署之间的差距。
AI.translation: 尽管可解释人工智能（XAI）已取得重大进展，但其在边缘和物联网系统中的应用通常是临时且低效的。目前大多数方法都是“耦合”的，即在进行模型推理的同时生成解释。因此，这些方法在部署于异构边缘设备集时，会导致计算冗余、高延迟和扩展性差。在这项工作中，我们提出了“可解释性即服务”（XaaS），这是一种将可解释性视为一等系统服务（而不是特定于模型的特征）的分布式架构。我们提出的XaaS架构的关键创新在于它将推理与解释生成解耦，允许边缘设备在资源和延迟限制下请求、缓存和验证解释。为了实现这一点，我们引入了三项主要创新：（1）一种基于语义相似度的分布式解释缓存和检索方法，显著减少了冗余计算；（2）一种确保缓存和新生成解释忠实度的轻量级验证协议；（3）一种根据设备能力和用户需求选择解释方法的自适应解释引擎。我们在三个真实的边缘AI用例上评估了XaaS的性能：（i）制造质量控制；（ii）自动驾驶感知；以及（iii）医疗诊断。实验结果表明，XaaS在三个真实部署中将延迟降低了38%，同时保持了高质量的解释。总的来说，这项工作实现了透明和可负责任的AI在大规模、异构物联网系统中的部署，并弥补了XAI研究与边缘实用性之间的差距。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为XaaS的分布式架构，将可解释性作为边缘AI系统的独立服务。通过将解释生成与模型推理解耦，并引入分布式缓存、验证协议和自适应引擎，有效解决了边缘环境下的计算冗余和延迟问题。
AI.keywords: 边缘AI, 可解释人工智能(XAI), 服务化架构, 分布式缓存, 模型推理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的系统架构，将可解释性从模型中解耦出来作为独立服务，这对边缘计算领域具有重要意义。其通过缓存和验证机制解决了计算冗余和资源限制问题，具有很强的工程实用价值。

title: Generative Neural Operators through Diffusion Last Layer
comments: ICML 2026, code is available at https://github.com/sungwpark/dll-no
summary: Neural operators provide a powerful framework for learning discretization invariant mappings between function spaces, but standard deterministic models do not capture predictive uncertainty. We introduce diffusion last layer (DLL), a modular probabilistic output head for neural operator backbones. DLL represents target fields through an input dependent low rank expansion inspired by the Karhunen-Loéve expansion and learns a conditional diffusion model over the corresponding coefficient space. This design enables efficient distributional modeling while preserving the structural advantages of operator learning. On stochastic PDE benchmarks with random forcing, DLL achieves strong distributional fidelity and performs competitively with pixel space and conventional latent diffusion baselines. In deterministic long horizon rollout tasks, DLL improves rollout stability over the underlying backbone and provides useful estimates of predictive uncertainty under compounding autoregressive errors. These results suggest that diffusion modeling in learned coefficient spaces offers a practical route to uncertainty aware neural operators.
comment: ICML 2026, code is available at https://github.com/sungwpark/dll-no

AI.title_translation: 生成式神经算子与扩散最后层
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为扩散最后层（DLL）的模块化概率输出头，用于神经算子模型，以解决现有确定性模型无法捕捉预测不确定性的问题。DLL通过一种受Karhunen-Loéve展开启发的低秩展开来表示目标场，并在相应的系数空间上学习条件扩散模型，从而实现高效的分布建模并保留神经算子的结构优势。实验证明，DLL在随机偏微分方程基准测试和确定性长期预测任务中均表现出色，能够提供准确的分布保真度，并在长期预测中提高稳定性并估计预测不确定性。
AI.motivation: 标准的确定性神经算子模型无法捕捉预测不确定性，限制了其在需要量化不确定性的应用中的使用。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为扩散最后层（DLL）的模块化概率输出头，它将目标场表示为一种输入相关的低秩展开，并在系数空间上学习条件扩散模型。
AI.result: 在随机偏微分方程基准测试中，DLL实现了良好的分布保真度，并与像素空间和传统的潜在扩散基线模型相比具有竞争力。在确定性长期预测任务中，DLL提高了模型预测的稳定性，并能有效估计累积自回归误差下的预测不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 在学习到的系数空间中进行扩散建模为构建具有不确定性感知能力的神经算子提供了一条实用的途径。
AI.translation: 神经算子提供了一个强大的框架，用于学习函数空间之间离散化不变的映射，但标准的确定性模型无法捕捉预测的不确定性。我们引入了扩散最后层（DLL），这是神经算子骨干的模块化概率输出头。DLL通过一种受Karhunen-Loéve展开启发的、与输入相关的低秩展开来表示目标场，并在相应的系数空间上学习条件扩散模型。这种设计能够实现高效的分布建模，同时保留算子学习的结构优势。在具有随机强迫的随机偏微分方程基准测试中，DLL实现了强大的分布保真度，并且与像素空间和传统的潜在扩散基线模型相比具有竞争力。在确定性长期预测任务中，DLL提高了基础模型的预测稳定性，并在累积自回归误差下提供了有用的预测不确定性估计。这些结果表明，在学习到的系数空间中进行扩散建模为实现具有不确定性感知能力的神经算子提供了一条实用的途径。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为扩散最后层（DLL）的新型概率输出头，用于增强神经算子模型以处理预测不确定性。DLL通过在学习到的系数空间中应用条件扩散模型，实现了高效的分布建模，并成功应用于随机偏微分方程和长期预测任务，在准确性和稳定性方面均表现优异。
AI.keywords: 神经算子, 扩散模型, 概率输出, 不确定性估计, 系数空间
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将扩散模型与神经算子相结合，通过在系数空间而非原始像素空间进行建模，有效解决了预测不确定性问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了有竞争力的结果。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的低秩展开方法或与其他概率建模技术结合。

title: ECG-R1: Protocol-Guided and Modality-Agnostic MLLM for Reliable ECG Interpretation
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) serves as an indispensable diagnostic tool in clinical practice, yet existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain unreliable for ECG interpretation, often producing plausible but clinically incorrect analyses. To address this, we propose ECG-R1, the first reasoning ECG MLLM designed for reliable ECG interpretation via three innovations. First, we construct the interpretation corpus using \textit{Protocol-Guided Instruction Data Generation}, grounding interpretation in measurable ECG features and monograph-defined quantitative thresholds and diagnostic logic. Second, we present a modality-decoupled architecture with \textit{Interleaved Modality Dropout} to improve robustness and cross-modal consistency when either the ECG signal or ECG image is missing. Third, we present \textit{Reinforcement Learning with ECG Diagnostic Evidence Rewards} to strengthen evidence-grounded ECG interpretation. Additionally, we systematically evaluate the ECG interpretation capabilities of proprietary, open-source, and medical MLLMs, and provide the first quantitative evidence that severe hallucinations are widespread, suggesting that the public should not directly trust these outputs without independent verification. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/ECG-R1}{here}.

title: Counterfactual Explanations for Hypergraph Neural Networks
summary: Hypergraph neural networks (HGNNs) effectively model higher-order interactions in many real-world systems but remain difficult to interpret, limiting their deployment in high-stakes settings. We introduce CF-HyperGNNExplainer, a counterfactual explanation method for HGNNs that identifies the minimal structural changes required to alter a model's prediction. The method generates counterfactual hypergraphs using actionable edits limited to removing node-hyperedge incidences or deleting hyperedges, producing concise and structurally meaningful explanations. Extensive experiments on hypergraph benchmark datasets show that CF-HyperGNNExplainer generates valid and concise counterfactuals, highlighting the higher-order relations most critical to HGNN decisions.

title: Inference-Time Backdoors via Chat Templates: From LLM Supply Chains to Agentic System Compromise
comments: V3: Accepted to ICLR 2026 Trustworthy AI Workshop, V4: Submitted to CCS 2026
summary: Open-weight language models are increasingly used in production settings, raising new security challenges. One prominent threat is backdoor attacks, in which adversaries embed hidden behaviors that activate under specific conditions. Previous work has assumed that adversaries have access to training pipelines or deployment infrastructure. We propose a novel attack surface requiring neither: the "chat template". Chat templates are executable programs invoked at every inference call, often implemented in Jinja2, that occupy a privileged position between user input and model processing. We show that an adversary who distributes a model with a maliciously modified template can implant an inference-time backdoor without modifying model weights, poisoning training data, or controlling runtime infrastructure. We evaluate this attack across three deployment tiers. At the LLM level, triggered backdoors reduce factual accuracy from 90% to 15% on average and induce attacker-controlled URL emission with success rates exceeding 80%, while benign inputs show no measurable degradation; these results hold across eighteen models. At the agent level, template backdoors hijack tool-use across two benchmarks spanning 3,868 episodes, bypassing every tested injection defense offered by the benchmarks while remaining fully dormant absent the trigger. At the multi-agent system level, we demonstrate how a single poisoned artifact compromises a real-world agentic deployment and propagates supply-chain code poisoning downstream. The poisoned artifacts evade all security scans on the largest open model distribution platform; and because the payload is rendered by the template before user input is processed, it is architecturally unreachable by input-level defenses such as prompt injection guardrails. These results establish chat templates as a reliable and undefended attack in the open-weight AI supply chain.
comment: V3: Accepted to ICLR 2026 Trustworthy AI Workshop, V4: Submitted to CCS 2026

title: Light Forcing: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Sparse Attention
summary: Advanced autoregressive (AR) video generation models have improved visual fidelity and interactivity, but the quadratic complexity of attention remains a primary bottleneck for efficient deployment. While existing sparse attention solutions have shown promise on bidirectional models, we identify that applying these solutions to AR models leads to considerable performance degradation for two reasons: isolated consideration of chunk generation and insufficient utilization of past informative context. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textsc{Light Forcing}, the \textit{first} sparse attention solution tailored for AR video generation models. It incorporates a \textit{Chunk-Aware Growth} mechanism to quantitatively estimate the contribution of each chunk, which determines their sparsity allocation. This progressive sparsity increase strategy enables the current chunk to inherit prior knowledge in earlier chunks during generation. Additionally, we introduce a \textit{Hierarchical Sparse Attention} to capture informative historical and local context in a coarse-to-fine manner. Such two-level mask selection strategy (\ie, frame and block level) can adaptively handle diverse attention patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing sparse attention in quality (\eg, 84.5 on VBench) and efficiency (\eg, $1.2{\sim}1.3\times$ end-to-end speedup). Combined with FP8 quantization and LightVAE, \textsc{Light Forcing} further achieves a $2.3\times$ speedup and 19.7\,FPS on an RTX~5090 GPU. Code will be released at \href{https://github.com/chengtao-lv/LightForcing}{https://github.com/chengtao-lv/LightForcing}.

title: Learning, Solving and Optimizing PDEs with TensorGalerkin: an efficient high-performance Galerkin assembly algorithm
summary: We present a unified algorithmic framework for the numerical solution, constrained optimization, and physics-informed learning of PDEs with a variational structure. Our framework is based on a Galerkin discretization of the underlying variational forms, and its high efficiency stems from a novel highly-optimized and GPU-compliant TensorGalerkin framework for linear system assembly (stiffness matrices and load vectors). TensorGalerkin operates by tensorizing element-wise operations within a Python-level Map stage and then performs global reduction with a sparse matrix multiplication that performs message passing on the mesh-induced sparsity graph. The Map and Reduce stages are co-designed inside PyTorch's autograd so that the assembly graph contains $O(1)$ nodes regardless of how the number of elements and local DoFs scale. We validate this $O(1)$-graph property by deploying TensorGalerkin downstream as i) a highly-efficient numerical PDEs solver, ii) an end-to-end differentiable framework for PDE-constrained optimization, and iii) a physics-informed operator learning algorithm for PDEs. With multiple benchmarks, including 2D and 3D elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic PDEs on unstructured meshes, we demonstrate that the proposed framework provides significant computational efficiency and accuracy gains over a variety of baselines in all the targeted downstream applications.

title: Correcting Contextual Deletions in DNA Nanopore Readouts
comments: 40 pages, 0 figures, 3 tables. Revised the statement and proof of the $t$-contextual deletion-correcting code in [v1, Theorem 4] (now Theorem 5). Constructed an alternative $t$-contextual deletion-correcting code with smaller redundancy but higher time complexity (Theorem 4). Added further details throughout the manuscript
summary: The problem of designing codes for deletion-correction and synchronization has received renewed interest due to applications in DNA-based data storage systems that use nanopore sequencers as readout platforms. In almost all instances, deletions are assumed to be imposed independently of each other and of the sequence context. These assumptions are not valid in practice, since nanopore errors tend to occur within specific contexts. We study contextual nanopore deletion-errors through the example setting of deterministic single deletions following (complete) runlengths of length at least $k$. The model critically depends on the runlength threshold $k$, and we examine two regimes for $k$: a) $k=C\log n$ for a constant $C\in(0,1)$; in this case, we study error-correcting codes that can protect from a constant number $t$ of contextual deletions, and show that the minimum redundancy (ignoring lower-order terms) is between $(1-C)t\log n$ and $2(1-C)t\log n$, meaning that it is a ($1-C$)-fraction of that of arbitrary $t$-deletion-correcting codes. To complement our non-constructive redundancy upper bound, we design efficiently and encodable and decodable codes for any constant $t$. In particular, for $t=1$ and $C>1/2$ we construct efficient codes with redundancy that essentially matches our non-constructive upper bound; b) $k$ equal a constant; in this case we consider the extremal problem where the number of deletions is not bounded and a deletion is imposed after every run of length at least $k$, which we call the extremal contextual deletion channel. This combinatorial setting arises naturally by considering a probabilistic channel that introduces contextual deletions after each run of length at least $k$ with probability $p$ and taking the limit $p\to 1$. We obtain sharp bounds on the maximum achievable rate under the extremal contextual deletion channel for arbitrary constant $k$.

title: BlitzRank: Principled Zero-shot Ranking Agents with Tournament Graphs
summary: Selecting the top $m$ from $n$ items via expensive $k$-wise comparisons is central to settings ranging from LLM-based document reranking to crowdsourced evaluation and tournament design. Existing methods either rely on heuristics that discard comparison information, or exploit it at prohibitive cost. We introduce a tournament graph framework that provides a principled foundation for $k$-wise ranking. Our key observation is that each $k$-item comparison reveals an induced tournament of $\binom{k}{2}$ pairwise preferences; aggregating these into a global preference graph and computing its transitive closure yields many additional orderings without further oracle calls. We formalize when the current top-$m$ output is certifiably determined and design a greedy query schedule that maximizes information gain towards identifying the top-$m$ items. The framework also gracefully handles non-transitive preferences -- cycles induced by real-world oracles -- by collapsing them into equivalence classes that yield principled tiered rankings. Applied to LLM reranking across 14 benchmarks and 5 models, BlitzRank achieves Pareto dominance over existing approaches: matching or exceeding accuracy while requiring 25--40% fewer tokens than comparable methods; against pairwise reranking, it achieves near-identical quality with 7$\times$ fewer tokens. Code available at https://github.com/ContextualAI/BlitzRank.

title: Muon in Associative Memory Learning: Training Dynamics and Scaling Laws
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026; 53 pages
summary: Muon updates matrix parameters via the matrix sign of the gradient and has shown strong empirical gains, yet its dynamics and scaling behavior remain unclear in theory. We study Muon in a linear associative memory model with softmax retrieval and a hierarchical frequency spectrum over query-answer pairs, with and without label noise. In this setting, we show that Gradient Descent (GD) learns frequency components at highly imbalanced rates, leading to slow convergence bottlenecked by low-frequency components. In contrast, the Muon optimizer mitigates this imbalance, leading to faster and more uniform progress. Specifically, in the noiseless case, Muon achieves an exponential speedup over GD; in the noisy case with a power-law frequency spectrum, we derive Muon's scaling law and demonstrate its superior scaling efficiency over GD. Furthermore, we show that Muon can be interpreted as an implicit matrix preconditioner arising from adaptive task alignment and block-symmetric gradient structure. In contrast, the preconditioner with coordinate-wise sign operator could match Muon under oracle access to unknown task representations, which is infeasible for SignGD in practice. Experiments on synthetic long-tail classification and LLaMA-style pre-training corroborate the theory.
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026; 53 pages

title: Discrete diffusion samplers and bridges: Off-policy algorithms and applications in latent spaces
summary: Sampling from a distribution $p(x) \propto e^{-\mathcal{E}(x)}$ known up to a normalising constant is an important and challenging problem in statistics. Recent years have seen the rise of a new family of amortised sampling algorithms, commonly referred to as diffusion samplers, that enable fast and efficient sampling from an unnormalised density. Such algorithms have been widely studied for continuous-space sampling tasks; however, their application to problems in discrete space remains largely unexplored. Although some progress has been made in this area, discrete diffusion samplers do not take full advantage of ideas commonly used for continuous-space sampling. In this paper, we propose to bridge this gap by introducing off-policy training techniques for discrete diffusion samplers. We show that these techniques improve the performance of discrete samplers on both established and new synthetic benchmarks. Next, we generalise discrete diffusion samplers to the task of bridging between two arbitrary distributions, introducing data-to-energy Schrödinger bridge training for the discrete domain for the first time. Lastly, we showcase the application of the proposed diffusion samplers to data-free posterior sampling in the discrete latent spaces of image generative models.

title: LLM-SAA: LLM-persona Generated Distributions for Decision-making
summary: LLMs can generate a wealth of data, ranging from simulated personas imitating human valuations and preferences, to demand forecasts based on world knowledge. But how well do such LLM-generated distributions support downstream decision-making? For example, when pricing a new product, a firm could prompt an LLM to simulate how much consumers are willing to pay based on a product description, but how useful is the resulting distribution for optimizing the price? We refer to this approach as LLM-SAA, in which an LLM is used to construct an estimated distribution and the decision is then optimized under that distribution. In this paper, we study metrics to evaluate the quality of these LLM-generated distributions, based on the decisions they induce. Taking three canonical decision-making problems (assortment optimization, pricing, and newsvendor) as examples, we find that LLM-generated distributions are practically useful, especially in low-data regimes. We also show that decision-agnostic metrics such as Wasserstein distance can be misleading when evaluating these distributions for decision-making.

title: World-VLA-Loop: Closed-Loop Learning of Video World Model and VLA Policy
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can refine Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies beyond behavior cloning, but real-world RL remains expensive due to extensive rollouts, resets, supervision, and safety risks. Action-conditioned video world models offer an option to train in virtual environments, yet they exhibit imprecise action following, particularly on subtle near-success failures. Besides, they lack native reward signals for RL. Computing rewards based on inaccurate visual predictions remain unreliable. We introduce World-VLA-Loop, structured around two foundational designs and a higher-level co-evolving paradigm. We first curate SANS, dedicatedly mixing successful and near-success trajectories to improve action-outcome alignment. Then, we train a state-aware video world model that jointly predicts future frames and binary rewards from diffusion latents. It couples reward estimation to the generator rather than a separate module, and in turn, benefits visual prediction. Since VLA behavior shifts during RL, a fixed simulator can misalign with the updated policy, World-VLA-Loop therefore closes the loop by using the refined world model for iterative VLA post-training while feeding rollouts from each improved policy back to augment and fine-tune the world model. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, World-VLA-Loop substantially improves VLA performance while reducing reliance on costly physical interaction.

title: F-GRPO: Don't Let Your Policy Learn the Obvious and Forget the Rare
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is commonly based on group sampling to estimate advantages and stabilize policy updates. In practice, computational limits often rule out very large groups, so training proceeds with finite rollout sets that can reinforce only the correct behavior they expose. At practical group sizes, updates can miss rare-correct trajectories while still containing mixed rewards, concentrating probability on more common sampled solutions. We derive the probability of such prompt-local tail-miss events as a function of group size, showing non-monotonic behavior, and in the categorical abstraction characterize how unsampled-correct mass can shrink even as total correct mass grows. Motivated by this analysis, we propose a difficulty-aware scaling coefficient, inspired by Focal loss, that down-weights updates on high-success sampled groups. Empirically, categorical simulation illustrates the same effect in the categorical setting, Maze provides a single-solution test, and LLM experiments include a representative GRPO group-size sweep together with fixed-$N$ transfer across GRPO, DAPO, and CISPO. On Qwen2.5-7B at $N{=}8$, our method improves average math pass@256 from 64.1 $\rightarrow$ 70.3 (GRPO), 69.3 $\rightarrow$ 72.5 (DAPO), and 73.2 $\rightarrow$ 76.8 (CISPO); OOD pass@256 also improves in all three cases, without increasing group size or computational cost.

title: Physical Analogue Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks based on Reconfigurable Nonlinear-Processing Units
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) shift neural computation from linear layers to learnable nonlinear edge functions, but implementing these nonlinearities efficiently in hardware remains an open challenge. Here we introduce a physical analogue KAN architecture in which edge functions are realized in materia using reconfigurable nonlinear-processing units (RNPUs): multi-terminal nanoscale silicon devices whose input-output characteristics are tuned via control voltages. By combining multiple RNPUs into an edge processor and assembling these blocks into a reconfigurable analogue KAN (aKAN) architecture with integrated mixed-signal interfacing, we establish a realistic system-level hardware implementation that enables compact KAN-style regression and classification with programmable nonlinear transformations. Using experimentally calibrated RNPU models and hardware measurements, we demonstrate accurate function approximation across increasing task complexity while requiring fewer or comparable trainable parameters than multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). System-level estimates indicate an energy per inference of $\sim$250 pJ and an end-to-end inference latency of $\sim$600 ns for a representative workload, corresponding to a $\sim$10$^{2}$-10$^{3}\times$ reduction in energy accompanied by a $\sim$10$\times$ reduction in area compared to a digital fixed-point MLP at similar approximation error. These results establish RNPUs as scalable, hardware-native nonlinear computing primitives and identify analogue KAN architectures as a realistic silicon-based pathway toward energy-, latency-, and footprint-efficient analogue neural-network hardware, particularly for edge inference.

title: SoK: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC): Competition Design, Architectures, and Lessons Learned
comments: Version 1.1 (February 2026). Systematization of Knowledge and post-competition analysis of DARPA AIxCC (2023-2025)
summary: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC, 2023--2025) is the largest competition to date for building fully autonomous cyber reasoning systems (CRSs) that leverage recent advances in AI -- particularly large language models (LLMs) -- to discover and remediate vulnerabilities in real-world open-source software. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of AIxCC. Drawing on design documents, source code, execution traces, and discussions with organizers and competing teams, we examine the competition's structure and key design decisions, characterize the architectural approaches of finalist CRSs, and analyze competition results beyond the final scoreboard. Our analysis reveals the factors that truly drove CRS performance, identifies genuine technical advances achieved by teams, and exposes limitations that remain open for future research. We conclude with lessons for organizing future competitions and broader insights toward deploying autonomous CRSs in practice.
