title: QUTCC: Quantile Uncertainty Training and Conformal Calibration for Imaging Inverse Problems
summary: While deep learning offers tremendous promise for scientific and medical imaging, any failures and hallucinations (predictions that do not coincide with reality) are hard to pinpoint and can have serious downstream consequences. Uncertainty estimation techniques, such as conformal prediction, can help by predicting statistically valid error bars for a model's prediction. However, popular conformal prediction methods were not designed for high-dimensional image-valued problems and do not take into account spatial correlations within an image during conformal calibration, resulting in larger-than-necessary uncertainty intervals. We propose a practical simultaneous quantile regression method that enables non-linear, spatially-adaptive scaling during conformal calibration. Our method, QUTCC uses a U-Net architecture with a quantile embedding to learn a full conditional quantile distribution during training, and then leverages this non-linear, learned function for spatially-adaptive conformal calibration. At test time, our method can efficiently estimate uncertainty intervals with pixel-marginal coverage guarantees. In addition, QUTCC can also predict pixel-wise conditional probability density estimates without any built-in distributional assumptions. We evaluate our method on several denoising problems, accelerated magnetic resonance imaging, and quantitative phase microscopy. Our method consistently produces tighter uncertainty intervals than prior conformal methods at the same coverage level, can predict plausible conditional distributions for different tasks, and in some cases, high-uncertainty regions can help us locate hallucinations in a model's prediction.

title: Scalable Fluid Antenna Systems: A New Paradigm for Array Signal Processing
summary: Most existing antenna array-based source localization methods rely on fixed-position arrays (FPAs) and strict assumptions about source field conditions (near-field or far-field), which limits their effectiveness in complex, dynamic real-world scenarios where high-precision localization is required. In contrast, this paper introduces a novel scalable fluid antenna system (SFAS) that can dynamically adjust its aperture configuration to optimize performance for different localization tasks. Within this framework, we develop a two-stage source localization strategy based on the exact spatial geometry (ESG) model: the first stage uses a compact aperture configuration for initial direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation, while the second stage employs an expanded aperture for enhanced DOA and range estimation. The proposed approach eliminates the traditional need for signal separation or isolation to classify source types and enables a single SFAS array to achieve high localization accuracy without field-specific assumptions, model simplifications, or approximations, representing a new paradigm in array-based source localization. Extensive simulations demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in terms of localization accuracy, computational efficiency, and robustness to different source types.

title: Position: Towards Responsible Evaluation for Text-to-Speech
summary: Recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS) technology have enabled systems to generate speech that is often indistinguishable from human speech, bringing benefits to accessibility, content creation, and human-computer interaction. However, current evaluation practices are increasingly inadequate for capturing the full range of capabilities, limitations, and societal impacts of modern TTS systems. This position paper introduces the concept of Responsible Evaluation and argues that it is essential and urgent for the next phase of TTS development, structured through three progressive levels: (1) ensuring the faithful and accurate reflection of a model's true capabilities and limitations, with more robust, discriminative, and comprehensive objective and subjective scoring methodologies; (2) enabling comparability, standardization, and transferability through standardized benchmarks, transparent reporting, and transferable evaluation metrics; and (3) assessing governance, fairness, and security concerns around data provenance, disparities, misuse, spoofing, and traceability. Through this concept, we critically examine current evaluation practices, identify systemic shortcomings, and propose actionable recommendations. We hope this concept will not only foster more reliable TTS technology but also guide its development toward ethically sound and societally beneficial applications.

title: Active Localization of Close-range Adversarial Acoustic Sources for Underwater Data Center Surveillance
summary: Underwater data infrastructures offer natural cooling and enhanced physical security compared to terrestrial facilities, but their storage systems remain susceptible to acoustic injection attacks, where sound-induced mechanical vibrations disrupt critical I/O operations and compromise data availability. This work presents a surveillance framework for localizing and tracking such close-range adversarial acoustic sources targeting offshore infrastructures, particularly underwater data centers (UDCs). We propose a scalable heterogeneous receiver configuration with one facility-mounted hydrophone and one mobile hydrophone carried by a surveillance robot. The resulting problem differs from conventional sound source localization (SSL) due to distributed facility scale, narrowband signaling with phase ambiguity, non-cooperative sources, and mobile receiver state uncertainty. To address these challenges, we formulate a Locus-Conditioned Maximum A-Posteriori (LC-MAP) scheme that generates acoustically informed priors, ensuring a physically plausible initial state for a joint time- and frequency-difference-of-arrival (TDOA-FDOA) filtering. We integrate this into an unscented Kalman filter (UKF) pipeline, along with a multipath-aware measurement model that compensates for surface and bed reflections, and an effective measurement covariance that accounts for mobile receiver uncertainty. Extensive Monte Carlo analyses, fixed-array baseline comparisons, Gazebo-based physics simulations, and field trials demonstrate reliable real-time localization and tracking. The framework achieves sub-meter localization accuracy and over 90% success rates in most scenarios, with convergence times nearly halved compared to baselines. Overall, this study establishes a geometry-aware, real-time approach for acoustic threat localization and advances autonomous surveillance capabilities of underwater infrastructure.

title: Reading Radio from Camera: Visually-Grounded, Lightweight, and Interpretable RSSI Prediction
comments: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Communications, 2026
summary: Accurate, real-time wireless signal prediction is essential for next-generation networks. However, existing vision-based frameworks often rely on computationally intensive models and are also sensitive to environmental interference. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel, physics-guided and light-weighted framework that predicts the received signal strength indicator (RSSI) from camera images. By decomposing RSSI into its physically interpretable components, path loss and shadow fading, we significantly reduce the model's learning difficulty and exhibit interpretability. Our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art by demonstrating exceptional robustness to environmental interference, a critical flaw in prior work. Quantitatively, our model reduces the prediction root mean squared error (RMSE) by 50.3% under conventional conditions and still achieves an 11.5% lower RMSE than the previous benchmark's interference-eliminated results. This superior performance is achieved with a remarkably lightweight framework, utilizing a MobileNet-based model up to 19 times smaller than competing solutions. The combination of high accuracy, robustness to interference, and computational efficiency makes our framework highly suitable for real-time, on-device deployment in edge devices, paving the way for more intelligent and reliable wireless communication systems.
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Communications, 2026

title: Online Learning of Modular Bayesian Deep Receivers: Single-Step Adaptation with Streaming Data
comments: Under review for publication in the IEEE
summary: Deep neural network (DNN)-based receivers offer a powerful alternative to classical model-based designs for wireless communication, especially in complex and nonlinear propagation environments. However, their adoption is challenged by the rapid variability of wireless channels, which makes pre-trained static DNN-based receivers ineffective, and by the latency and computational burden of online stochastic gradient descent (SGD)-based learning. In this work, we propose an online learning framework that enables rapid low-complexity adaptation of DNN-based receivers. Our approach is based on two main tenets. First, we cast online learning as Bayesian tracking in parameter space, enabling a single-step adaptation, which deviates from multi-epoch SGD . Second, we focus on modular DNN architectures that enable parallel, online, and localized variational Bayesian updates. Simulations with practical communication channels demonstrate that our proposed online learning framework can maintain a low error rate with markedly reduced update latency and increased robustness to channel dynamics as compared to traditional gradient descent based method.
comment: Under review for publication in the IEEE

title: Fractional Programming and Manifold Optimization for Reciprocal BD-RIS Scattering Matrix Design
summary: We investigate the problem of maximizing the sum-rate performance of a beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS)-aided multi-user (MU)-multiple-input single-output (MISO) system using fractional programming (FP) techniques. More specifically, we leverage the Lagrangian Dual Transform (LDT) and Quadratic Transform (QT) to derive an equivalent objective function which is then solved iteratively via a manifold optimization framework. It is shown that these techniques reduce the complexity of the optimization problem for the scattering matrix solution, while also providing notable performance gains compared to state-of-the-art (SotA) methods under the same system conditions. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving sum-rate performance.

title: Distributed Riemannian Optimization in Geodesically Non-convex Environments
summary: This paper studies the problem of distributed Riemannian optimization over a network of agents whose cost functions are geodesically smooth but possibly geodesically non-convex. Extending a well-known distributed optimization strategy called diffusion adaptation to Riemannian manifolds, we show that the resulting algorithm, the Riemannian diffusion adaptation, provably exhibits several desirable behaviors when minimizing a sum of geodesically smooth non-convex functions over manifolds of bounded curvature. More specifically, we establish that the algorithm can approximately achieve network agreement in the sense that Fréchet variance of the iterates among the agents is small. Moreover, the algorithm is guaranteed to converge to a first-order stationary point for general geodesically non-convex cost functions. When the global cost function additionally satisfies the local Riemannian Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition, we also show that it converges linearly under a constant step size up to a steady-state error. Finally, we apply this algorithm to a decentralized robust principal component analysis (PCA) problem formulated on the Grassmann manifold and low-rank matrix completion problems and illustrate its convergence and performance through numerical simulations.

title: FlowSteer: Conditioning Flow Field for Consistent Image Restoration
comments: Accepted by CVPRF 2026. Camera Ready version. Project page is \href{https://tharindu-nirmal.github.io/FlowSteer/}{in this link}
summary: Flow-based text-to-image (T2I) models excel at prompt-driven image generation, but falter on Image Restoration (IR), often "drifting away" from being faithful to the measurement. Prior work mitigate this drift with data-specific flows or task-specific adapters that are computationally heavy and not scalable across tasks. This raises the question "Can't we efficiently manipulate the existing generative capabilities of a flow model?" To this end, we introduce FlowSteer (FS), an operator-aware conditioning scheme that injects measurement priors along the sampling path,coupling a frozed flow's implicit guidance with explicit measurement constraints. Across super-resolution, deblurring, denoising, and colorization, FS improves measurement consistency and identity preservation in a strictly zero-shot setting-no retrained models, no adapters. We show how the nature of flow models and their sensitivities to noise inform the design of such a scheduler. FlowSteer, although simple, achieves a higher fidelity of reconstructed images, while leveraging the rich generative priors of flow models. All data and code will be publicly available \href{https://tharindu-nirmal.github.io/FlowSteer/}{in this link}.
comment: Accepted by CVPRF 2026. Camera Ready version. Project page is \href{https://tharindu-nirmal.github.io/FlowSteer/}{in this link}

title: Hyperspectral Image Data Reduction for Endmember Extraction
summary: Endmember extraction from hyperspectral images aims to identify the spectral signatures of materials present in a scene. Recent studies have shown that self-dictionary methods can achieve high extraction accuracy; however, their high computational cost limits their applicability to large-scale hyperspectral images. Although several approaches have been proposed to mitigate this issue, it remains a major challenge. Motivated by this situation, this paper pursues a data reduction approach. Assuming that a hyperspectral image follows the linear mixing model with the pure-pixel assumption, we develop a data reduction technique to remove pixels corresponding to mixtures of multiple endmember signatures. We analyze the theoretical properties of this reduction step and show that it preserves pixels that lie close to the endmembers. Building on this result, we propose a data-reduced self-dictionary method that integrates the data reduction with a self-dictionary method based on a linear programming formulation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can substantially reduce the computational time of the original self-dictionary method without sacrificing endmember extraction accuracy.

title: Performance Analysis for Wireless Localization with Random Sensor Network
summary: Accurate wireless localization underpins applications from autonomous systems to smart infrastructure. We study the mean-squared error (MSE) and conditional MSE (CMSE) of a practical fusion-based estimator in d-dimensional, stationary isotropic (translation- and rotation-invariant) random sensor networks, where a central processor combines received-signal-strength (RSS) and angle-of-arrival (AOA) measurements to infer a target's position. Our contributions are twofold. First, we establish an approximation theorem: when measurement noise is sufficiently large, the joint law of RSS and AOA observations under a broad class of stationary isotropic deployments is, in distribution, indistinguishable from that induced by a homogeneous Poisson point process (PPP). Second, leveraging this equivalence, we investigate a homogeneous PPP-based sensor network. We propose a fusion-based estimator in which a central processor aggregates RSS and AOA measurements from a set of spatially distributed sensors to infer the target position. For this PPP deployment within a finite observation region, we derive tractable analytical upper bounds for both the MSE and CMSE, establishing explicit scaling laws with respect to sensor density, observation radius, and noise variance. The approximation theorem then certifies these PPP-based bounds as reasonable proxies for non-Poisson deployments in noisy regimes. Overall, the results translate deployment and sensing parameters into achievable accuracy targets and provide robust, cost-aware guidance for the design of next-generation location-aware wireless networks.

title: Pixelwise Uncertainty Quantification of Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
summary: Parallel imaging techniques reduce magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan time but image quality degrades as the acceleration factor increases. In clinical practice, conservative acceleration factors are chosen because no mechanism exists to automatically assess the diagnostic quality of undersampled reconstructions. This work introduces a general framework for pixel-wise uncertainty quantification in parallel MRI reconstructions, enabling automatic identification of unreliable regions without access to any ground-truth reference image. Our method integrates conformal quantile regression with image reconstruction methods to estimate statistically rigorous pixel-wise uncertainty intervals. We trained and evaluated our model on Cartesian undersampled brain and knee data obtained from the fastMRI dataset using acceleration factors ranging from 2 to 10. An end-to-end Variational Network was used for image reconstruction. Quantitative experiments demonstrate strong agreement between predicted uncertainty maps and true reconstruction error. Using our method, the corresponding Pearson correlation coefficient was higher than 90% at acceleration levels at and above four-fold; whereas it dropped to less than 70% when the uncertainty was computed using a simpler a heuristic notion (magnitude of the residual). Qualitative examples further show the uncertainty maps based on quantile regression capture the magnitude and spatial distribution of reconstruction errors across acceleration factors, with regions of elevated uncertainty aligning with pathologies and artifacts. The proposed framework enables evaluation of reconstruction quality without access to fully-sampled ground-truth reference images. It represents a step toward adaptive MRI acquisition protocols that may be able to dynamically balance scan time and diagnostic reliability.

title: Interpretable and backpropagation-free Green Learning for efficient multi-task echocardiographic segmentation and classification
comments: Accepted for publication in APSIPA Transactions on Signal and Information Processing. Jyun-Ping Kao and Jiaxing Yang contributed equally to this work. C.-C. Jay Kuo and Jonghye Woo are the senior authors
summary: Echocardiography is a cornerstone for managing heart failure (HF), with Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) being a critical metric for guiding therapy. However, manual LVEF assessment suffers from high inter-observer variability, while existing Deep Learning (DL) models are often computationally intensive and data-hungry "black boxes" that impede clinical trust and adoption. Here, we propose a backpropagation-free multi-task Green Learning (MTGL) framework that performs simultaneous Left Ventricle (LV) segmentation and LVEF classification. Our framework integrates an unsupervised VoxelHop encoder for hierarchical spatio-temporal feature extraction with a multi-level regression decoder and an XG-Boost classifier. On the EchoNet-Dynamic dataset, our MTGL model achieves state-of-the-art classification and segmentation performance, attaining a classification accuracy of 94.3% and a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.912, significantly outperforming several advanced 3D DL models. Crucially, our model achieves this with over an order of magnitude fewer parameters, demonstrating exceptional computational efficiency. This work demonstrates that the GL paradigm can deliver highly accurate, efficient, and interpretable solutions for complex medical image analysis, paving the way for more sustainable and trustworthy artificial intelligence in clinical practice.

title: Decoding Speech Envelopes from Electroencephalogram with a Contrastive Pearson Correlation Coefficient Loss
summary: Recent advances in reconstructing speech envelopes from Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals have enabled continuous auditory attention decoding (AAD) in multi-speaker environments. Most Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based envelope reconstruction models are trained to maximize the Pearson correlation coefficients (PCC) between the attended envelope and the reconstructed envelope (attended PCC). While the difference between the attended PCC and the unattended PCC plays an essential role in auditory attention decoding, existing methods often focus on maximizing the attended PCC. We therefore propose a contrastive PCC loss which represents the difference between the attended PCC and the unattended PCC. The proposed approach is evaluated on three public EEG AAD datasets using four DNN architectures. Across many settings, the proposed objective improves envelope separability and AAD accuracy, while also revealing dataset- and architecture-dependent failure cases.

title: Covert Routing with DSSS Signaling Against Cycle Detectors
comments: 2026 IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference (WCNC)
summary: This paper investigates covert multi-hop communication in wireless networks where an adversary employs a cyclostationary (cycle) detector to reveal hidden transmissions. The covert route employs direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) signaling to ensure either maximum end-to-end covertness maximization or minimum latency minimization-under quality-of-service (QoS) and link budget constraints. Optimal bandwidth, transmit power, and spreading gain for each hop jointly satisfy reliability and either rate or covertness requirements. We show the equivalence between the covertness and the detection SNR gain-based widest-path formulations, and, hence, enabling efficient route computation. Numerical simulations in a realistic 3D environment illustrate that (i) end-to-end latency increases exponentially with the covertness requirement, (ii) the end-to-end latency increase is super-linear with the packet size M, and (iii) cycle and energy detectors impose different latency behavior as a function of the message length and the covertness requirement. The proposed framework provides important insights into resource allocation and routing design for covert networks against advanced detection adversaries.
comment: 2026 IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference (WCNC)

title: Index Modulation for Modulation on Conjugate-Reciprocal Zeros (IM-MOCZ)
comments: 5 pages, 8 figures; Revised to address reviewer comments
summary: This paper investigates the application of Index Modulation (IM) to Modulation on Conjugate-Reciprocal Zeros (MOCZ) to enhance spectral efficiency (SE) in short packet communications. The proposed IM-MOCZ scheme splits an $N$-bit message into two streams: $N-K$ bits select one of $2^{N-K}$ uniquely designed codebooks, while the remaining $K$ bits are transmitted with conventional binary-MOCZ (BMOCZ) using the selected codebook. At the receiver, Root Finding Minimum Distance (RFMD) or Direct Zero-Testing (DiZeT) detectors evaluate all candidate codebooks and compute penalty metrics, with a majority vote rule selecting the most confident codebook and recovering the transmitted message. The proposed IM-MOCZ can provide higher SE gains than conventional BMOCZ at the cost of increasing the computational complexity, with simulations demonstrating improved bit error rate (BER) and block error rate (BLER) performance for larger $K$ relative to $N$, when compared to conventional BMOCZ.
comment: 5 pages, 8 figures; Revised to address reviewer comments

title: Subspace Fusion Sensing for Cooperative ISAC
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper proposes a subspace fusion sensing algorithm for cooperative integrated sensing and communication. First, we stack the received signals from access points (APs) into a third-order tensor and construct the equivalent virtual antenna (EVA) array via tensor unfolding. Then, a data association-free subspace-based fusion sensing algorithm is developed utilizing the EVA arrays from distributed APs. A derivation of Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) is also presented. Finally, simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm compared to traditional techniques.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: UAV-Based 3D Spectrum Sensing: Insights on Altitude, Bandwidth, Trajectory, and Effective Antenna Patterns on REM Reconstruction
comments: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: Spectrum sensing and the generation of 3D Radio Environment Maps (REMs) are essential for enabling spectrum sharing within cognitive radio networks. While Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer high-mobility 3D sensing, REM accuracy is challenged by dynamic flight behaviors, where fluctuations in UAV speed and direction introduce measurement inconsistencies. Furthermore, the airframe itself impacts the onboard antenna's radiation characteristics. In this paper, using real-world data, we systematically analyze how REM reconstruction accuracy is shaped by three key pillars: physical sensing parameters like altitude and bandwidth, environmental shadowing, and distortions caused by the UAV airframe. First, we benchmark diverse spatial prediction models, including simple Kriging (SK), ordinary Kriging (OK), trans-Gaussian Kriging, and Gaussian process regression (GPR). We demonstrate that while SK and its trans-Gaussian variant are highly accurate at extreme sample sparsity, OK improves as sample size increases, and GPR serves as the most stable overall baseline. Building on this, we propose a novel matrix completion (MC)-assisted GPR framework that enhances REM reconstruction in the presence of non-uniform spatial smoothness. The method operates by decomposing the REM into two distinct layers: a global smooth component and a highly varying local component. Our analysis based on real-world measurements reveals three key findings: 1) REM accuracy and shadowing variance follow a distinct tri-phasic trend as the UAV altitude increases; 2) REM accuracy significantly improves with increased spectrum bandwidth; and 3) antenna pattern calibration from in-field measurements significantly enhances REM accuracy by accounting for the effect of the UAV airframe.
comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Sensors Journal

title: Algebraic Diversity: Principles of a Group-Theoretic Approach to Signal Processing
comments: v2: updated blind group matching results for the non-Abelian case; v3: corrected $κ$ inconsistency, added 1973 Hill citation v4: updated blind group matching results
summary: We present principles of algebraic diversity (AD), a group-theoretic approach to signal processing exploiting signal symmetry to extract more information per observation, complementing classical methods that use temporal and spatial diversity. The transformations under which a signal's statistics are invariant form a matched group; this group determines the natural transform for analysis, and averaging an estimator over the group action reduces variance without requiring additional snapshots. The viewpoint is broadened in five directions beyond the single-observation measurement of a companion paper. Rank promotion admits AD on scalar data streams and identifies the law of large numbers as the trivial-group case of a $(G, L)$ continuum combining sample-count with group-orbit averaging. An eigentensor hierarchy handles signals with nested symmetry. A blind group-matching methodology identifies the matched group from data via a polynomial-time generalized eigenvalue problem on the unitary Lie algebra, placing the DFT, DCT, and Karhunen--Loève transforms as distinguished points on a transform manifold. A cost-symmetry matching principle then extends AD from measurement to blind and adaptive signal processing generally; blind equalization is given as a detailed example, with the Constant Modulus Algorithm's residual phase ambiguity predicted analytically and matched within two degrees on 3GPP TDL multipath channels, and other blind problems in signal processing are mapped into the framework. Four theorems formalize a structural capacity $κ$, the Rényi-2 analog of Shannon and von Neumann's Rényi-1 entropies, quantifying how a signal's information is organized rather than how much information it contains. AD complements prior algebraic approaches including invariant estimation, minimax robust estimation, algebraic signal processing, and compressed sensing.

title: Non-intrusive Body Composition Assessment from Full-body mmWave Scans
summary: Body composition assessment (BCA) provides detailed information about the distribution of different tissue types in the body, enabling more precise characterization of individuals than BMI or weight alone. Consistent and frequent BCA would be valuable for personalized medicine, but the gold standard methods for BCA, such as CT and MRI, are only practical for opportunistic monitoring of patients with clinical indications for imaging and are not suitable for routine use in the general population. Here, we consider an imaging modality which is not currently used in medical applications: millimeter wave (mmWave) radar. Commonly used in security settings, mmWave scans enable fast, non-intrusive, and privacy-preserving reconstruction of full body shape without the need to remove clothing. To demonstrate the feasibility of fast and convenient BCA from mmWave scans, we present a method for BCA value regression using a multi-task learning strategy that leverages synthetic mmWave-like point clouds derived from clinical imaging and parametric human models. We evaluate the model on a pilot cohort of real mmWave scans with bioimpedance-derived body fat measurements, supporting the feasibility of estimating VAT and body fat percentage (BFP) from mmWave data acquired through clothing in a standing posture. We find that the model can predict VAT and BFP with a mean absolute error of 1.0 L and 3.2%, respectively, demonstrating the potential of mmWave scanning for routine BCA in a wide range of settings.

title: RADAR Challenge 2026: Robust Audio Deepfake Recognition under Media Transformations
summary: RADAR Challenge 2026 is an APSIPA Grand Challenge on Robust Audio Deepfake Recognition under Media Transformations, designed to simulate realistic media conditions in real-world audio distribution pipelines, including compression, resampling, noise, and reverberation. It consists of two phases: an English development phase with labeled data for analysis and paper writing, and a multilingual evaluation phase containing more than 100,000 utterances in English, Singapore English, Mandarin Chinese, Taiwanese Mandarin, Japanese, and Vietnamese. Systems are evaluated using equal error rate (EER) for binary real/fake classification. This paper describes the challenge task, the construction of the data set, the evaluation protocol, and the overall results. During the challenge, 33 teams submitted to the development phase and 22 teams submitted to the final evaluation phase. The reported results highlight the remaining challenges of robust audio deepfake detection under multilingual and media-transformed conditions.

title: PlanRAG-Audio: Planning and Retrieval Augmented Generation for Long-form Audio Understanding
summary: Long-form audio understanding poses significant challenges for large audio language models (LALMs) due to the extreme length of audio sequences and the need to reason over heterogeneous acoustic cues distributed over time, such as speech content, speaker identity, emotion, and sound events. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PlanRAG-Audio}, a planning-based retrieval-augmented generation framework for scalable long-form audio understanding. Rather than having audio LALMs process entire recordings directly, PlanRAG-Audio explicitly plans which modalities and temporal spans are required for a given query, and retrieves only query-relevant information from a structured text and audio database. This retrieval planning enables effective reasoning over complex, cross-domain audio queries while substantially reducing the input length passed to the large language models. Experiments across a wide range of speech/audio retrieval demonstrate that PlanRAG-Audio improves reasoning accuracy and stabilizes performance as audio duration increases by decoupling inference cost from raw audio length.

title: Gray-Box Nonlinear Feedback Optimization
comments: published in IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 2026
summary: Feedback optimization enables autonomous optimality seeking of a dynamical system through its closed-loop interconnection with iterative optimization algorithms. Among various iteration structures, model-based approaches require the input-output sensitivity matrix of the system to construct gradients, whereas model-free approaches eliminate this need by estimating gradients from real-time objective evaluations. These approaches offer complementary benefits in sample efficiency and accuracy against model mismatch, i.e., sensitivity errors. To achieve balanced closed-loop performance, we propose a gray-box feedback optimization controller, featuring systematic incorporation of approximate sensitivities into model-free updates via a tunable convex combination. We provide unified performance characterizations covering different approaches. We elucidate how cumulative sensitivity errors (model-based) and variances due to stochastic exploration (model-free) shape the closed-loop behavior and induce a trade-off between iteration and dimensional dependence. The proposed controller retains sample efficiency and provable (local) optimality for nonconvex problems despite inaccurate sensitivities. We further develop and characterize a running gray-box controller that handles constrained time-varying problems with changing objectives and steady-state input-output maps.
comment: published in IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 2026

title: Globally Stable Attitude Control along Neutrally Stable Trajectories
summary: It is quite often claimed, and correctly so, that linear methods cannot achieve global stability results for attitude control, and conversely that nonlinear control is essential in order to achieve (almost) globally stable tracking of general attitude trajectories. On account of this definitive result, and also because of the existence of powerful nonlinear control techniques, there has been relatively very little work analyzing the limits and performance of linear attitude control. It is the purpose of this paper to provide a characterization of the stability achievable for one class of linear attitude control problems, namely those leading to a constant quaternion difference. In this paper, we analytically derive a critical error angle below which linearized dynamics lead to natural marginal stability for such a system, and above which the system is unstable. The dynamics are then used to derive a locally stable linear attitude controller whose performance is validated using simulations.

title: Stability Analysis of Thermohaline Convection With a Time-Varying Shear Flow Using the Lyapunov Method
summary: This work demonstrates that the Lyapunov method can effectively identify the growth rate of a linear time-periodic system describing cold fresh water on top of hot salty water with a periodically time-varying background shear flow. We employ a time-dependent weighting matrix to construct a Lyapunov function candidate, and the resulting linear matrix inequalities are discretized in time using the forward Euler method. As the number of temporal discretization points increases, the growth rate predicted from the Lyapunov method or the Floquet theory will converge to the same value as that obtained from numerical simulations. Additionally, the Lyapunov method is used to analyze the most dangerous disturbance, and we also compare computational resource usage for the Lyapunov method, numerical simulations, and the Floquet theory.

title: A Spectral Framework for Graph Neural Operators: Convergence Guarantees and Tradeoffs
summary: Graphons, as limits of graph sequences, provide an operator-theoretic framework for analyzing the asymptotic behavior of graph neural operators. Spectral convergence of sampled graphs to graphons induces convergence of the corresponding neural operators, enabling transferability analyses of graph neural networks (GNNs). This paper develops a unified spectral framework that brings together convergence results under different assumptions on the underlying graphon, including no regularity, global Lipschitz continuity, and piecewise-Lipschitz continuity. The framework places these results in a common operator setting, enabling direct comparison of their assumptions, convergence rates, and tradeoffs. We further illustrate the empirical tightness of these rates on synthetic and real-world graphs.

title: Selection-Induced Contraction of Innovation Statistics in Gated Kalman Filters
summary: Validation gating is a fundamental component of classical Kalman-based tracking systems. Only measurements whose normalized innovation squared (NIS) falls below a prescribed threshold are considered for state update. While this procedure is statistically motivated by the chi-square distribution, it implicitly replaces the unconditional innovation process with a conditionally observed one, restricted to the validation event. This paper shows that innovation statistics computed after gating converge to gate-conditioned rather than nominal quantities. Under classical linear--Gaussian assumptions, we derive exact expressions for the first- and second-order moments of the innovation conditioned on ellipsoidal gating, and show that gating induces a deterministic, dimension-dependent contraction of the innovation covariance. The analysis is extended to NN association, which is shown to act as an additional statistical selection operator. We prove that selecting the minimum-norm innovation among multiple in-gate measurements introduces an unavoidable energy contraction, implying that nominal innovation statistics cannot be preserved under nontrivial gating and association. Closed-form results in the two-dimensional case quantify the combined effects and illustrate their practical significance.

title: A Cycle-Based Solvability Condition for Real Power Flow Equations
comments: This work has been revised and resubmitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Certifying power flow solvability is important for reliable power system operations under volatile operating conditions, but solving power flow equations repeatedly can be costly and may encounter convergence issues. In this paper, we develop an explicit cycle-based solvability condition for the lossless real power flow equations on meshed networks. We decompose every feasible nodal balance solution into a particular flow plus a cycle flow correction vector. The power flow problem is then reduced to enforcing edge-wise feasibility and cycle consistency. We show that the cycle consistency function is strongly monotone, and is the gradient of a strongly convex energy function. By exploiting these properties, we derive an explicit condition on the existence and uniqueness of power flow solution with bounded angle difference. The resulting condition is invariant under the choice of cycle basis and can be verified through simple algebraic computations. Numerical results on standard test systems show that the proposed condition is significantly less conservative than existing sufficient conditions and closely approximates true loading limits.

AI.title_translation: 实数潮流方程基于环路的可解性条件
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于环路分解的显式代数条件，用于快速、低保守性地判定网状电力网络中无损实潮流方程的解的存在性与唯一性。
AI.motivation: 在波动的运行工况下，认证潮流可解性对于电力系统的可靠运行至关重要，但重复求解潮流方程计算成本高昂，且容易遇到收敛问题。因此需要一种显式、高效且保守性低的潮流可解性判定方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于环路的可解性条件。将每个可行的节点平衡解分解为一个特定流加上一个环路流修正向量，从而将潮流问题简化为强制执行边可行性和环路一致性。利用环路一致性函数是强单调的（且是强凸能量函数的梯度）这一性质，推导出具有有界角差的潮流解存在性和唯一性的显式代数条件。
AI.result: 推导出的显式条件在环路基的选择下保持不变，且只需通过简单的代数计算即可验证。在标准测试系统上的数值结果表明，该条件比现有的充分条件保守性显著降低，且能紧密逼近真实的负荷极限。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功推导出一种高效、显式且低保守性的潮流方程可解性判定条件，为网状网络中潮流的快速安全评估提供了实用的理论工具。
AI.translation: 在波动的运行工况下，认证潮流可解性对于可靠的电力系统运行至关重要，但重复求解潮流方程可能成本高昂，并可能遇到收敛问题。在本文中，我们针对网状网络上的无损实潮流方程开发了一种显式的基于环路的可解性条件。我们将每个可行的节点平衡解分解为一个特定流加上一个环路流修正向量。潮流问题随后被简化为强制执行边可行性和环路一致性。我们证明了环路一致性函数是强单调的，并且是一个强凸能量函数的梯度。通过利用这些性质，我们推导出了关于具有有界角差的潮流解存在性和唯一性的显式条件。所得条件在环路基的选择下保持不变，并且可以通过简单的代数计算进行验证。标准测试系统上的数值结果表明，所提出的条件明显比现有的充分条件更少保守性，并能紧密逼近真实的负荷极限。
AI.summary: 本文针对网状网络中的无损有功（实）潮流方程，提出了一种基于环路的可解性判定条件。通过将节点平衡解分解为特定流与环路流修正向量，潮流问题被转化为边可行性与环路一致性问题。利用环路一致性函数的强单调性和强凸性，推导出了保证潮流解存在且唯一的显式代数条件。该方法不依赖于环路基的选择，计算简便，实验表明其保守性远低于现有方法，能紧密逼近实际负荷极限。
AI.keywords: 潮流方程, 可解性条件, 环路一致性, 网状网络, 强凸性
AI.comments: 该方法巧妙地利用了图论中的环路分解以及凸优化中的强单调性与强凸性，将复杂的潮流可解性问题转化为简单的代数可验证条件。其最大的创新点在于消除了对环路基选择的依赖，并且在实际测试中展现出极低的保守性，对电力系统的在线安全评估和稳定分析具有重要的理论和实用价值。

title: Fundamental Limits for Sensor-Based Control via the Gibbs Variational Principle
comments: First revision. Added LQG numerical example. Improved exposition throughout. 6 pages, 1 figure
summary: Fundamental limits on the performance of feedback controllers are essential for benchmarking algorithms, guiding sensor selection, and certifying task feasibility -- yet few general-purpose tools exist for computing them. Existing information-theoretic approaches overestimate the information a sensor must provide by evaluating it against the uncontrolled system, producing bounds that degrade precisely when feedback is most valuable. We derive a lower bound on the minimum expected cost of any causal feedback controller under partial observations by applying the Gibbs variational principle to the joint path measure over states and observations. The bound applies to nonlinear, nonholonomic, and hybrid dynamics with unbounded costs and admits a self-consistent refinement: any good controller concentrates the state, which limits the information the sensor can extract, which tightens the bound. The resulting fixed-point equation has a unique solution computable by bisection, and we provide conditions under which the free energy minimization is provably convex, yielding a certifiably correct numerical bound. On a scalar LQG problem the self-consistent bound captures over 80% of the known optimal cost at moderate sensor noise, and on a nonlinear Dubins car tracking problem it remains informative across all noise levels where a bound using the uncontrolled state distribution is vacuous.

AI.title_translation: 基于吉布斯变分原理的传感器控制基本极限
AI.tldr: 本文利用吉布斯变分原理推导了部分观测下反馈控制器的性能下界，通过自洽细化机制解决了传统方法高估传感器信息需求的问题，为非线性及混合系统提供了紧凑且可证正确的数值界限。
AI.motivation: 反馈控制器性能的基本极限对于算法基准测试、传感器选择和任务可行性验证至关重要，但目前缺乏通用的计算工具。现有信息论方法通过针对“无控制系统”评估传感器，高估了传感器必须提供的信息，导致在反馈最重要时，计算出的界限反而会发生退化。
AI.method: 通过将吉布斯变分原理应用于状态和观测的联合路径测度，推导出了部分观测下因果反馈控制器最小期望成本的下界。该方法引入了“自洽细化”机制：优秀的控制器会使状态集中，从而限制传感器可提取的信息，进而收紧界限。这产生了一个具有唯一解、可通过二分法计算的不动点方程，并给出了自由能最小化为凸的条件以确保数值界限的正确性。
AI.result: 在标量LQG（线性二次高斯）问题上，该自洽界限在适度传感器噪声下捕获了超过80%的已知最优成本；在非线性Dubins汽车跟踪问题上，在基于无控制状态分布的界限完全失效的所有噪声水平下，该方法依然能够提供有效的、具有信息量的界限。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于吉布斯变分原理的下界不仅适用于复杂的动力学系统（非线性、非完整、混合系统等），而且克服了传统信息论方法的退化问题，为传感器控制系统的性能基准测试和可行性验证提供了一个强有力且可证正确的数值计算工具。
AI.translation: 反馈控制器性能的基本极限对于基准测试算法、指导传感器选择以及证明任务可行性至关重要，然而目前用于计算这些极限的通用工具却很少。现有的信息论方法通过针对无控制系统评估传感器，从而高估了传感器必须提供的信息，导致在反馈最有价值时，得出的界限反而会退化。我们通过将吉布斯变分原理应用于状态和观测的联合路径测度，推导出了在部分观测下任何因果反馈控制器最小期望成本的下界。该界限适用于具有无界成本的非线性、非完整和混合动力学，并允许进行自洽细化：任何优秀的控制器都会使状态集中，这限制了传感器可以提取的信息，从而使界限更加紧凑。由此产生的不动点方程具有可通过二分法计算的唯一解，并且我们提供了自由能最小化可证明为凸的条件，从而产生了一个可证明正确的数值界限。在标量LQG问题上，该自洽界限在适度传感器噪声下捕获了超过80%的已知最优成本；在非线性Dubins汽车跟踪问题上，在利用无控制状态分布的界限失效的所有噪声水平下，它依然能够提供有效信息。
AI.summary: 本文针对部分观测下的反馈控制系统，提出了一种基于吉布斯变分原理计算其性能基本极限（最小期望成本下界）的新方法。该方法适用于非线性、非完整和混合系统，并通过“自洽细化”机制（控制器集中状态进而限制传感器信息提取，从而收紧界限）克服了传统信息论方法高估传感器需求并退化的缺陷，提供了一种可证正确的数值下界计算方案。
AI.keywords: 吉布斯变分原理,反馈控制,基本极限,部分观测,自洽细化
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将统计力学中的吉布斯变分原理引入到控制系统基本极限的推导中，巧妙地解决了传统信息论方法因基于无控制系统评估而高估传感器信息需求、导致下界退化的痛点。其提出的“自洽细化”机制（控制器的状态集中效应会限制传感器提取的信息，从而反过来收紧界限）非常具有启发性。局限性在于，虽然在特定条件下证明了自由能最小化的凸性，但对于极其复杂的混合动力学系统，其实际数值求解的计算复杂度和收敛性可能仍需进一步验证。

title: Sterile mosquito release via intelligent proportional controllers
comments: The 6th International Symposium on Complex Systems -- June 03-05, 2026 -- La Rochelle, France
summary: The Sterile Insect Technique (SIT) against insect pests and insect vectors consists of releasing males that have been previously sterilized in order to reduce or eliminate a specific wild population. We study this complex control question via model-free control, ultra-local models, and intelligent proportional controllers that have already proven their effectiveness in various fields. They permit addressing, perhaps for the first time, the essential sampling question. Computer simulations are displayed and discussed.
comment: The 6th International Symposium on Complex Systems -- June 03-05, 2026 -- La Rochelle, France

AI.title_translation: 基于智能比例控制器的不育蚊子释放研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用无模型控制和智能比例控制器来优化不育蚊子的释放策略，并通过模拟验证了其在解决控制和采样问题上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 不育昆虫技术（SIT）通过释放不育雄性来控制野生昆虫种群，这是一个复杂的控制问题，且需要解决至关重要的采样问题。
AI.method: 采用无模型控制（model-free control）、超局部模型（ultra-local models）以及智能比例控制器（intelligent proportional controllers）。
AI.result: 通过计算机模拟展示并讨论了该控制方法的有效性，成功应对了复杂的控制需求和采样问题。
AI.conclusion: 智能比例控制器和无模型控制方法能够有效解决不育蚊子释放这一复杂的控制问题，并为解决关键的采样问题提供了可行途径。
AI.translation: 针对害虫和昆虫媒介的不育昆虫技术（SIT）包括释放先前已进行绝育处理的雄性昆虫，以减少或消除特定的野生种群。我们通过无模型控制、超局部模型和智能比例控制器来研究这一复杂的控制问题，这些方法此前已在多个领域证明了其有效性。它们使得解决——或许是首次解决——关键的采样问题成为可能。文中展示并讨论了计算机模拟结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了如何利用无模型控制、超局部模型和智能比例控制器来解决不育昆虫技术（SIT）中不育蚊子释放的复杂控制问题。该方法首次应对了关键的采样问题，并通过计算机模拟验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 不育昆虫技术 (SIT), 无模型控制, 智能比例控制器, 蚊虫控制
AI.comments: 该研究将无模型控制和智能比例控制器应用于生物种群控制（不育昆虫技术），具有较强的跨学科创新性，特别是首次尝试解决控制过程中的关键采样问题。然而，目前的研究成果仅基于计算机模拟，在实际复杂多变的野外生态环境中，该控制器的鲁棒性和有效性仍需进一步验证。

title: Network Epidemic Control via Model Predictive Control: Extended Version
summary: Balancing the societal costs of non-pharmaceutical interventions with epidemic suppression requires adaptive feedback control. Rather than relying on state-dependent operational caps, we formulate an infinite-horizon optimal control problem for a networked SIQR model that strictly enforces suppression via a hard spectral constraint on the transmission dynamics. We derive a safety-critical Model Predictive Control (MPC) approximation that embeds this spectral certificate stage-wise, yielding a tunable exponential decay rate. Furthermore, we construct a terminal set ensuring recursive feasibility and a feasible continuation that decays globally, proving positive invariance directly via the physical depletion of susceptibles rather than standard quadratic Lyapunov functions. To handle prediction uncertainty, we develop a robust counterpart that replaces nominal constraints by upper-envelope versions, recovering recursive feasibility and finite-horizon realized decay. We conclude by validating our approaches using simulation studies that leverage public data from counties in the state of Massachusetts.

AI.title_translation: 基于模型预测控制的网络流行病控制：扩展版本
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的新型网络流行病控制方法，通过在网络SIQR模型中引入硬谱约束实现严格的疫情抑制，并设计了鲁棒MPC以应对预测不确定性。
AI.motivation: 在流行病控制中，平衡非药物干预的社会成本与疫情抑制效果需要自适应反馈控制。现有的方法通常依赖于状态相关的操作上限，缺乏对传播动力学严格、系统性抑制的硬性安全保证。
AI.method:
1. 针对网络化SIQR模型构建无限时区最优控制问题，通过对传播动力学施加硬谱约束来严格执行抑制。
2. 推导了一种安全关键的模型预测控制（MPC）近似，将谱证书分阶段嵌入，以获得可调的指数衰减率。
3. 构建了终端集以确保递归可行性，并通过易感人群的物理消耗直接证明正不变性。
4. 针对预测不确定性，开发了鲁棒MPC方法，用上包络版本代替名义约束，以恢复递归可行性和有限时区衰减。
5. 使用美国马萨诸塞州各县的公开数据进行仿真验证。
AI.result: 成功推导出了具有可调指数衰减率的安全关键型MPC近似算法，在理论上证明了其递归可行性和基于物理消耗的正不变性。同时，所提出的鲁棒MPC能够有效应对预测不确定性。仿真结果表明，该方法在利用马萨诸塞州真实数据时表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于硬谱约束的MPC方法及其鲁棒扩展方案，能够有效平衡流行病抑制与社会成本，在理论上保证了递归可行性和正不变性，并通过实际数据仿真验证了其可行性与有效性。
AI.translation: 平衡非药物干预的社会成本与流行病抑制需要自适应反馈控制。我们没有依赖于状态相关的操作上限，而是针对网络化SIQR模型构建了一个无限时区最优控制问题，该问题通过对传播动力学施加硬谱约束来严格执行抑制。我们推导了一种安全关键的模型预测控制（MPC）近似方法，该方法逐步嵌入了这种谱证书，从而产生了可调的指数衰减率。此外，我们构建了一个确保递归可行性的终端集和全局衰减的可行延续，直接通过易感人群的物理消耗（而非标准的二次李雅普诺夫函数）证明了正不变性。为了处理预测不确定性，我们开发了一种鲁棒的对应方法，用上包络版本代替名义约束，恢复了递归可行性和有限时区实现的衰减。最后，我们利用马萨诸塞州各县的公共数据进行模拟研究，验证了我们的方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对网络化SIQR流行病模型，提出了一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的自适应反馈控制方案。该方法通过引入硬谱约束来严格抑制疫情传播，并推导了具有可调衰减率的安全关键MPC近似。研究构建了保证递归可行性的终端集，并利用易感人群的物理消耗证明了正不变性。为应对不确定性，还开发了鲁棒MPC版本。最后，利用马萨诸塞州县级公开数据仿真验证了该控制策略的有效性。
AI.keywords: 模型预测控制 (Model Predictive Control), 网络化流行病控制 (Network Epidemic Control), SIQR模型 (SIQR Model), 谱约束 (Spectral Constraint), 鲁棒控制 (Robust Control)
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：该研究将硬谱约束引入网络化SIQR模型的无限时区最优控制中，并创造性地利用易感人群的物理消耗（而非传统的二次Lyapunov函数）来证明正不变性，为流行病动力学控制提供了新的理论视角。
2. 重要性：在流行病大流行期间，如何在抑制疫情的同时最小化非药物干预的社会经济成本是一个亟待解决的现实问题，该研究为此提供了系统性的控制理论框架。
3. 局限性：尽管提出了鲁棒版本来应对预测不确定性，但在面对极其复杂的现实社会网络时，高维非线性MPC的在线计算开销和参数辨识的准确性仍可能面临挑战。

title: CounterFlow: A Two-Phase Inference-Time Sampling for Counterfactual Video Foley Generation
comments: accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshop on Sight and Sound
summary: We investigate Counterfactual Video Foley Generation, which aims to adopt a sound-source identity that contradicts the visual evidence while remaining temporally synchronized to a silent video. Existing Video&Text-to-Audio (VT2A) models struggle with this, often remaining anchored to the visually implied sound source when video and text contents disagree. We present ConterFlow, an inference-time dual-phase sampling scheme for pretrained flow-matching VT2A models. Phase 1 builds a video-derived temporal structure while suppressing the visually implied source; Phase 2 drops video conditioning to focus entirely on shaping audio timbre toward the target prompt. ConterFlow substantially improves counterfactual Video Foley generation compared to naive negative prompting and state-of-the-art baselines. To evaluate replacement quality, we propose a metric leveraging a text-audio co-embedding space to measure both target-prompt evidence and residual visually implied source leakage. Video demonstrations and code are available at https://gyubin-lee.github.io/counterflow-demo/
comment: accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshop on Sight and Sound

AI.title_translation: CounterFlow：用于反事实视频拟音生成的两阶段推理期采样
AI.tldr: 本文提出CounterFlow，一种无须重训的两阶段推理采样方案，通过解耦时间结构保持与音色生成，解决了视频和文本冲突时反事实视频拟音生成的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频和文本转音频（VT2A）模型在处理视频和文本内容不一致时，往往会受限于视频中隐含的声源，难以生成与视觉画面相矛盾但时间同步的反事实视频拟音。
AI.method: 提出CounterFlow，一种针对预训练流匹配VT2A模型的双阶段推理采样方案。第一阶段构建源自视频的时间结构，同时抑制视觉隐含的声源；第二阶段去除视频条件，完全专注于根据目标文本提示塑造音频音色。此外，还提出了一种利用文本-音频共嵌入空间来评估替换质量的新指标。
AI.result: 与朴素的负向提示（negative prompting）和现有的前沿基线方法相比，CounterFlow显著提升了反事实视频拟音的生成质量，有效减少了视觉隐含声源的残留泄露，并更好地契合了目标文本提示。
AI.conclusion: CounterFlow成功解决了反事实视频拟音生成中由于音画不一致导致的声源泄露问题，在保持与视频时间同步的同时，实现了高质量的异质声源替换，并通过新提出的文本-音频共嵌入指标验证了其优越性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了反事实视频拟音生成（Counterfactual Video Foley Generation），其旨在采用与视觉证据相矛盾的声源身份，同时与无声视频保持时间上的同步。现有的视频和文本转音频（VT2A）模型在视频和文本内容不一致时往往难以应对，通常仍锚定在视觉暗示的声源上。我们提出了CounterFlow，这是一种用于预训练流匹配VT2A模型的推理期双阶段采样方案。第一阶段构建源自视频的时间结构，同时抑制视觉暗示的声源；第二阶段放弃视频条件，完全专注于根据目标提示词塑造音频音色。与朴素的负向提示和最先进的基线方法相比，CounterFlow显著改善了反事实视频拟音的生成。为了评估替换质量，我们提出了一种利用文本-音频共嵌入空间的指标，以衡量目标提示词证据和残留的视觉暗示声源泄露。视频演示和代码可在以下网址获取：https://gyubin-lee.github.io/counterflow-demo/
AI.summary: 本文针对反事实视频拟音生成任务（即生成与视频画面冲突但时间同步的音频），指出传统VT2A模型容易被视频画面隐含声源误导的局限。为此，提出了一种无需重新训练的推理期双阶段采样方法CounterFlow。该方法通过在第一阶段保留视频时间结构并抑制原声源，在第二阶段去除视频条件以专注生成目标音色，实现了优异的反事实拟音效果，并引入了新型评估指标。
AI.keywords: 反事实视频拟音, 推理期采样, 流匹配, 视频转音频
AI.comments: 该论文针对视频拟音中一个非常实用且有趣的挑战——反事实生成（即音画不一致但时间同步）进行了探索。其核心创新在于提出了一种无需微调的推理期双阶段采样策略（CounterFlow），巧妙地解耦了“时间结构保持”与“原声源抑制/目标音色控制”两个过程，对多模态音频生成领域具有较好的启发意义和实用价值。

title: Near-Field User Location Inference From Far-Field Power Measurements
comments: To appear in IEEE Vehicular Technology Conference: VTC2026-Fall
summary: Near-field beamfocusing enabled by extremely large-aperture arrays (ELAA) is a promising 6G technique for massive connectivity and high spectrum efficiency. While beamfocusing concentrates energy at an intended user, the radiated field outside the focal point exhibits a structured leakage that varies with the focal-point coordinates. This paper shows that this leakage enables a new form of passive user localization in which distributed far-field sensors measuring only received power can infer the user's location by exploiting this location-dependent power signature. Using the induced noncentral chi-square statistics, we derive a Bayesian Cramér-Rao lower bound (BCRLB) that establishes the fundamental limits of this inference problem. We then evaluate a model-based grid-search estimator and an attention-based permutation-invariant deep learning regressor (DeepSet). Results under both line-of-sight (LoS) and multipath propagation confirm that reliable location inference is feasible, with accuracy improving as more sensors and snapshots are used.
comment: To appear in IEEE Vehicular Technology Conference: VTC2026-Fall

AI.title_translation: 基于远场功率测量的近场用户位置推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用分布式远场传感器接收到的近场波束聚焦功率泄漏信号，来推断近场用户位置的被动定位方法。
AI.motivation: 极大型孔径阵列（ELAA）的近场波束聚焦在焦点之外会产生随焦点坐标变化的结构化功率泄漏。本文旨在利用这种与位置相关的功率特征，通过仅测量接收功率的分布式远场传感器来实现一种新型的被动用户定位。
AI.method: 1. 利用感应非中心卡方统计量推导了贝叶斯克拉美-罗下界（BCRLB），以确立该推断问题的基本物理极限；2. 评估了一种基于模型的网格搜索估计器；3. 评估了一种基于注意力机制且排列不变的深度学习回归器（DeepSet）。
AI.result: 在视距（LoS）和多径传播环境下，所提方案均能实现可靠的位置推断。此外，随着使用的传感器数量和快照数量的增加，定位精度会进一步提高。
AI.conclusion: 利用远场传感器测量近场波束聚焦的功率泄漏，可以有效且可靠地推断用户位置，这为6G网络中的近场无源定位提供了一种可行且高效的新途径。
AI.translation: 由极大型孔径阵列（ELAA）赋能的近场波束聚焦是一项极具前景的6G技术，可用于实现海量连接和高频谱效率。虽然波束聚焦将能量集中在目标用户处，但焦点之外的辐射场表现出一种随焦点坐标变化的结构化泄漏。本文表明，这种泄漏使一种新型的被动用户定位成为可能，其中仅测量接收功率的分布式远场传感器可以通过利用这种与位置相关的功率特征来推断用户的位置。利用感应非中心卡方统计量，我们推导了贝叶斯克拉美-罗下界（BCRLB），确立了该推断问题的基本极限。随后，我们评估了一个基于模型的网格搜索估计器和一个基于注意力机制且排列不变的深度学习回归器（DeepSet）。在视距（LoS）和多径传播条件下的结果均证实，可靠的位置推断是可行的，且精度随着更多传感器和快照的使用而提高。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了如何利用极大型孔径阵列（ELAA）近场波束聚焦产生的空间功率泄漏来实现被动用户定位。通过分布式远场传感器测量接收功率，利用这种与位置相关的功率特征来推断用户位置。研究推导了推断误差的理论下界（BCRLB），并评估了基于模型的网格搜索和基于深度学习（DeepSet）的两种定位方法，证实了该方案在LoS和多径环境下的可行性与高精度。
AI.keywords: 近场波束聚焦, 被动定位, 功率泄漏, 贝叶斯克拉美-罗下界, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将近场波束聚焦的“副作用”（能量泄漏）转化为定位的“信号源”，提出了一种新颖的无源定位机制。将远场功率测量与近场定位相结合，具有很强的创新性。其局限性可能在于对复杂多径环境的敏感性，以及深度学习模型在实际多变场景中的泛化能力仍有待进一步检验。

title: Global Convergence of Control-Based Lagrangian Flows for Non-Convex Optimization
summary: This paper studies the continuous-time dynamics generated by control-theoretic Lagrangian methods for equality-constrained optimization. In particular, we consider dynamics induced by proportional-integral and feedback linearization controllers, which have recently been proposed as alternatives to primal-dual gradient methods. Unlike global convergence results for these dynamics, which rely on strong convexity of the objective function or boundedness assumptions, we exploit the geometric structure induced by the constraints. Specifically, we show global exponential convergence for non-convex problems that satisfy a suitable convexity property when restricted to the constraint manifold.

AI.title_translation: 基于控制的拉格朗日流在非凸优化中的全局收敛性
AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于在约束流形上具有适当凸性的非凸等式约束优化问题，基于控制（PI和反馈线性化）的拉格朗日动力学具有全局指数收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于控制理论的拉格朗日动力学的全局收敛性结果通常高度依赖于目标函数的强凸性或变量的有界性假设。为了克服这些局限性，本文旨在探索如何利用约束本身的几何结构来保证非凸优化问题的全局收敛。
AI.method: 研究了由比例积分（PI）和反馈线性化控制器引导的连续时间拉格朗日动力学。方法的核心在于不依赖全局强凸性，而是利用约束条件在流形上诱导的几何结构，并在限制于约束流形时利用其凸性性质进行分析。
AI.result: 证明了对于在限制于约束流形上时满足适当凸性性质的非凸优化问题，基于控制的拉格朗日流具有全局指数收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用约束诱导的几何结构，基于控制的拉格朗日流（如PI和反馈线性化控制器）可以在无需全局强凸性或有界性假设的情况下，实现非凸等式约束优化问题的全局指数收敛。
AI.translation: 本文研究了由用于等式约束优化的控制论拉格朗日方法生成的连续时间动力学。特别是，我们考虑了由比例积分和反馈线性化控制器引导的动力学，这些控制器最近被提出作为原始-对偶梯度方法的替代方案。与以往依赖于目标函数强凸性或有界性假设的这些动力学的全局收敛性结果不同，我们利用了由约束诱导的几何结构。具体而言，我们证明了对于在限制于约束流形上时满足适当凸性性质的非凸问题，该动力学具有全局指数收敛性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了等式约束优化中由比例积分和反馈线性化控制器生成的连续时间拉格朗日动力学。通过利用约束流形诱导的几何结构，作者证明了当非凸问题在限制于约束流形上满足适当的凸性时，该动力学具有全局指数收敛性，从而摆脱了对强凸性或有界性的传统依赖。
AI.keywords: 等式约束优化, 控制拉格朗日动力学, 非凸优化, 全局指数收敛, 约束流形

title: Multilevel Isogeometric Projection Stabilization via Quasi-Interpolation for Advection-Dominated Problems
summary: This paper presents a novel multilevel projection-based stabilization method for advection-dominated convection--diffusion problems within the framework of Isogeometric Analysis. The proposed approach extracts and penalizes fine-scale fluctuations using continuous B-spline quasi-interpolants, avoiding both the highly sensitive parameters used in residual-based stabilization methods and the discontinuous auxiliary spaces required by classical Local Projection Stabilization. Stabilization is applied hierarchically across nested levels of the discrete space via explicit mesh-dependent weights. We establish the theoretical foundation of the method by deriving a priori error estimates, supplemented by a discrete inf-sup condition established for the one-dimensional setting with constant advection under a numerically validated stability hypothesis that ensures robust streamline derivative control. Numerical experiments on stringent benchmarks demonstrate the method's ability to significantly reduce spurious oscillations across a variety of regimes, including the limiting cases of pure advection and advection--reaction. Notably, despite being a fully linear formulation, the method achieves significant reduction of undershoots near sharp layers, providing an effective stabilization mechanism without requiring complex nonlinear terms. Furthermore, by utilizing a robust global parameter scaling, the proposed approach significantly alleviates the parameter sensitivity that typically affects residual-based alternatives, reducing the strong dependence on problem-dependent tuning.

AI.title_translation: 基于拟插值的多级等几何投影稳定化方法用于平流占优问题
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于连续B样条拟插值的多级等几何投影稳定化方法，在无需复杂非线性项和高敏感参数的情况下，显著减少了平流占优问题中的数值振荡和过渡层下冲。
AI.motivation: 在等几何分析框架下解决平流占优的对流-扩散问题时，传统的残差稳定化方法对参数高度敏感，而经典的局部投影稳定化（LPS）方法需要使用不连续的辅助空间。为了克服这些局限性，需要一种更鲁棒且参数敏感性较低的稳定化方法。
AI.method: 提出一种多级投影稳定化方法。该方法在等几何分析（IGA）框架下，利用连续B样条拟插值器来提取并惩罚细尺度波动。通过显式的网格相关权重，在嵌套的离散空间层级上分层应用稳定化。理论上，推导了先验误差估计，并在恒定平流的一维设置下建立了离散inf-sup条件。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法在纯平流和平流-反应等各种极端工况下均能显著减少伪振荡。尽管采用了完全线性的公式，该方法仍能显著减少急剧过渡层附近的下冲现象。此外，通过采用稳健的全局参数缩放，该方法显著降低了对特定问题进行参数微调的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种高效且鲁棒的稳定化机制，不仅在保持全线性公式的前提下显著抑制了伪振荡，还通过全局参数缩放极大地缓解了对特定问题调参的依赖，为等几何分析中平流占优问题的求解奠定了理论与数值基础。
AI.translation: 本文针对等几何分析（IGA）框架下的平流占优对流-扩散问题，提出了一种新型的多级投影稳定化方法。该方法利用连续B样条拟插值提取并惩罚细尺度波动，从而避免了残差稳定化方法中高度敏感的参数，以及经典局部投影稳定化（LPS）所需的不连续辅助空间。稳定化通过显式的网格相关权重，在离散空间的嵌套层级上分层实施。我们通过推导先验误差估计奠定了该方法的理论基础，并结合数值验证的稳定性假设（确保稳健的流线导数控制），在恒定平流的一维设置下建立了离散inf-sup条件。在严苛基准测试上的数值实验表明，该方法在包括纯平流和平流-反应极端情况在内的各种机制下，均能显著减少伪振荡。值得注意的是，尽管该方法采用完全线性的公式，但它在急剧过渡层附近实现了下冲的显著减少，从而在不需要复杂非线性项的情况下提供了有效的稳定化机制。此外，通过利用稳健的全局参数缩放，该方法显著缓解了通常影响残差稳定化方法的参数敏感性，减少了对问题相关调参的强烈依赖。
AI.summary: 本文针对等几何分析中的平流占优对流-扩散问题，提出了一种基于连续B样条拟插值的多级投影稳定化方法。该方法通过在嵌套的离散空间层级上分层施加稳定化，避免了复杂的非线性项和高度敏感的参数。理论分析推导了先验误差估计和一维inf-sup条件，数值实验证实了该方法在消除数值振荡、减少过渡层下冲以及降低参数敏感性方面的优异性能。
AI.keywords: 等几何分析, 多级投影稳定化, 拟插值, 平流占优问题, 误差估计
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将连续B样条拟插值与多级投影稳定化相结合，成功避开了传统残差稳定化方法对参数的高度敏感性，以及经典局部投影稳定化（LPS）对不连续辅助空间的依赖。其重要价值在于，即使在完全线性的框架下，也能在不引入复杂非线性项的前提下，有效抑制急剧过渡层附近的数值振荡。局限性在于，其离散inf-sup条件的理论证明目前仅限于一维恒定平流情形，高维或更复杂流场下的理论分析仍有待进一步完善。

title: Composite B-Spline Current Deposition and Interpolation Operators for Thin-Wire Finite-Difference Time-Domain Simulations
summary: Holland-Simpson thin-wire finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations of obliquely oriented closed-loop antennas exhibit persistent low-frequency parasitic currents because the current-deposition operator fails to conserve charge. This deposition operator, together with an interpolation operator that samples the tangential electric field along the wire, can be realized as regularizations of distributions: the wire current is deposited as a source term by integrating it against a regularized delta function along the wire, and the electric field is sampled back to the wire by integrating it against the same regularized delta function. We show that charge conservation requires the deposited current to be discretely divergence-free when the wire carries a constant current, and we introduce a family of composite B-spline regularizations that satisfy this condition to machine precision. Exact evaluation of the coupling line integrals is possible because the B-spline kernels are piecewise polynomial with a priori-known breakpoints, allowing composite Gauss-Legendre quadrature with subinterval breakpoints at every grid-plane crossing. Taking the interpolation operator as the discrete adjoint of the deposition operator preserves skew-symmetry and ensures that a discretely irrotational electric field drives no net electromotive force around a closed loop. Numerical experiments on a center-fed dipole and on circular and square loop antennas show that the proposed regularizations yield orientation-independent impedance values consistent with known characteristics, whereas a simple trilinear regularization produces unphysical parasitic low-frequency currents in closed loops.

AI.title_translation: 用于细导线时域有限差分模拟的复合B样条电流沉积和插值算子
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于复合B样条的电流沉积和插值算子，解决了细导线FDTD模拟中因电荷不守恒导致的低频寄生电流问题。
AI.motivation: 在斜向闭环天线的Holland-Simpson细导线时域有限差分（FDTD）模拟中，由于电流沉积算子无法保证电荷守恒，会导致持续存在的低频非物理寄生电流，从而影响模拟的准确性。
AI.method: 提出了一族满足离散无散条件的复合B样条正则化方法。利用B样条核函数作为分段多项式且断点先验已知的特性，采用在网格交叉处设置子区间的复合Gauss-Legendre求积方法来精确计算耦合线积分。同时，将插值算子设计为沉积算子的离散伴随算子，以保持系统的斜对称性。
AI.result: 在中心馈电偶极子、圆形和方形环形天线上的数值实验表明，该方法能够产生与天线方向无关的阻抗值，且与理论特性高度一致；相比之下，传统的三线性正则化方法则会在闭合回路中产生明显的低频寄生电流。
AI.conclusion: 通过采用复合B样条正则化并保持插值与沉积算子的共轭关系，可以有效消除细导线FDTD模拟中的非物理低频寄生电流，显著提高倾斜闭环天线电磁模拟的准确性和物理一致性。
AI.translation: 斜向放置的闭合回路天线的Holland-Simpson细导线时域有限差分（FDTD）模拟会表现出持续的低频寄生电流，这是因为电流沉积算子未能遵守电荷守恒。该沉积算子与沿着导线对切向电场进行采样的插值算子一起，可以实现为分布的正则化：通过将导线电流与沿着导线的正则化δ函数进行积分，将其作为源项沉积；并通过将电场与相同的正则化δ函数进行积分，将其采样回导线。我们表明，当导线承载恒定电流时，电荷守恒要求沉积的电流在离散意义上是无散的，并且我们引入了一族满足该条件至机器精度的复合B样条正则化。精确评估耦合线积分是可能的，因为B样条核函数是具有先验已知断点的分段多项式，从而允许在每个网格面交叉处进行带有子区间断点的复合Gauss-Legendre求积。将插值算子作为沉积算子的离散伴随可以保持斜对称性，并确保离散无旋电场在闭合回路中不会驱动净电动势。在中心馈电偶极子以及圆形和方形环形天线上的数值实验表明，所提出的正则化方法能够产生与方向无关的阻抗值，且与已知特性一致，而简单的三线性正则化则会在闭合回路中产生非物理的低频寄生电流。
AI.summary: 本文针对细导线FDTD模拟中由于电荷不守恒导致的低频寄生电流问题，提出了一种新型的复合B样条电流沉积和插值算子。通过确保电流在离散意义上无散以及插值与沉积算子的伴随关系，该方法在机器精度上实现了电荷守恒并保持了系统的斜对称性。数值实验证明，该方法能有效消除闭环天线模拟中的非物理寄生电流，并获得方向无关的准确阻抗结果。
AI.keywords: 时域有限差分 (FDTD), 细导线模拟, 复合B样条, 电荷守恒, 寄生电流
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于通过数学上严格的复合B样条正则化和伴随算子设计，从根本上解决了电磁计算中由于数值离散导致的电荷不守恒问题。该方法不仅消除了非物理的寄生电流，还保证了斜对称性。其局限性可能在于，由于需要进行复杂的线积分和高阶B样条计算，其计算复杂度相比传统的简单三线性插值会有所上升。

title: Runge--Kutta numerical methods for ruin probabilities in classical risk model
summary: In this paper, we study Runge--Kutta methods for the computation of ruin probabilities in the classical risk model through the associated Volterra integro-differential equation. The proposed framework combines fourth-order one-step and two-step Runge--Kutta schemes with numerical quadrature formulas to approximate the convolution term. In particular, the convolution term is approximated using Newton--Cotes and Gaussian quadrature formulas, including Simpson's 1/3 rule and Pareto-adapted Gauss--Jacobi quadrature. An equivalent reformulation of the Volterra equation as a system of ordinary differential equations is also considered. Implementations for Gamma and Pareto claim-size distributions are developed. Numerical results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

AI.title_translation: 经典风险模型中破产概率的龙格-库塔数值方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合四阶龙格-库塔格式与数值求积公式的算法，用于高效计算经典风险模型中的破产概率。
AI.motivation: 旨在通过求解相关的Volterra积分微分方程，为经典风险模型中的破产概率计算提供一种高效且精确的龙格-库塔数值求解方法。
AI.method: 将四阶单步和两步龙格-库塔格式与数值求积公式（如Newton-Cotes、Simpson 1/3法则和针对Pareto调整的高斯-雅可比求积）相结合来近似卷积项；同时，将Volterra积分微分方程等价重构为常微分方程组进行求解，并针对Gamma和Pareto索赔额分布进行了具体实现。
AI.result: 成功开发了针对Gamma和Pareto索赔额分布的数值实现，数值实验结果验证了所提数值方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的龙格-库塔数值框架能有效计算经典风险模型中不同索赔分布下的破产概率。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了通过相关的Volterra积分微分方程计算经典风险模型中破产概率的龙格-库塔（Runge-Kutta）方法。所提出的框架将四阶单步和两步龙格-库塔格式与数值求积公式相结合，以近似卷积项。特别地，利用Newton-Cotes和高斯求积公式（包括辛普森1/3法则和针对Pareto调整的高斯-雅可比求积）来近似卷积项。同时，还考虑了将Volterra方程等价重构为常微分方程组的方法。本文针对Gamma和Pareto索赔额分布进行了算法实现。数值结果表明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了计算经典风险模型中破产概率的龙格-库塔（Runge-Kutta）数值方法。通过将相关的Volterra积分微分方程转化为常微分方程组，并结合四阶单步、两步龙格-库塔格式以及多种数值求积公式（如Simpson法则和自适应Gauss-Jacobi求积）来处理卷积项，实现了对Gamma和Pareto索赔额分布下破产概率的高效计算，数值实验证实了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 龙格-库塔方法, 破产概率, Volterra积分微分方程, 数值求积, 经典风险模型
AI.comments: 该论文将经典的数值分析工具（龙格-库塔法与求积公式）成功应用于精算数学中的破产概率计算。其创新之处在于结合了四阶单步和两步龙格-库塔格式，并针对重尾的Pareto分布定制了专门的求积公式（如Pareto自适应Gauss-Jacobi求积），这有效解决了破产概率计算中的数值困难。局限性在于摘要中未给出与其他现代数值方法在计算效率和精度上的定量对比。

title: Improvement of Clamonds solution of the Colebrook-White equation: highest accuracy for engineering purposes with one iteration
comments: 19 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables |v4: update of front page, header and footer
summary: The Colebrook-White equation is the widely used basis for the calculation of the friction factor lambda for flows in pipes and ducts. Because this equation is implicit in lambda, many solutions have been developed to ease the calculation in order to reduce the effort and to reach a sufficient accuracy. Clamond has proposed in 2008 an iterative solution that requires maximally two iterations to obtain the machine double precision. Here an improvement of this solution is presented, that achieves already with one iteration a maximal error of 2.79E-7, what is more than sufficient for most engineering purposes. This solution is compared in a chart of CPU time versus accuracy with 28 solutions from the literature and in the group of the fastest solutions, that require only two calls of the logarithm function, it proved to be by far the most accurate one.

AI.title_translation: Colebrook-White方程Clamond解法的改进：单次迭代实现工程应用中的最高精度

AI.method: 对Clamond在2008年提出的迭代解法进行了改进，使其仅需一次迭代。通过绘制CPU时间与精度的对比图，将该方法与文献中的28种解法进行了对比分析。

AI.conclusion: 改进后的Clamond解法在保证极高计算速度（仅需两次对数函数调用）的同时，通过仅一次迭代就达到了极高的精度，是目前同类快速算法中最准确的，非常适合工程实际应用。
AI.translation: Colebrook-White方程是计算管道和风管流动中摩擦因子lambda广泛使用的基础。由于该方程关于lambda是隐式的，因此人们开发了许多解法以简化计算，从而减少工作量并达到足够的精度。Clamond在2008年提出了一种迭代解法，该方法最多需要两次迭代即可获得机器双精度。本文提出了该解法的一种改进方案，仅需一次迭代即可达到2.79E-7的最大误差，这对于大多数工程目的是绰绰有余的。在CPU时间与精度的对比图中，将该解法与文献中的28种解法进行了比较，在仅需要两次调用对数函数的最快解法组中，它被证明是迄今为止最精确的一种。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种改进的Clamond迭代解法，用于求解计算管道流动摩擦因子的Colebrook-White方程。该改进方法仅需一次迭代即可实现2.79E-7的最大误差，满足大多数工程需求。在与文献中28种解法的对比中，该方法在仅需两次对数调用的最快算法类别中表现出最高的精度。
AI.keywords: Colebrook-White方程, Clamond解法, 摩擦因子, 迭代法, 计算精度
AI.comments: 该研究针对经典的Colebrook-White方程求解问题进行了非常实用的算法改进。其创新性在于对Clamond算法的优化，使得在仅进行一次迭代和两次对数调用的极低计算开销下，依然能保持极高的工程精度（误差低于3E-7）。这对于需要进行大规模管网水力模拟和实时计算的工程应用具有重要价值。局限在于摘要未透露具体的数学改进推导过程。

title: Hybrid least squares for learning functions from highly noisy data
summary: Motivated by the need for efficient estimation of conditional expectations, we consider a least-squares function approximation problem with heavily polluted data. Existing methods that are effective in the small-noise regime are suboptimal when large noise is present. To address this issue, we propose a hybrid approach that combines Christoffel sampling with optimal experimental design. We show that the proposed algorithm enjoys appropriate optimality properties for both sample point generation and noise mollification, leading to improved computational efficiency and sample complexity compared to existing methods. We also extend the algorithm to convexity-constrained settings with similar theoretical guarantees. When the target function is defined as the expectation of a random field, we further extend our approach to leverage adaptive random subspaces and establish results on the approximation capacity of the adaptive procedure. Our theoretical findings are supported by numerical studies on both synthetic data and on a more challenging stochastic simulation problem in computational finance.

AI.title_translation: 用于从高噪声数据中学习函数的混合最小二乘法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合Christoffel采样与最优实验设计的混合最小二乘法，用于解决高噪声数据下的函数逼近问题，显著提升了计算与样本效率。
AI.motivation: 在估计条件期望时，现有的在小噪声体制下有效的函数逼近方法在面对高噪声（严重污染）数据时表现不佳，因此需要一种能应对高噪声的高效逼近方法。
AI.method: 提出一种将Christoffel采样与最优实验设计相结合的混合方法。此外，将该算法推广到凸性约束设置，并针对目标函数为随机场期望的情况，引入了自适应随机子空间方法。
AI.result: 理论证明该算法在样本点生成和噪声缓和方面均具有最优性质，相比现有方法显著提高了计算效率并降低了样本复杂度。数值实验（合成数据和计算金融中的随机模拟）证实了其理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合最小二乘方法能有效解决高噪声环境下的函数逼近问题，具有良好的理论保证，并在计算效率和样本复杂度上优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 出于对条件期望进行高效估计的需求，我们考虑了在数据受到严重污染的情况下的最小二乘函数逼近问题。在小噪声情况下有效的现有方法在存在大噪声时是次优的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种结合了Christoffel采样与最优实验设计的混合方法。我们证明了所提算法在样本点生成和噪声缓和方面都具有适当的最优性质，与现有方法相比，提高了计算效率和样本复杂度。我们还将该算法扩展到具有类似理论保证的凸性约束设置中。当目标函数定义为随机场的期望时，我们进一步扩展了我们的方法以利用自适应随机子空间，并建立了关于该自适应过程逼近能力的结论。我们的理论发现得到了在合成数据以及计算金融中更具挑战性的随机模拟问题上的数值研究的支持。
AI.summary: 本文针对高噪声数据下的函数逼近问题，提出了一种结合Christoffel采样与最优实验设计的混合最小二乘算法。该方法克服了传统方法在强噪声下表现不佳的缺陷，提高了计算效率和样本复杂度。此外，该方法还被成功推广至凸性约束和基于自适应随机子空间的随机场期望估计中，其优越性在数值实验和金融随机模拟中得到了验证。
AI.keywords: 混合最小二乘, Christoffel采样, 最优实验设计, 函数逼近, 高噪声数据
AI.comments: 该论文创新地将Christoffel采样与最优实验设计相结合，针对高噪声环境下的最小二乘函数逼近问题给出了具有理论保证的解决方案。其在样本复杂度和计算效率上的提升具有重要的实用价值，且向凸约束及自适应随机子空间的扩展进一步扩大了该方法的应用场景（如计算金融）。

title: Shortest paths in planar domains with hyperbolic type metrics
summary: We study planar domains $G$ equipped with a hyperbolic type metric and approximate geodesics that join two points $x,y \in G$ and their lengths. We present an algorithm that enables one to approximate the shortest distance in polygonal domains taken with respect to the quasihyperbolic metric. The method is based on Dijkstra's algorithm, and we give several examples demonstrating how the algorithm works and analyze its accuracy. We experimentally demonstrate several previously theoretically observed features of geodesics, such as the relationship between hyperbolic and quasihyperbolic distance in the unit disk. We also investigate bifurcation of geodesics and the connection of this phenomenon to the medial axis of the domain.

AI.title_translation: 具有双曲型度量的平面区域中的最短路径
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Dijkstra算法的新方法，用于近似多边形区域中拟双曲度量下的最短路径，并通过实验研究了测地线特征及分叉现象与区域中轴的联系。

AI.method: 提出了一种基于迪杰斯特拉（Dijkstra）算法的数值算法，用于在多边形区域中近似拟双曲度量下的最短路径和距离；并通过数值实验分析了算法的准确性，以及研究了测地线分叉与区域中轴的关系。
AI.result: 成功开发出一种基于Dijkstra算法的近似最短距离算法，分析了其精度，实验验证了单位圆盘中双曲与拟双曲距离关系等理论特征，并探讨了测地线分叉与中轴的关联。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功提出了一种有效的算法来近似多边形区域中的拟双曲最短距离，实验结果不仅验证了测地线的理论特征，还揭示了测地线分叉与区域中轴之间的紧密联系。
AI.translation: 我们研究了配备有双曲型度量的平面区域 $G$，并近似了连接两个点 $x,y \in G$ 的测地线及其长度。我们提出了一种算法，能够近似多边形区域中关于拟双曲度量的最短距离。该方法基于迪杰斯特拉（Dijkstra）算法，我们给出了几个示例来演示该算法的工作原理并分析了其准确性。我们通过实验展示了先前在理论上观察到的测地线的若干特征，例如单位圆盘中双曲距离与拟双曲距离之间的关系。我们还研究了测地线的分叉现象，以及该现象与区域中轴（medial axis）之间的联系。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有双曲型度量的平面区域中的测地线及其长度近似问题。作者提出了一种基于Dijkstra算法的数值方法，用以计算多边形区域在拟双曲度量下的最短路径。通过多组示例，文章展示了该算法的运行机制并分析了其精度。此外，研究还通过实验验证了测地线的理论性质（如单位圆盘中双曲与拟双曲距离的关系），并探讨了测地线分叉现象及其与区域中轴的内在联系。
AI.keywords: 双曲型度量, 拟双曲度量, 测地线, 迪杰斯特拉算法, 区域中轴
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将经典的图论算法（Dijkstra算法）引入到计算几何中，用于近似求解连续平面区域下的拟双曲最短路径问题。这种方法不仅具有理论意义，还能通过实验直观地展示测地线的分叉现象及其与区域中轴的关联，为几何分析提供了数值计算工具。局限性在于摘要中未给出算法的理论误差界限和计算复杂度的详细分析。

title: Endpoint Koopman Spectral Computation: $L^1$ Residual Bounds, $L^\infty$ Instability, and Point-Spectral SCI Calibration Families
comments: Revised version: Corrected issue from 1<p<\infty theory and further smaller logical mistakes
summary:
We study endpoint Koopman spectral computation from the viewpoint of the Solvability Complexity Index (SCI). Let \((\mathcal X,d)\) be a compact metric space with finite Borel measure \(ω\), and let \(\mathcal K_F\) be the Koopman operator associated with a continuous nonsingular map \(F:\mathcal X\to\mathcal X\).
  First, on \(L^1(\mathcal X,ω)\), we record the endpoint residual upper-bound in the target-split form. The regularized compact fixed-\(\varepsilon\) target $R_{\mathrm{ap},\varepsilon}(\mathcal K_F)$ is separated from the closed fixed-\(\varepsilon\) target $C_{\mathrm{ap},\varepsilon}(\mathcal K_F)$ and from the exact approximate point spectrum $σ_{\mathrm{ap}}(\mathcal K_F).$ This endpoint statement uses the same point-evaluation plus fixed-quadrature information model as the \(1<p<\infty\) residual theory.
  Second, we isolate two obstructions at the nonseparable endpoint \(L^\infty\). Fixed quadrature schemes do not discretize the full \(L^\infty\) unit sphere, and even inside measure-preserving Cantor homeomorphisms the map $F\mapsto σ_{\mathrm{ap}}(\mathcal K_F:L^\infty\to L^\infty)$ is maximally discontinuous in Hausdorff distance under arbitrarily small uniform perturbations of \(F\). We also show that finite-period Silver-tree block constructions cannot yield analytic hardness for the \(L^\infty\) approximate point spectrum: for a fixed non-torsion \(z_0\in\mathbb T\), the condition $z_0\inσ_{\mathrm{ap}}(\mathcal K_{F}:L^\infty\to L^\infty)$ collapses to a Borel unbounded-period condition. In addition, fixed \(L^\infty\) point-eigenvalue membership is Borel in the measure-preserving continuous class, so one fixed eigenvalue cannot encode a non-Borel tree predicate.
  Third, we construct Koopman point-spectrum calibration families on the Cantor space.
